Cinnamon Applesauce Muffins  Moist & Flavorful Treat
Introduction
These Cinnamon Applesauce Muffins are the perfect treat for cozy mornings or afternoon snacks. The combination of cinnamon and applesauce is a classic that never fails to delight the taste buds. What makes this recipe even more special is its ease of preparationno fancy equipment or complicated steps are required. Whether youre a seasoned baker or just starting out, youll find this recipe straightforward and rewarding.
The use of unsweetened applesauce not only adds moisture but also cuts down on the amount of oil needed, making these muffins a slightly healthier option. Plus, the warm spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves give these muffins a depth of flavor thats perfect for the fall season or any time you crave something comforting.
Ingredients
To prepare this comforting Cinnamon Applesauce Muffins recipe, youll need:
For the Muffins:
2  cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
 teaspoon ground ginger
 teaspoon ground nutmeg
 teaspoon ground cloves
2 cups unsweetened applesauce all-natural
2 large eggs, room temperature
1 cup vegetable oil
 cup granulated sugar
 cup light brown sugar
1  teaspoons vanilla extract
 cup chopped walnuts or pecans optional
For the Cinnamon Cream Cheese Frosting:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1  teaspoons vanilla extract
3  cups powdered sugar #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
My nana made this every year but I kept forgetting to write it down. So glad I found something that comes close to hers!.
Nanas Frozen Fruit Salad
Ingredients
- 1 8-ounce package cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 20-ounce can crushed pineapple, drained well
- 1 10-ounce package frozen strawberries or raspberries, slightly thawed and chopped
- 1 11-ounce can mandarin oranges, drained
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans
- 1/3 cup maraschino cherries, halved
- 2 ripe bananas, sliced
- Juice of 1 lemon
Directions
1. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until smooth and creamy.
2. Gently fold in the whipped cream until well combined.
3. Add the drained crushed pineapple, chopped strawberries, and mandarin oranges to the creamy mixture. Stir to incorporate the fruits evenly.
4. Incorporate the chopped pecans and halved maraschino cherries into the mixture, ensuring even distribution.
5. In a small bowl, toss the banana slices in the lemon juice to prevent browning. Then, gently fold the bananas into the salad mixture.
6. Spread the fruit salad evenly into a 9x13-inch pan. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours, or until firm.
7. To serve, remove from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes. Cut into squares and enjoy.
Variations & Tips
For a lighter version, you can substitute the cream cheese with a lower-fat or Neufchâtel cheese, and use a light whipped topping instead of heavy cream. To enhance the nutty flavor, toast the pecans beforehand. This dish is also beautifully adaptable - feel free to swap in other fruits depending on the season or your preference. Peaches, mangoes, or even a mix of berries can create delightful variations. If you are looking to add an extra dimension of flavor, a splash of rum or an orange-flavored liqueur can weave in a sophisticated note. #recipes #recipereels #recipeideas #recipeshare #recipeoftheday #recipe

Great-Grandmas Frozen Fruit Salad
Frozen fruit salad is a nostalgic classic! This vintage recipe offers a cool, creamy, and delicious way to enjoy fruit. Perfect for holiday gatherings, it also makes a refreshing and fun side dish for summer parties!
Ingredients

 cup drained Maraschino cherries

Quarter cherries

Fold whipped cream into the fruit mixture.
Put into a glass 9x13 pan or similarly sized freezer safe serving dish. Freeze until solid.
Remove from freezer 10-15 minutes before time to serve.
Use a sharp knife to cut into squares and enjoy.

Message:
New Orleans Beignet
Ingredients
1 and 1/2 cups warm water, between 110 and 115 degrees F
2/3 cup granulated sugar
2 and 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
2 large eggs, at room temperature
1 cup evaporated milk
2 and 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
7 cups bread flour
1 and 1/2 teaspoons salt
5 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature
4 cups peanut oil, for deep frying
2 cups confectioners sugar
Instructions
In a medium-size bowl, add the warm water, sugar, and yeast and whisk well to combine. Sit aside for about 10 minutes, or until the mixture has bubbled up and become foamy.
In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment,  beat the eggs until smooth. Beat in the vanilla and evaporated milk. Beat in 3 and 1/2 cups of the flour until smooth. Turn the mixer to low speed and slowly pour in the yeast mixture careful here - this mixture can splash up if added to quickly!; beat until smooth. Add in the butter and beat until incorporated. Finally, beat in the remaining 3 and 1/2 cups of flour and salt. Beat until dough is smooth and cohesive; about 2 minutes. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate the dough for at least 2 hours, or up to 24 hours.
Line a large rimmed baking sheet with three layers of paper towels, set aside.
In a large enameled cast-iron pan, heat 4-inches of oil to 360 degrees F. Remove the dough from the refrigerator. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out into a 1/4-inch thick rectangle. Cut the dough into 2 and 1/2-inch squares.
In batches, fry the dough until they puff up and are golden brown in color, about 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beignets to the prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining dough.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve at once!

Message:
Strawberry Cheesecake Dump Cake
Ingredients:
2 15 oz cans strawberry pie filling
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 large egg
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 package vanilla or white cake mix
1/2 cup salted butter, cold, sliced into thin pats
Fresh strawberries, whole or halved optional, for serving
Directions:
Preheat the oven to 350F.
Spread the strawberry pie filling evenly across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese, egg, and sugar until creamy and well combined.
Drop spoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture over the strawberry filling, spreading slightly to create an even layer.
Evenly sprinkle the dry cake mix over the strawberry and cream cheese layers.
Distribute the slices of butter across the top, covering as much of the cake mix as possible.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden and the strawberry filling is bubbling at the edges.
Serve warm or cooled, garnished with fresh strawberries if desired.
Servings: 8-10

Message:
Irresistible Mini Chocolate Peanut Butter Pies #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes 
Introduction
These mini chocolate peanut butter pies are a heavenly treat that combines the creamy goodness of peanut butter with the luxurious taste of chocolate. Originating from the classic American dessert traditions, this recipe brings together the best of both worlds. Whether youre making these for a special occasion or just to satisfy a sweet craving, these mini pies are sure to impress.
Ingredients
To prepare this comforting recipe for mini chocolate peanut butter pies, youll need:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/2 cup butter, melted
1 cup creamy peanut butter
1/2 cup powdered sugar
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2 cup heavy cream for chocolate ganache
1 tsp vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
Chocolate chips for garnish
Optional substitutions:
Use gluten-free graham crackers to make the crust gluten-free.
Substitute dairy-free butter and cream cheese for a lactose-free version.
How to Make Mini Chocolate Peanut Butter Pies
Follow these steps to create your own delicious mini chocolate peanut butter pies:
Prepare the Crust: In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press mixture into the bottoms and sides of a muffin tin lined with cupcake liners. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to set.
Make the Filling: In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla extract, and mix until well combined.
Whip the Cream: In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture.
Fill the Crusts: Spoon the peanut butter filling into the chilled crusts, smoothing the tops with a spatula.
Prepare the Ganache: In a small saucepan, heat the 1/2 cup heavy cream until just simmering. Remove from heat and add the chocolate chips, stirring until melted and smooth.
Top with Ganache: Pour the chocolate ganache over the peanut butter filling, spreading evenly.
Chill and Serve: Refrigerate the pies for at least 2 hours, or until set. Garnish with additional chocolate chips before serving.
Helpful Tips
Ensure the cream cheese is softened for a smoother filling.
Chill the crusts thoroughly before adding the filling to prevent crumbling.
Cooking Tips
Enhance Flavor: Add a pinch of sea salt to the ganache for a salted chocolate twist.
Equipment: Using a stand mixer for whipping cream can save time and effort.

Message:
No Bake Pecan Coconut Praline Cookies 便
Ingredients:
1 cup pecan halves or pieces
1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
1/2 cup unsalted butter
1 cup brown sugar, packed
1/4 cup milk whole or almond milk works
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon sea salt
2 cups rolled oats
1/4 cup creamy peanut butter optional, for extra richness
Directions:
Toast the Pecans and Coconut: Start by placing your pecan halves and shredded coconut in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir frequently for about 5-6 minutes until the coconut is lightly golden brown and the pecans are fragrant. Remove from heat and set aside.
Make the Praline Syrup: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the brown sugar, milk, and sea salt. Stir continuously and bring to a gentle boil. Let it simmer for about 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly until the syrup thickens slightly.
Combine the Ingredients: Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract. Now, add the toasted pecans and coconut to the syrup mixture, and mix well to coat them evenly.
Add Oats and Optional Peanut Butter: Stir in the rolled oats and peanut butter if using. The mixture will be thick and stickydont worry, thats exactly what you want!
Form the Cookies: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat. Use a spoon or a small cookie scoop to drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared sheet. Shape them into small, round cookies.
Chill: Place the cookies in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to an hour, or until they firm up and set.
Serve and Enjoy: Once the cookies are firm, theyre ready to enjoy! These cookies are chewy, nutty, and packed with caramel-like sweetness.
Nutritional Information:
 Prep Time   Cooking Time   Total Time
 Calories per serving   Number of servings
#PecanCookies #NoBakeTreats #SweetTooth #CoconutDelights #EasyDesserts
Bon appétit and happy cooking!

Message:
Homemade Chocolate-Covered Ice Cream Bars 
Ingredients:
Vanilla ice cream or your favorite flavor
Melting chocolate milk, dark, or white
Optional toppings:
Crushed nuts 
Crushed cookies 
Sprinkles 
Drizzle e.g., white chocolate or caramel
Popsicle sticks
Instructions:
Shape the Ice Cream Bars:
Scoop ice cream into molds or shape into bars by hand.
Insert a popsicle stick into each bar.
Freeze until firm, about 23 hours.
Melt the Chocolate:
Place the chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl.
Heat in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until smooth.
Coat the Bars:
Remove frozen bars from the freezer.
Dip each bar into the melted chocolate, ensuring a full coat.
Add Toppings:
Before the chocolate hardens, sprinkle with toppings of your choice nuts, cookies, sprinkles, etc..
Optional: Drizzle with contrasting melted chocolate or caramel.
Freeze Again:
Place the coated bars on a parchment-lined tray.
Freeze for an additional 30 minutes until chocolate is set.
Serve and Enjoy:
Take out, savor, and share your delicious homemade treats!
Tips for Success:
Add a teaspoon of coconut oil to the melted chocolate for a smoother finish.
Use a tall, narrow container for dipping to get an even coating.
Store in an airtight container for up to a week for ultimate freshness.
Enjoy creating and indulging in these irresistible frozen delights! 
 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Nanas Frozen Fruit Salad
Ingredients
- 1 8-ounce package cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 20-ounce can crushed pineapple, drained well
- 1 10-ounce package frozen strawberries or raspberries, slightly thawed and chopped
- 1 11-ounce can mandarin oranges, drained
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans
- 1/3 cup maraschino cherries, halved
- 2 ripe bananas, sliced
- Juice of 1 lemon

1. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until smooth and creamy.

5. In a small bowl, toss the banana slices in the lemon juice to prevent browning. Then, gently fold the bananas into the salad mixture.
6. Spread the fruit salad evenly into a 9x13-inch pan. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours, or until firm.
7. To serve, remove from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes. Cut into squares and enjoy.

For a lighter version, you can substitute the cream cheese with a lower-fat or Neufchâtel cheese, and use a light whipped topping instead of heavy cream. To enhance the nutty flavor, toast the pecans beforehand. This dish is also beautifully adaptable - feel free to swap in other fruits depending on the season or your preference. Peaches, mangoes, or even a mix of berries can create delightful variations. If you are looking to add an extra dimension of flavor, a splash of rum or an orange-flavored liqueur can weave in a sophisticated note. #recipe #recipeshare #recipeoftheday #recipes #recipeideas

Ham and Cheese Roll-Ups
Ingredients:
8 large slices of deli ham
8 slices of Swiss or mozzarella cheese
8 lasagna sheets boiled until soft
2 cups béchamel sauce white sauce
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese for topping
1 tsp dried Italian herbs
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Instructions:
1. Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 180C 350F.
2. Prepare the Roll-Ups:
Place a lasagna sheet on a clean surface.
Layer one slice of ham and one slice of cheese on top.
Roll the sheet tightly into a log. Repeat with the remaining sheets, ham, and cheese.
3. Assemble in the Baking Dish:
Spread a thin layer of béchamel sauce on the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange the roll-ups seam side down in the dish.
4. Add the Toppings:
Pour the remaining béchamel sauce over the roll-ups.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese and Italian herbs on top.
5. Bake:
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden brown.
6. Serve:
Serve hot with a side salad or garlic bread for a complete meal.

Blueberry Cheesecake Swirl Rolls Recipe
Ingredients:
3 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 1/2 tablespoons powdered sugar
1 can refrigerated crescent roll dough
1/2 cup fresh blueberries
1/4 cup blueberry jam
1 egg, beaten for egg wash
Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 375F 190C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a bowl, mix cream cheese, vanilla extract, and powdered sugar until smooth.
3. Roll out the crescent roll dough and separate into rectangles, pressing seams together.
4. Spread the cream cheese mixture over each rectangle. Add a thin layer of blueberry jam and sprinkle with fresh blueberries.
5. Roll each rectangle into a log and cut into swirls. Place the swirls on the baking sheet.
6. Brush with beaten egg for a golden finish.
7. Bake for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly before serving.

Eggnog French Toast Recipe
Ingredients:
- 1 cup eggnog
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 8 slices bread
- Butter, for cooking
- Maple syrup, for serving
Directions:

3. Dip each slice of bread into the eggnog mixture, making sure to coat both sides.
4. Place the coated bread slices onto the skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides.
5. Serve the French toast hot with maple syrup drizzled on top.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 20 minutes  Servings: 4

Strawberry Cheesecake Dump Cake
Ingredients:
2 15 oz cans strawberry pie filling
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 large egg
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 package vanilla or white cake mix
1/2 cup salted butter, cold, sliced into thin pats
Fresh strawberries, whole or halved optional, for serving
Directions:
Preheat the oven to 350F.
Spread the strawberry pie filling evenly across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese, egg, and sugar until creamy and well combined.
Drop spoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture over the strawberry filling, spreading slightly to create an even layer.
Evenly sprinkle the dry cake mix over the strawberry and cream cheese layers.
Distribute the slices of butter across the top, covering as much of the cake mix as possible.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden and the strawberry filling is bubbling at the edges.
Serve warm or cooled, garnished with fresh strawberries if desired.
Servings: 8-10

 Start Your Day Right with This Hearty Breakfast Platter! 
Fuel your morning with this delicious and satisfying breakfast featuring sunny-side-up eggs, crispy bacon, sausages, roasted cherry tomatoes, sautéed mushrooms, creamy avocado slices, and perfectly toasted bread. 陋 Its the ultimate way to kickstart your day with flavor and nutrients!
 Ingredients Serves 2:
Proteins:
2 eggs 
4 breakfast sausages 
4 slices of bacon 肋
Vegetables:
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved 
1 cup mushrooms, sliced 
1 ripe avocado, sliced 陋
Others:
2 slices of bread, toasted 
Olive oil or butter for cooking 杻
Salt & pepper to taste 蓼
 Directions:
1 Cook the Bacon & Sausages:
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook bacon until crispy 34 mins per side. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook sausages until browned and cooked through 810 mins.
2 Sauté the Mushrooms:
Drain excess grease, leaving 1 tbsp in the skillet. Sauté mushrooms for 57 mins until golden. Season with salt and pepper.
3 Roast the Tomatoes:
In another pan, drizzle olive oil and cook halved cherry tomatoes until blistered 34 mins.
4 Cook the Eggs:
Heat a non-stick skillet with butter or oil. Cook eggs sunny-side-up or to your liking. Season with salt and pepper.
5 Assemble the Platter:
Arrange toast, bacon, sausages, mushrooms, tomatoes, and eggs on a large plate. Add avocado slices and lightly season.
 Tips & Variations:
 Sprinkle fresh herbs like parsley or chives for extra flavor.
 Swap toast for hash browns or roasted sweet potatoes for a fun twist.

Ravioli Lasagna Casserole
This hearty and comforting Ravioli Lasagna Casserole is loaded with tender ravioli, Italian sausage, zucchini, mushrooms, and topped with gooey melted mozzarella cheese.
Ingredients
1 tsp olive oil
1 lb Italian Sausage, mild or hot
2 cups zucchini, diced or shredded
2 cups mushrooms, chopped
2 tsp garlic, minced
2 tsp Italian Seasoning
1 tsp onion powder
24 oz pasta sauce, jarred or homemade
 cup water
48 oz Ravioli, frozen, cheese filled
16 oz mozzarella cheese, shredded
Instructions
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Lightly coat a 9x13"" casserole dish with non-stick spray and set aside.
Bring a large sauce pan to medium-high heat and add in oil. Cook sausage, breaking up until browned and cooked through. Add in zucchini, mushrooms, garlic, Italian seasoning and onion powder. Cook until veggies are tender. Scrape any browned bits off the bottom of pan as necessary.
Add in the pasta sauce and  cup of water. Bring sauce mixture to a simmer for just 3 to 5 minutes.
Layer the casserole with 1 cup of sauce on the bottom. Add  of the frozen ravioli in an even layer, top with  of the remaining sauce and  of the mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers with the remaining ravioli, sauce and cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 60 minutes.
Uncover casserole and continue baking for an additional 15 to 20 minutes, until the casserole is bubbly throughout and cheese is melted in middle. If desired, turn on the top broiler and brown cheese slightly. Let the casserole rest for about 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

Ground Beef Stuffed Pepper Skillet
This incredibly simple Ground Beef Stuffed Pepper Skillet comes together in just one pan in under 30 minutes! Enjoy all the delicious flavors of a stuffed pepper without the fuss!
Ingredients
1 lb. ground beef
1/2 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup green bell pepper
1/2 cup red bell pepper
14.5 oz diced tomatoes
3/4 cups white rice, I use Jasmine
2 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
1 1/2 cups cheese
1 tbsp parsley
Instructions
Brown the ground beef with the onion and garlic in a skillet over medium heat until ground beef is fully cooked, crumbled, and no longer pink. Drain and discard any fat. Place the skillet back on the heat and add in the bell peppers, diced tomatoes, rice, beef broth, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Stir to combine and bring mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to a simmer, cover and let cook for about 18 minutes, until rice is cooked through.
Fluff the rice with a fork and top with the shredded cheese. Cover again and let cheese melt over low heat. Garnish with fresh parsley and enjoy!

Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cabbage
Whip up this incredibly simple Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cabbage for a festive St. Patricks Day celebration or a cozy, comforting Sunday dinner!
Ingredients
3 to 4 lb. corned beef, with seasoning
4 cups low sodium beef broth
2 bay leaves
1 lb. baby carrots
2 lbs. baby potatoes, red and gold
 head cabbage, chopped
Instructions
Remove the corned beef from packaging and place in the bottom of the slow cooker. Cover with beef broth or water for a more mild flavor, and top with 2 bay leaves. Cover and cook on LOW heat for 5 hours.
Add in potatoes and carrots around brisket and continue cooking on LOW heat for 3 more hours.
Finally, add in the chopped cabbage on top, cover and continue cooking for an additional 30 minutes on LOW heat.
Use tongs and a slotted spoon to remove cabbage, carrots and potatoes from slow cooker. Remove the corned beef and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Enjoy!

Chicken Parmesan Calzone Recipe
Ingredients:
16-20 ounces pizza dough
4 cups pizza sauce
2 tablespoons butter, melted
2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 cups cooked and shredded chicken
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 400F 200C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Roll out the pizza dough into a large circle on a floured surface.
3. In a bowl, mix shredded chicken with 2 cups of pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
4. Spread the chicken mixture on one half of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
5. Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and pinch the edges to seal.
6. Brush the calzone with melted butter and sprinkle with extra Parmesan cheese.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with the remaining pizza sauce for dipping. #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Juicy Pineapple Cake Recipe
Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 large eggs
1/2 cup pineapple juice
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup crushed pineapple drained

Instructions:

Ingredients
8 slices thick-cut Texas toast See Kellys Notes
4 large eggs
1 cup heavy cream
2 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
1 Tablespoon sugar
1 Tablespoon vanilla extract
Unsalted butter, for cooking
Maple syrup, for serving
Instructions 
Cut each slice of Texas toast into four sticks. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, cinnamon, sugar and vanilla. Dip each piece of bread in the egg mixture, turning to coat it on all sides so that its well-saturated with the custard.
Shake off any excess and place the coated bread on a large plate or baking dish. Repeat the dipping process with the remaining pieces of bread.
Heat a large sauté pan over medium heat and add 2 to 3 tablespoons of butter. Once the butter has melted, place several of the coated sticks in a single layer in the pan. Do not overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on one side then flip and continue cooking until the sticks are golden brown and slightly crisped on all edges.
Serve immediately with maple syrup for dipping.

Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 30 mins
Total Time: 50 mins
Servings: 16
Yield: 1 9x13-inch casserole
Ingredients
3 cups cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1 cup white sugar
1 8 ounce can crushed pineapple, drained
 14 ounce bag flaked coconut, or more to taste
 cup unsalted butter, melted
 cup milk
2 eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup firmly packed brown sugar
1 cup finely chopped pecans
 cup all-purpose flour
 cup unsalted butter, melted
Directions
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Beat sweet potatoes, white sugar, pineapple, coconut, 1/2 cup melted butter, milk, eggs, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until smooth; pour into the prepared pan and set aside. Combine brown sugar, pecans, flour, and 1/3 cup melted butter in a separate bowl; sprinkle over sweet potato mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbly and topping is browned, about 30 minutes.

I always use fresh sweet potatoes that I have baked in the oven ahead of time so they have plenty of time to cool. Be sure you put a pan under them in your oven because they tend to split and run everywhere and can really make a mess! Strawberry Oatmeal Bars
Strawberry Oatmeal Bars are a wholesome and delicious fruit dessert featuring fresh strawberries, a buttery whole-grain crumb topping, and a subtly sweet vanilla glaze. These lighter oatmeal bars are a crowd favorite,
Ingredients
  
For the Strawberry Bars:
1 cup old-fashioned rolled oats gluten free if needed
 cup white whole wheat flour or substitute all-purpose flour or 1:1 baking flour to make gluten free
 cup light brown sugar
 teaspoon ground ginger
 teaspoon kosher salt
6 tablespoons unsalted butter melted or substitute melted coconut oil to make vegan/dairy free
2 cups small-diced strawberries about 10 ounces, divided
1 teaspoon cornstarch
1 tablespoon  freshly squeezed lemon juice from about 1/2 small lemon
1 tablespoon granulated sugar divided
For the Vanilla Glaze optional but delicious, especially if you prefer a sweeter bar:
 cup powdered sugar sifted
 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
1 tablespoon milk any kind you like
Instructions
 
Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 375 degrees F. Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with parchment paper so that the paper overhangs two sides like handles.
In a medium bowl, combine the oats, flour, brown sugar, ginger, and salt. Pour in the melted butter and stir until it forms clumps and the dry ingredients are evenly moistened. Set aside 1/2 cup of the crumble mixture, then press the rest into an even layer in the bottom of the prepared pan. Press very firmly so the crust holds together you can also use the back of a measuring cup to help press it into an even later.
Scatter half of the strawberries over the crust. Sprinkle the cornstarch evenly over the top, then sprinkle on the lemon juice and 1/2 tablespoon of the granulated sugar. Scatter on the remaining berries, then the remaining 1/2 tablespoon sugar. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs evenly over the top. You will have some fruit showing through.
Bake the bars for 35 to 40 minutes, until the fruit is bubbly and the crumb topping smells toasty and looks golden. Place the pan on a wire rack to cool completely you can speed this process along in the refrigerator.
While the bars cool, prepare the glaze: In a medium bowl, briskly whisk together the powdered sugar, vanilla, and milk until smooth. Feel free to add more milk if a thinner consistency is desired. Using the parchment-paper handles, lift the bars from the pan. Drizzle with glaze, slice, and serve.

Strawberry Cheesecake Dump Cake
Ingredients:
2 15 oz cans strawberry pie filling
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 large egg
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 package vanilla or white cake mix
1/2 cup salted butter, cold, sliced into thin pats

Directions:

Spread the strawberry pie filling evenly across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Distribute the slices of butter across the top, covering as much of the cake mix as possible.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden and the strawberry filling is bubbling at the edges.
Serve warm or cooled, garnished with fresh strawberries if desired.
Servings: 8-10

Strawberry Shortcake Cheesecake Rolls
Crepe rolls filled with creamy cheesecake mixture, fresh strawberries, and a buttery cookie crumb layer. A beautiful no-bake dessert.
Ingredients
 8 oz cream cheese, softened.
 1/4 cup granulated sugar.
 1 teaspoon vanilla extract.
 1 cup heavy whipping cream.
 1 cup fresh strawberries, diced.
 2 tablespoons granulated sugar.
 1 1/2 cups crushed shortbread cookies or graham crackers.
 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted.
 6 large crepes or thin cake layers.
 Powdered sugar for dusting.
Instructions
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks and fold into cream cheese mixture.
Mix diced strawberries with sugar and let sit 10 minutes to macerate.
Mix crushed cookies with melted butter until mixture resembles wet sand.
Layer crepe with filling, crumbs, and strawberries. Roll tightly into sushi shape.
Wrap rolls in plastic and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Slice into 1-inch pieces and dust with powdered sugar.
Notes
Chill thoroughly before slicing.
Can use shortbread or graham crackers.

Philly Steak Cheese Fries Recipe
Ingredients:
4 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and black pepper to taste
1 lb 450g ribeye steak, thinly sliced
1 tbsp olive oil
1 medium onion, thinly sliced
1 green bell pepper, thinly sliced
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 cup beef broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2 cups shredded provolone cheese
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
Fresh parsley for garnish optional
Instructions:
Preheat your oven to 400F 200C.
Toss the potato fries with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy and golden.
While the fries bake, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the thinly sliced ribeye steak and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned. Remove the steak from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the onion and bell pepper. Cook for 5-6 minutes, until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Pour in the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce, scraping up any browned bits from the skillet. Let the mixture simmer for 2-3 minutes until the broth reduces slightly.
Return the cooked steak to the skillet and stir to combine.
Once the fries are done, place them on a serving platter or baking sheet. Top with the steak and vegetable mixture.
Sprinkle the provolone and cheddar cheese evenly over the top and return to the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese melts and is bubbly.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired and serve immediately.

Smoky, Brown Sugar Cajun Wings
3 tablespoons  Dark Brown Sugar
2 1/2 tablespoons Smoked Paprika
1 tablespoon Fine Kosher Salt
1 1/2 tablespoons Garlic Powder
1/2 tablespoon Ancho Chili Powder
1 tablespoon Ground Black Pepper
1 tablespoon Onion Powder
1/2 tablespoon Dried Oregano
1/2 tablespoon Dried Thyme
5 pounds Chicken Wings
4 - 4 1/2 tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided
4 tablespoons Baking Powder
Prep Time: 5 minutes / Cook Time: 25 minutes / Yields: 5-6 servings
Step 1
Prepare dry rub by combining  Dark Brown Sugar, smoked paprika, fine kosher salt, garlic powder, ancho chili powder, ground black pepper, onion powder, dried oregano & dried thyme. Set aside. 
Step 2
Pat the wings dry. Lightly drizzle with 2 - 2 1/2 tablespoons of olive oil. Coat with baking powder followed by 3 - 3 1/2 tablespoons of prepared dry rub. Ensure that the wings are well coated.
Step 3
Grease & preheat the air fryer to 375F. Once hot, place the wings in the air-fryer & cook for 18 - 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through. Ensure that the air-fryer basket is not overcrowded; cook in batches if necessary.
Step 4
While the wings cook, prepare the glaze. In a skillet, melt the butter on low heat, add 5 tablespoons of the rub & whisk well to combine. Remove from heat & add 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Whisk again. Add additional dry rub &/or salt, to taste.
Step 5
Add the wings to a bowl, drizzle with sauce & toss well to coat. Air fry again for 2 - 3 minutes at 400F or until sugar caramelizes. Serve hot & pair with your favorite dipping sauce.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups fresh blackberries the juicier, the better!
- 1 cup sugar because life is sweet, right?

Strawberry Cheesecake Dump Cake
This easy strawberry cheesecake dump cake is bursting with creamy, sweet, and tangy flavors! Layers of smooth cheesecake, juicy strawberries, and a buttery crumb topping come together to create a dessert thats perfect for any occasion. With the help of a boxed cake mix and canned pie filling, you can whip up this irresistible treat in no timeand no one will believe how simple it was to make!
Ingredients
1 15.25 oz Vanilla or french vanilla cake mix
1 stick of butter melted
1 8 oz Package of cream cheese
2 21 oz cans of Strawberry pie filling
Instructions
Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.
Spray your 9x13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray.
In a medium sized bowl melt your stick of butter. Add your cake mix and mix with a fork until its well combined and has a crumbly texture. Set aside.
Pour both cans of strawberry filling unto your 9x13 baking dish and spread out evenly.
Open your package of cream cheese and slice into thin pieces. Lay each thin slice on top of strawberry filling.
Pour your crumbly cake mixture on top and spread evenly.
Bake for 30 mins or until the strawberry is bubbling and the top is lightly golden brown.
Serve warm.
Notes
Dont try to sub yellow cake mix for the vanilla called for in this recipe. Yellow cake mix will turn out, well, yellow. You want the result to be white, which will only come from using either vanilla, French vanilla, or white cake mix. However, if you like chocolate with your strawberries- you can substitute a box of chocolate cake mix for a delicious variation.
If salt isnt a dietary concern, then I highly recommend using salted butter in this recipe. A little bit of salt naturally enhances the sweetness of the dessert.
Change things up and use different canned pie fillings in this recipe- cherry, blueberry, and peach all work well!

Strawberry Blueberry Banana Smoothie
This smoothie brings summertime straight to your glass. Sweet and creamy, this good-for-you smoothie is an easy way to start your day or refuel in the afternoon.
Ingredients
2 frozen bananas ripe and sweet
 cup frozen blueberries
8-10 frozen strawberries
1-2 tbsp honey adjust to taste
2 cups whole milk
Instructions
Layer the bananas, blueberries, and strawberries in the blender. Drizzle with honey and add the milk.
Puree until the mixture reaches a thick, creamy consistency. Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
Notes
With fruit smoothies, the sweetness of the frozen fruits will have a direct impact on the flavor of the smoothie. The same combination of ingredients that tasted perfect one day, might need an extra boost of sweetener another day. Play with the ingredients to find the perfect smoothie combination for your tastes.

Pie Crust Envelopes for Every Occasion
Ingredients
  
2 pre-made pie dough crusts store-bought is fine
Strawberry jam or your favorite fruit preserve
Knife
1 tablespoon melted butter or an egg wash 1 egg beaten with a teaspoon of water
Sugar for sprinkling
Baking sheet
Parchment paper optional, for easier cleanup
Instructions
 
Prepare the Pie Dough 
Start by unrolling the two pie dough crusts. Youll need to cut out four diamond shapes from the dough, so use a knife to carefully cut four diamonds from the two dough sheets. 
Add the Jam 
Next, place each diamond-shaped piece of dough on a clean surface or baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spoon a small amount of strawberry jam into the center of each diamond, about a tablespoon or so. Be sure not to overfill  you want enough jam to give a sweet center but not too much that it will ooze out when baked.
Fold the Dough Into an Envelope Shape 
Now, fold each diamond shape up into an envelope, bringing the two side points toward the center, followed by the bottom point, to create the body of the ""envelope."" Leave the top flap open to resemble an envelope that has yet to be sealed. Gently press the edges of the dough together to help hold the shape.
Cut Out Heart Shapes 
Use a knife, or small heart cookie cutter, to cut out four small hearts from the remaining dough. These will be the decorative seals for your love letters. Place one heart on the center of each envelope.
Brush with Butter or Egg Wash 
To give your love letter envelopes a golden, crispy finish, brush each one with melted butter or an egg wash. To make an egg wash, simply beat one egg with a teaspoon of water and brush it onto the dough. The egg wash will create a beautiful, shiny glaze. If youre using butter, just melt it and use a pastry brush to coat the dough lightly.
Sprinkle with Sugar 
For a sweet touch, lightly sprinkle each love letter with sugar. This adds a bit of sparkle and extra sweetness that makes these treats even more irresistible.
Bake 
Preheat your oven to 400F 200C. Place the love letter envelopes on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until they turn golden brow. Keep an eye on them towards the end to prevent burning. The sugar will caramelize slightly, creating a delightful crunch.
Let Cool and Enjoy 
Once the envelopes are golden and baked to perfection, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes. These treats are best served warm, but theyre delicious at room temperature as well!

Hawaiian Pineapple Coconut Fluff Recipe
Ingredients:
1 can crushed pineapple, drained
1 cup shredded coconut
1 package instant coconut pudding mix 3.4 oz
1 cup cold milk
1 container whipped topping 8 oz
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, whisk together the instant coconut pudding mix and cold milk until smooth and thickened.
2. Gently fold in the drained crushed pineapple and shredded coconut.

4. Refrigerate the fluff for at least 1 hour to chill and allow flavors to meld.
5. Serve in dessert cups, garnished with extra shredded coconut or pineapple chunks if desired. Enjoy this tropical treat!

Venison Jalapeño Cheddar Summer Sausage Recipe
Ingredients:
1 pound ground venison
 pound ground pork fat
 cup shredded cheddar cheese
2 jalapeños, finely diced
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon black pepper
2 teaspoons curing salt
1 tablespoon liquid smoke optional
Instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground venison, ground pork fat, shredded cheddar cheese, and diced jalapeños.
2. Add garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, curing salt, and liquid smoke. Mix thoroughly until well combined.
3. Divide the mixture into portions and shape into sausage logs. Wrap each log tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 12-24 hours to let the flavors meld.
4. Preheat your smoker to 180F 82C. Remove the plastic wrap from the sausage logs and place them on the smoker racks.
5. Smoke the sausages for 3-4 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 160F 71C.
6. Remove from the smoker, let cool, and refrigerate. Slice and enjoy your flavorful summer sausage!

Apple Crisp Cheesecake
Ingredients for the crust:
5 tablespoons unsalted butter melted
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
Ingredients for the cheesecake layer:
16 oz cream cheese softened

5. Bake for 40-45 minutes until the cheesecake is set. Cool, refrigerate for 4 hours, and drizzle with caramel sauce before serving.

How to Dry Apples: Tips for Delicious Apple Slices
Drying apples is a fantastic way to preserve their natural sweetness and enjoy a healthy snack. Heres a simple guide to creating delicious apple slices:
Preparation
Choose the Right Apples: Opt for firm, slightly tart apples like Granny Smith, Honeycrisp, or Fuji for the best flavor and texture.
Wash and Core: Wash the apples thoroughly and core them. No need to peel unless you prefer it.
Slice Evenly: Cut the apples into 1/8 to 1/4-inch slices for even drying. A mandoline slicer can be helpful.
Prevent Browning: Soak slices in a mixture of water and lemon juice 1 tablespoon of lemon juice per cup of water for 5-10 minutes to prevent browning.
Drying Methods
Dehydrator:
Arrange apple slices in a single layer on dehydrator trays.
Dry at 135F 57C for 6-12 hours, checking for desired texture.
Oven:
Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Place apple slices in a single layer and bake at 200F 93C for 2-4 hours, flipping halfway through.
Air Drying:
String slices on a clean thread or place on a drying rack in a warm, dry space with good airflow. This method takes several days.
Flavor Options
Sprinkle apple slices with cinnamon, nutmeg, or a light dusting of sugar for extra flavor.
Storage
Let the slices cool completely before storing.
Keep dried apples in airtight containers or resealable bags in a cool, dark place for up to 6 months.
Enjoy your homemade dried apple slices as a snack, in oatmeal, or baked into desserts!

10 full-size graham crackers
1 cup salted butter
3 chocolate bars
Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange graham crackers in a single layer.
3. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat and pour it evenly over the graham crackers.
4. Bake in the oven for 7-10 minutes, until the butter is bubbling.
5. Remove from the oven and immediately place chocolate bars on top of the hot graham crackers.
6. Let the chocolate melt, then spread it evenly across the surface.
7. Allow to cool and set before breaking into pieces.
8. Enjoy your delicious Smores Crack! #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
Sheet Pan Dinner with Sausage and Roasted Vegetables
A simple and delicious one-pan dinner combining lots of different veggies and two types of sausages. Its easy to prepare and even easier to eat!
Prep Time: 30 mins
Cook Time: 30 mins
Total Time: 1 hr
Servings: 6
Ingredients
1 head cauliflower, broken into florets
1 head broccoli, broken into florets
2 medium potatoes, peeled and cubed
2 large bell peppers any color, chopped
 cup baby carrots, or to taste
 large onion, chopped
1 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
1 teaspoon dried parsley, or to taste
1 teaspoon dried cilantro, or to taste
1 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
2 tablespoons olive oil, or as needed
1 12 ounce package apple chicken sausage such as Aidells, thinly sliced and quartered
1 12 ounce package Italian sausage such as Aidells, thinly sliced and quartered
Directions
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F 200 degrees C. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Combine cauliflower, broccoli, potatoes, bell peppers, baby carrots, and onion in a large bowl. Season with garlic powder, parsley, cilantro, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Add oil, chicken sausages, and Italian sausages. Toss to combine. Spread evenly on the prepared baking sheet. Season with more spices and oil if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven until vegetables are soft, and sausage is cooked, 30 to 45 minutes.
 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Blueberry Jam 𢡄
Ingredients:
- 550 g about 2 cups blueberries, preferably organic 𢡄
- 1/4 cup erythritol 
- Juice of 1/2 lemon 
- 1 g agar agar 
Instructions:
1. Add the rinsed blueberries and erythritol to a medium-sized pot. Cook over medium-low heat, covering the pot to help concentrate the heat 𢡄.
2. After 3-4 minutes, the blueberries will start releasing their natural juices .
3. Stir the mixture and mash the blueberries with a spatula as they soften 籠.
4. Pour in the juice of half a lemon and stir for another 2 minutes .
5. Add the agar agar, increase the heat to bring the mixture to a boil, and stir constantly for at least one minute to dissolve and fully incorporate the agar agar .
6. Remove from the heat and transfer the jam into glass jars with airtight lids .
7. Let the jam cool to room temperature before sealing the jars and storing.
Enjoy your homemade blueberry jam! 𢡄
 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
Crusted Salmon with Honey-Mustard Sauce
These delightful salmon fillets, with their wonderful honey-mustard-butter sauce, are similar to the salmon dish I enjoyed at a bar-and-grill in New Castle, Delaware.
Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 15 mins
Additional Time: 10 mins
Total Time: 40 mins
Servings: 4
Yield: 4 fillets
Ingredients
1 1.5 pound skinless center-cut salmon fillet, cut into 4 pieces
1 cup milk
 cup fine bread crumbs
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 large egg
 cup butter, melted
1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard
1 tablespoon honey
Directions
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F 190 degrees C. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Place fillets in a baking dish. Pour milk over fillets. Allow to soak in milk, 10 to 15 minutes.
Stir bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese together in a wide, deep bowl. Beat egg in a separate bowl until frothy. Remove fillets from milk, shaking off excess. Dip each fillet into egg. Gently press into breadcrumb mixture to coat, shaking off excess.
Bake in the preheated oven, turning once half way through cooking, until fillets flakes easily with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, stir butter, mustard, and honey together in a bowl. Drizzle over fillets and serve.
Cooks Notes:
The nutrition data for this recipe includes the full amount of milk and breading ingredients. The actual quantity of milk and breading consumed will vary.

Description:
Creamy Spinach Meatball Pasta
Ingredients:
For the Meatballs:
500g ground beef or a mix of beef and pork
1/4 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1 egg
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Sauce:
2 tbsp olive oil or butter
2 cups fresh spinach, chopped
2 cups heavy cream
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 garlic cloves, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Pasta:
400g spaghetti or your preferred pasta
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Meatballs:
In a bowl, mix all the meatball ingredients until well combined.
Form small, evenly sized meatballs about 1.5 inches in diameter.
Heat a skillet with a drizzle of oil and cook the meatballs over medium heat until browned on all sides and fully cooked. Set aside.
2. Cook the Pasta:
Boil the pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
3. Make the Creamy Spinach Sauce:
In the same skillet, add olive oil or butter and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper.
4. Combine Everything:
Add the cooked meatballs to the sauce and let them simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and meatballs until well coated.
5. Serve:
Garnish with extra Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve warm and enjoy!
#CreamySpinachMeatballPasta

Steak Loaded Fries
Ingredients:
For the Fries:
500g frozen French fries or homemade fries
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Steak:
250g steak ribeye or sirloin, cooked to your preference and sliced thinly
1 tbsp butter
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Cheese Topping:
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
Optional Toppings:
Chopped green onions
Sour cream
Crushed red pepper
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Fries:
Preheat the oven to 200C 400F.
Spread the fries on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 2025 minutes or until crispy, flipping halfway through.
2. Cook the Steak:
Season the steak with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the steak for 23 minutes per side or until cooked to your liking. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
3. Assemble the Loaded Fries:
Place the baked fries on an oven-safe platter.
Layer the sliced steak over the fries.
Sprinkle cheddar and mozzarella cheese on top.
4. Melt the Cheese:
Place the loaded fries back in the oven for 57 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
5. Serve:
Garnish with optional toppings like green onions, sour cream, or crushed red pepper. Serve hot and enjoy!
#LoadedFries
#SteakLovers

Garlic Butter Lobster Tails 咽龍
""Juicy lobster tails drizzled with a luscious garlic butter sauce, perfectly baked for a truly indulgent meal."

From name: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

Use kitchen shears or a sharp knife to carefully cut the top of each lobster shell lengthwise, exposing the meat. Gently pull the lobster meat out and rest it on top of the shell ""piggybacking"" the lobster meat.
In a small bowl, mix melted butter, minced garlic, lemon juice, paprika, dried parsley, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Place the prepared lobster tails on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Generously brush the garlic butter mixture over the lobster meat, ensuring even coverage.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the lobster meat is opaque and firm to the touch. The internal temperature should reach 145F 63C.
Remove from the oven and drizzle any remaining garlic butter over the lobster meat.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley and serve hot with lemon wedges for a zesty finish.

The Best Cinnamon Rolls
This recipe for the best cinnamon rolls results from a long line of experimenting and tweaking a cinnamon roll recipe I got the first time I went to the United States. I hope you enjoy it!
Prep Time: 30 mins
Cook Time: 20 mins
Additional Time: 1 hr 35 mins
Total Time: 2 hrs 25 mins
Servings: 12
Yield: 1 dozen rolls
Ingredients
Cinnamon Roll Dough:
1 cup milk
1 tablespoon active dry yeast
1 tablespoon white sugar
 cup white sugar
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
4 cups all-purpose flour, or more as needed
1 teaspoon sea salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
Cinnamon-Sugar Filling:
1 cup packed brown sugar
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened
2  tablespoons ground cinnamon
Cream Cheese Frosting:
2 cups confectioners sugar
1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened
 cup unsalted butter, softened
 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
 teaspoon salt
Directions
Microwave milk in a microwave-safe bowl until warm but not hot to the touch, 45 to 60 seconds. An instant-read thermometer should read about 105 degrees F 41 degrees C. Pour into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook.
Stir yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar into warm milk; let sit proof until foamy, about 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 6 tablespoons melted butter, eggs, and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract; beat until combined.
Add 4 cups flour, 1 teaspoon sea salt, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; beat, starting on low speed and gradually increasing to high speed, until forms a large ball of smooth and slightly tacky dough. Add more flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, if dough seems too sticky, until forms a smooth ball.
Transfer dough to a floured surface; knead with your hands until smooth and elastic, 3 to 5 minutes. Form into a ball; place in a large, lightly oiled bowl and turn to coat. Cover the bowl with a warm, damp towel; let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.
Meanwhile, combine brown sugar, 6 tablespoons softened butter, and 2 1/2 tablespoons cinnamon in a small bowl; set filling aside.
Gently punch down dough and transfer to a large, floured work surface; roll into a 24x12-inch rectangle, about 1/4-inch thick. Spread filling over dough with greased hands or a greased spatula. Roll up dough; cut into 12 equal-sized rolls, about 2-inches long.
Line a 9x13-inch glass baking dish with parchment paper; lightly grease paper. Place cinnamon rolls into the prepared baking dish in 4 evenly spaced rows. Cover dish; let rise until nearly doubled in volume, about 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 18 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat confectioners sugar, cream cheese, 1/4 cup softened butter, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract, and 1/8 teaspoon salt together in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth; keep frosting at room temperature while rolls bake.
Spread frosting on warm rolls; cool before serving.
Cooks Note:
Spreading the cinnamon-brown sugar filling can seem difficult, but it gets easier as you spread it. Alternately, you can just combine the cinnamon and brown sugar for the filling and set aside. Melt butter and spread it all over the dough with a pastry brush, then sprinkle with cinnamon-brown sugar, patting it down gently to ensure it sticks.

Message:
Restaurant-Style Shoyu Miso Ramen
Inspired by the shoyu ramen at my favorite ramen restaurant, this restaurant-style shoyu miso ramen recipe is my ideal. If you want to make it pescatarian, forgo the pork belly for bonito flakesjust a big pinch in each bowl.
Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 4 hrs 30 mins
Additional Time: 4 hrs 5 mins
Total Time: 8 hrs 50 mins
Servings: 4
Ingredients
 cup dried black fungus
2 cups mirin
1  cups soy sauce, divided
 onion, coarsely chopped
 cup brown sugar
6 green onion bulbs, chopped, divided
6 cloves garlic, peeled
2 pounds skin-on, boneless pork belly
kitchen twine
4 eggs
2 tablespoons brown sugar
 cup miso paste
4 3 ounce packages ramen noodles, or to taste
4 sheets nori dry seaweed, quartered
1 naruto fish paste stick with a red spiral pattern, sliced
Directions
Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F 135 degrees C.
Place black fungus in a large bowl; fill with water.
Combine mirin, 1/2 cup soy sauce, onion, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 3 chopped green onion bulbs, and garlic in an oven-safe pot over high heat; bring to a boil.
Place pork belly skin-side down on a flat work surface. Roll up lengthwise; secure with twine. Place pork belly into mirin mixture; partially cover pot with lid.
Bake in the preheated oven until pork is tender and an instant-read thermometer inserted into center reads at least 145 degrees F 63 degrees C, about 4 hours.
Fill a bowl with ice and cold water; set aside. Meanwhile, bring a separate pot of water to a boil over high heat; gently add eggs and cook until yolks are barely set, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer eggs to the bowl of ice water; let sit about 1 minute. Remove eggs from water; peel.
Place eggs in a container with 1 cup water, 1/2 cup soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons brown sugar. Dampen a paper towel in soy sauce mixture; cover container with dampened paper towel. Refrigerate 4 hours to overnight.
Drain black fungus; add to liquid in pork belly pot. Cover pot with a lid; refrigerate 4 hours to overnight.
Skim fungus from top of pork belly mixture; place in a pot with 8 cups water. Fungus should be covered in pork belly fat. Add remaining 1/4 cup soy sauce and miso paste; bring to a boil.
Remove and discard skin from pork belly using a knife. Chop meat into pieces of desired thickness. Cut eggs in half lengthwise.
Bring a separate pot of water to a boil. Add ramen and cook until noodles are tender yet firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Drain.
Place 4 nori slices diagonally in corner of each bowl. Place noodles on top; arrange 2 egg halves and a few pork belly slices separately. Cover with black fungus, top with remaining 3 chopped green onion bulbs, and pour in broth. Top each bowl with a few slices of naruto. Let sit before serving, about 3 minutes.
Cooks Note:
Use fresh ramen noodles if possible.

Message:
Absolutely Delicious Baked Root Vegetables
This absolutely delicious baked root vegetables recipe is a wonderful way to prepare root vegetables. This savory combination of potatoes, rutabagas, carrots, parsnips, and sweet potatoes keeps people going back for seconds!
Prep Time: 25 mins
Cook Time: 40 mins
Total Time: 1 hr 5 mins
Servings: 8
Ingredients
1 pound new potatoes, halved
1 large sweet potato, peeled and cubed
2 large parsnips, peeled and cubed
2 large carrots, peeled and cubed
 large rutabaga, peeled and cubed
3 tablespoons olive oil
3 tablespoons sweet red chili sauce
1 tablespoon steak seasoning
1  teaspoons onion powder
1  teaspoons garlic powder
1 teaspoon ground black pepper
Directions
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F 190 degrees C.
Toss potatoes, sweet potato, parsnips, carrots, and rutabaga with olive oil and chili sauce in a large bowl until coated; season with steak seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, and black pepper. Toss until evenly coated; spread vegetables into a 9x13-inch roasting pan.
Cook in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender, about 40 minutes, stirring halfway through.

Message:
Creamy Vegan Corn Chowder
I was experimenting with different menu ideas when I became a vegan and came across this great low-fat comfort food: creamy vegan corn chowder recipe. Its great as a meal starter or as the main course.
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 40 mins
Total Time: 1 hr
Servings: 6
Ingredients
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 small onion, chopped
1 cup celery, chopped
1 cup carrots, chopped
1 clove garlic, minced
2  cups water
2 cubes vegetable bouillon
2 cups corn
2 cups soy milk
1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon dried parsley
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground black pepper
Directions
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and celery; cook until just slightly golden. Stir in carrots and garlic; cook until garlic is slightly golden.
Meanwhile, bring water to a boil in a pot over high heat. Add bouillon cubes, reduce heat to medium, and stir until cubes are dissolved. Add corn and onion mixture; cook until vegetables are tender, adding water, if necessary. Reduce heat to low, pour in 1 cup soy milk, stir well, then stir in remaining 1 cup soy milk. Quickly whisk in flour; stir in parsley, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook until chowder thickens, stirring constantly, 15 to 20 minutes.

Message:
Gluten Free Danish
My husband says these gluten-free Danish are the closest thing to real Danish he has had since going gluten free five years ago. We like raspberry jam in this recipe, but you could also try pie filling in the middles.
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 10 mins
Additional Time: 15 mins
Total Time: 45 mins
Servings: 6
Yield: 1 dozen Danish
Ingredients
2 cups gluten-free pancake mix
 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
2 tablespoons white sugar
 cup milk
3/4 teaspoon almond extract, divided
 cup raspberry jam
 cup confectioners sugar
2 tablespoons milk, or more as needed
 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F 200 degrees C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine pancake mix, butter, and sugar in a bowl; stir until crumbly. Stir in 2/3 cup milk and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract until fully incorporated; the dough will be sticky.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheet, spaced about 2 inches apart. Make a shallow indentation in center of each dough ball using the back of a teaspoon. Fill each center with 1 teaspoon jam.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.
Combine confectioners sugar, 3 tablespoons milk, vanilla extract, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon almond extract; mix until smooth. Drizzle glaze over Danish.

Message:
Sheet Pan Eggs
This recipe for sheet pan eggs is an easy way to make eggs for a crowd. Add a total of 1 cup cooked vegetables, cooked bacon, ham, chicken, sautéed onions, more cheese, sausage, or herbs to the eggs to your liking.
Prep Time: 10 mins
Cook Time: 15 mins
Total Time: 25 mins
Servings: 12
Ingredients
oil
12 large eggs
 cup milk
1 cup mix-ins cooked vegetables, cooked bacon, ham, chicken, sausage, sautéed onions, more cheese, or herbs
 cup shredded Cheddar cheese
Directions
Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F 150 degrees C. Grease a baking sheet well with oil.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a large bowl; add 1 cup mix-ins. Pour mixture into the prepared baking sheet; dot with little Cheddar cheese piles.
Bake until eggs are just set, about 15 minutes. Eggs will continue to cook out of the ovenbut leave them in too long and they will become rubbery. Slice into squares; serve.
Cooks Note:
You can use any type of shredded cheese instead of Cheddar cheese, such as mozzarella or pepper Jack.

Message:
Carrot Bundt Cake with Orange-Bourbon Glaze
This carrot Bundt cake with orange-bourbon glaze recipe has all the spice and texture of a traditional carrot cake but uses a non-creamy, orange-bourbon glaze, which is perfect for those sensitive to dairy. Garnish it with coarsely grated orange zest.
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 45 mins
Additional Time: 15 mins
Total Time: 1 hr 20 mins
Servings: 12
Yield: 1 Bundt cake
Ingredients
Carrot Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
2 teaspoons baking soda
2 teaspoons baking powder
 teaspoon salt
 teaspoon ground allspice
 teaspoon ground ginger
2 cups white sugar
4 large eggs
 cup vegetable oil
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
3 cups lightly packed shredded carrots, drained of excess water
Orange-Bourbon Glaze:
4 tablespoons unsalted butter
1 fluid ounce bourbon whiskey, or more to taste
1 tablespoon orange juice
 large orange, finely zested
1 cup confectioners sugar
Directions
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C. Grease and flour a 10-inch 12-cup fluted tube pan such as Bundt.
Combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder, salt, allspice, and ginger in a medium bowl.
Beat sugar, eggs, oil, and vanilla extract together in a separate bowl until slightly lightened in color. Add carrots; stir to coat. Fold in flour mixture with a rubber spatula or large spoon until just barely combined with some small clumps; dont use a hand mixer. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into center comes out mostly clean, 40 to 50 minutes. Cool in the pan on a wire rack, right-side up, for 15 minutes. Invert pan onto a plate and gently tap pan to remove cake. Cool completely.
While cake is cooling, whisk butter, bourbon, orange juice, and orange zest together in a small saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Boil about 1 minute. Off heat, add confectioners sugar, a little at a time, whisking until smooth before adding more and until glaze reaches desired consistency. Liberally spoon glaze over mostly cooled cake.
Cooks Notes:
Be sure to use medium-coarse grated carrots.
When zesting, be sure to only get the very surface of the orange rind and not the bitter white part pith beneath.
If the cake doesnt come out of the pan, place the pan, right-side up, in a 200 degrees F 93 degrees C oven for 3 to 5 minutes and try to remove again.
For a thicker glaze, add extra confectioners sugar.

Message:
Awesome Sweet Potato Casserole
Diane Thornton gave me this awesome sweet potato casserole recipe in the late 1980s in Jackson, Mississippi. I have made it each year since, and when I bring it to gatherings, people rave about it, so I bring it year after year. Some people say its more like a dessert than a side dish. All I know is its a standby for me and always gets a nod.
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 30 mins
Total Time: 50 mins
Servings: 16
Yield: 1 9x13-inch casserole
Ingredients
3 cups cooked mashed sweet potatoes
1 cup white sugar
1 8 ounce can crushed pineapple, drained
 14 ounce bag flaked coconut, or more to taste
 cup unsalted butter, melted
 cup milk
2 eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup firmly packed brown sugar
1 cup finely chopped pecans
 cup all-purpose flour
 cup unsalted butter, melted
Directions
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Beat sweet potatoes, white sugar, pineapple, coconut, 1/2 cup melted butter, milk, eggs, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until smooth; pour into the prepared pan and set aside. Combine brown sugar, pecans, flour, and 1/3 cup melted butter in a separate bowl; sprinkle over sweet potato mixture.

Diane Thornton gave me this awesome sweet potato casserole recipe in the late 1980s in Jackson, Mississippi. I have made it each year since, and when I bring it to gatherings, people rave about it, so I bring it year after year. Some people say its more like a dessert than a side dish. Ingredients

 14 ounce bag flaked coconut, or more to taste
 cup unsalted butter, melted
 cup milk
2 eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup firmly packed brown sugar
1 cup finely chopped pecans
 cup all-purpose flour
 cup unsalted butter, melted
Directions
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Combine brown sugar, pecans, flour, and 1/3 cup melted butter in a separate bowl; sprinkle over sweet potato mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbly and topping is browned, about 30 minutes.

I always use fresh sweet potatoes that I have baked in the oven ahead of time so they have plenty of time to cool. Message:
Homemade Soft Pretzels
Ingredients:
1  cups warm water 110F
1 packet 2  tsp active dry yeast
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp granulated sugar
4 cups all-purpose flour
2/3 cup baking soda for boiling
1 large egg yolk  1 tbsp water for egg wash
Coarse salt for topping
Directions:
Activate Yeast:
In a mixing bowl, combine the warm water and active dry yeast.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes until it becomes foamy.
Make Dough:
Add the salt and granulated sugar to the yeast mixture.
Gradually mix in the all-purpose flour until a dough begins to form.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 57 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let Dough Rise:
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise for about 1 hour or until it doubles in size.
Shape Pretzels:
Preheat your oven to 450F 230C.
Once the dough has risen, divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a long rope, then twist into a classic pretzel shape.
Baking Soda Bath:
In a large pot, bring 9 cups of water to a boil and add the baking soda.
Dip each pretzel into the boiling water for 30 seconds, ensuring they are fully submerged.
Use a slotted spatula to remove the pretzels and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Egg Wash & Salt:
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolk and 1 tablespoon of water to create an egg wash.
Brush the egg wash over the tops of the pretzels and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake:
Bake the pretzels in the preheated oven for 1215 minutes, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm with your favorite cheese dip, mustard, or enjoy plain for a soft and chewy snack! #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
Merry Christmas Petit Fours 
Ingredients
Cake
1 cup all-purpose flour 
1 cup granulated sugar 蓼
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
4 large eggs 讀
1/4 cup milk 拏
1 tsp vanilla extract 
1/4 tsp salt 蓼
Icing & Decorations
2 cups powdered sugar 
2-3 tbsp milk or water 拏
Red and green food coloring 
Edible glitter, holiday sprinkles, or edible pearls 
Melted chocolate or royal icing for detailed decorations 
Instructions
Prepare the Cake
Preheat oven to 350F 175C and line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment paper 六.
In a bowl, cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition 籠.
Mix in milk, vanilla, flour, and salt until smooth and combined .
Pour batter into the prepared pan, spreading evenly. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean . Let the cake cool completely.
Cut the Cake
Once cooled, remove the cake from the pan and trim the edges for a neat look. Cut into 1-inch squares for classic petit fours .
Prepare the Icing
In a bowl, mix powdered sugar with milk or water until smooth and pourable. Divide into separate bowls and tint with red and green food coloring for a festive palette .
Dip & Decorate
Dip each cake square into the icing or drizzle it over for a light coating. Let excess drip off and place on a rack to set.
Decorate with edible glitter, sprinkles, or add designs with melted chocolate or royal icing .
Set & Serve
Allow the icing to fully set before serving these adorable, festive petit fours. Perfect for holiday gatherings! 
#ChristmasPetitFours #HolidayTreats

Message:
Homemade Chocolate-Covered Ice Cream Bars 
Ingredients:
Vanilla ice cream or your favorite flavor
Melting chocolate milk, dark, or white
Optional toppings:
Crushed nuts 
Crushed cookies 
Sprinkles 
Drizzle e.g., white chocolate or caramel
Popsicle sticks
Instructions:
Shape the Ice Cream Bars:
Scoop ice cream into molds or shape into bars by hand.
Insert a popsicle stick into each bar.
Freeze until firm, about 23 hours.
Melt the Chocolate:
Place the chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl.
Heat in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until smooth.
Coat the Bars:
Remove frozen bars from the freezer.
Dip each bar into the melted chocolate, ensuring a full coat.
Add Toppings:
Before the chocolate hardens, sprinkle with toppings of your choice nuts, cookies, sprinkles, etc..
Optional: Drizzle with contrasting melted chocolate or caramel.
Freeze Again:
Place the coated bars on a parchment-lined tray.
Freeze for an additional 30 minutes until chocolate is set.
Serve and Enjoy:
Take out, savor, and share your delicious homemade treats!
Tips for Success:
Add a teaspoon of coconut oil to the melted chocolate for a smoother finish.
Use a tall, narrow container for dipping to get an even coating.
Store in an airtight container for up to a week for ultimate freshness.
Enjoy creating and indulging in these irresistible frozen delights!

Who Needs Coffee When Youve Got THIS?   A slice of heaven with this Sour Cream Blueberry Coffee Cake! Perfect for brunch or just because you deserve a treat! 
Ingredients: 
- 1 cup sour cream
- 1/2 cup butter softened, ya know, like your heart when you smell this baking!
- 1 cup sugar sweeten up, baby!

- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract the secret sauce!

Message:
Burger Sliders
These tasty burger sliders are easy to make with savory ground beef and shredded Cheddar cheese, baked in mini rolls until warm and gooey. These sandwiches remind me of those delicious mini burgers at my favorite fast-food restaurant! They are a perfect appetizer to bring to a party!
Prep Time: 10 mins
Cook Time: 35 mins
Total Time: 45 mins
Servings: 24
Yield: 24 sliders
Ingredients
cooking spray
2 pounds ground beef
1 1.25 ounce envelope onion soup mix
2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese
 cup mayonnaise
24 dinner rolls, split
 cup sliced pickles Optional
Directions
Gather the ingredients.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F 175 degrees C. Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil and grease with cooking spray. Grease a sheet of aluminum foil; set aside.
Mix ground beef and onion soup mix together in a large skillet; cook and stir over medium-high heat until beef is crumbly and evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard any excess grease.
Remove the skillet from heat; stir in Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise.
Place roll bottoms on the prepared baking sheet. Spread beef mixture onto each bottom; cover with bread roll tops. Cover sliders with the prepared sheet of aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until burger sliders are heated through and cheese is melted, about 30 minutes.
Serve sliders with sliced pickles and enjoy!

Message:
Pan-Seared Mediterranean Cod in Tomato Basil Sauce 
Ingredients 
For the Cod:
4 cod fillets about 6 oz each
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/2 tsp paprika
For the Tomato Basil Sauce:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 small onion, finely chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 14 oz can crushed tomatoes
1/4 cup dry white wine optional
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp red chili flakes optional for heat
1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/4 cup Kalamata olives, sliced optional
1 tbsp capers optional
Instructions 
Prepare the cod: Pat the cod fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Sear the cod: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the cod fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the fillets and set aside.
Make the sauce: In the same skillet, add 2 tbsp olive oil. Sauté the onions until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.
Simmer the tomatoes: Stir in the crushed tomatoes, white wine if using, oregano, and chili flakes. Season with salt and pepper. Let the sauce simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add final touches: Stir in the fresh basil, olives, and capers, if using. Simmer for another 2 minutes.
Combine: Return the cod fillets to the skillet, spooning the sauce over the fish. Let it warm through for 2-3 minutes.
Serve: Serve the cod with the tomato basil sauce over a bed of rice, quinoa, or alongside crusty bread.
Enjoy this light, flavorful Mediterranean dish! 
#HealthyEats #NovasSpiceLab

Message:
Philly Cheesesteak Sliders
A quick and easy take on a Philly steak and cheese sandwich.
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 10 mins
Total Time: 30 mins
Servings: 12
Yield: 12 sliders
Ingredients
1 pound sirloin steak, cut into 1/8-inch strips
1 pinch meat tenderizer
1 splash olive oil
1 onion, thinly sliced
 cup minced bell pepper
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, or to taste
ground black pepper to taste
2 cups canned sliced mushrooms
1 12 count package Hawaiian-style dinner rolls, sliced in half
8 slices provolone cheese
Directions
Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the ovens broiler. Mix steak and meat tenderizer together in a bowl.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper; cook and stir until slightly softened, about 3 minutes. Message:
Pizza Sliders
These cheesy pizza sliders capture all the delicious flavors of pizza, perfectly complemented by the slight sweetness of Hawaiian rolls. While pulling them apart can get a little messy, the taste more than makes up for it! Once you master the method, the possibilities for variations are endlessget creative and have fun experimenting!
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 20 mins
Total Time: 40 mins
Servings: 12
Yield: 12 sliders
Ingredients
cooking spray
1  cups finely pre-shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
1 cup finely pre-shredded Italian cheese blend
 cup finely chopped fresh basil
 teaspoon black pepper
2 teaspoons dried Italian seasoning, divided
1  cups pizza sauce
2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato pesto
1 12 count package Hawaiian sweet rolls
 cup thinly sliced pepperoni
2 tablespoons unsalted butter
1 tablespoon grated Parmesan cheese
 teaspoon garlic powder
Directions
Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F 190 degrees C. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment, and place a cooling rack on baking sheet. Spray rack with cooking spray.
Stir mozzarella, Italian cheese blend, basil, pepper, and 1  teaspoons of the Italian seasoning together in a small bowl until combined. Set aside.
Stir pizza sauce and pesto together in another small bowl. Set aside.
Without separating the individual rolls, cut the entire slab of rolls in half horizontally using a serrated knife. Place bottom layer of rolls on the prepared baking sheet. Set top layer of rolls aside.
Sprinkle bottom layer of rolls evenly with half of the cheese mixture; top evenly with half of pepperoni and half of the sauce. Repeat layers once.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese melts, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine butter, Parmesan, garlic powder, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning in a small saucepan; cook over medium, stirring occasionally, until butter melts, 1 to 2 minutes. Set aside.
Remove rolls from oven, and add top layer of rolls; brush top of rolls evenly with butter mixture. Return to preheated oven, and bake until rolls are golden brown and crisp, about 5 minutes.
Separate the rolls, and serve immediately.
Variations to try:
Sausage: Prepare recipe as directed, substituting 3/4 cup cooked, crumbled Italian sausage for pepperoni.
Meat Lovers: Prepare recipe as directed, reducing pepperoni to 1/4 cup, and adding 3 oz. thin deli ham slices and 1/4 cup cooked crumbled Italian sausage.
Veggie: Prepare recipe as directed, substituting 1 cup mixed sauteed peppers, onions, and mushrooms for pepperoni.
BBQ Chicken: Prepare recipe as directed, substituting 1 cup barbecue sauce for pizza sauce and sundried tomato pesto. Substitute 1 cup chopped or shredded rotisserie chicken for pepperoni.

Message:
Homemade Chocolate-Covered Ice Cream Bars 
Ingredients:
- Vanilla ice cream  or any preferred flavor
- Melting chocolate  milk, dark, or white
- Crushed nuts 
- Crushed cookies 
- Sprinkles 
- Popsicle sticks 蝹
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Ice Cream Bars:
- Scoop vanilla ice cream into molds or form into bar shapes using a spoon. 
- Insert a popsicle stick into each bar and freeze until solid around 2-3 hours. 
2. Melt the Chocolate:
- In a microwave-safe bowl, melt your chocolate in 30-second intervals, stirring in between until smooth. 
3. Dip the Bars:
- Once frozen solid, dip each ice cream bar into the melted chocolate, making sure to coat it fully. 
4. Add Toppings:
- Before the chocolate sets, sprinkle crushed nuts, cookies, or sprinkles on top of the bars. 
- For some variation, you can drizzle white chocolate or add crushed candies like toffee. 
5. Refreeze:
- Place the chocolate-dipped bars back in the freezer to harden for another 30 minutes.

Cinnamon Honey Butter Sweet Potato Cornbread 泌
Ingredients:
For the Sweet Potato Cornbread:
- 1 cup mashed sweet potatoes 
- 1 cup yellow cornmeal 
- 1 cup all-purpose flour 
- 1/4 cup honey 
- 1 tablespoon baking powder 
- 1/2 teaspoon salt 蓼
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 
- 2 large eggs 
- 1/2 cup melted butter 杻
- 1 cup buttermilk 拏
For the Cinnamon Honey Butter:
- 1/4 cup honey 
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 
- 1/2 cup softened butter 杻
Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 375F 190C and grease or line your baking dish with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon.
3. In another bowl, combine mashed sweet potatoes, eggs, melted butter, buttermilk, and honey. Stir until smooth.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
6. While the cornbread bakes, mix together honey, cinnamon, and softened butter in a small bowl.
7. Once the cornbread is done, let it cool slightly and serve with a dollop of cinnamon honey butter on top.
Enjoy your delicious sweet potato cornbread with cinnamon honey butter!
