Message:
Big Mac Wraps
Ingredients:
For the Special Sauce:
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 tablespoons finely chopped dill pickles
1 tablespoon yellow mustard
1 teaspoon white vinegar
1 teaspoon paprika
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon onion powder
For the Wraps:
1 pound lean ground beef
1/2 cup finely chopped onion
Salt and pepper, to taste
4 large flour tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
Dill pickle slices optional
1 tablespoon olive oil
Directions:
Step 1: Prepare the Special Sauce
In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, chopped pickles, mustard, vinegar, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Stir until smooth and creamy. Cover and refrigerate while you prepare the rest of the dish.
Step 2: Cook the Beef
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add the ground beef, breaking it into crumbles, and season with salt and pepper. Cook until browned and fully cooked. Drain any excess grease.
Step 3: Assemble the Wraps
Slightly warm the tortillas for easy folding.
Spread a generous layer of the special sauce on each tortilla.
Top with a portion of the cooked ground beef, followed by shredded lettuce, cheddar cheese, and pickle slices if using.
Step 4: Wrap and Serve
Fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly to form a wrap.
Slice in half if desired and serve immediately.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 15 minutes  Total Time: 25 minutes
Servings: 4 wraps  Calories: Approximately 350 kcal per wrap

Message:
凜 Potato And Cabbage Soup 凜
 Difficulty: Easy  
 Servings: 6  
 Total Time: 60 minutes  
 Preparation Time: 15 minutes  
 Cooking Time: 45 minutes  
This soup reminds me of cozy family dinners, and its a great way to warm up on chilly nights!
Ingredients:
- 8 ounces bacon, sliced into 1-inch pieces optional
- 1 cup diced onion
- 1 cup diced carrots optional
- 1 cup diced celery optional
- 2 large leeks, cleaned and thinly sliced
- 2 green onions, chopped into whites and greens
- 1/2 teaspoon caraway seeds
- 6 cups chicken or vegetable broth
- 2 cups chopped cabbage
- 2 pounds potatoes, cut into bite-sized chunks
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 1 tablespoon white vinegar optional
- 1 tablespoon chopped parsley optional
- Salt and pepper to taste
Directions:
1 - In a large pot, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Once done, set it aside and leave about two tablespoons of the bacon grease in the pot.  
2 - Add the diced onion, carrots, celery, leeks, and the white parts of the green onions into the pot. Sauté until they soften, which should take about 10-15 minutes.  
3 - Stir in the caraway seeds, broth, cabbage, and potatoes. Bring everything to a boil.  
4 - Once boiling, lower the heat and let it simmer until the potatoes are nice and tender, roughly 20 minutes.  
5 - Turn off the heat and mix in the sour cream, vinegar, parsley, and cooked bacon. Add the green parts of the green onions too. Season with salt and pepper to your liking, and enjoy!

Message:
Homemade Soft Pretzels
Ingredients:
1  cups warm water 110F
1 packet 2  tsp active dry yeast
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp granulated sugar
4 cups all-purpose flour
2/3 cup baking soda for boiling
1 large egg yolk  1 tbsp water for egg wash
Coarse salt for topping
Directions:
Activate Yeast:
In a mixing bowl, combine the warm water and active dry yeast.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes until it becomes foamy.
Make Dough:
Add the salt and granulated sugar to the yeast mixture.
Gradually mix in the all-purpose flour until a dough begins to form.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 57 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let Dough Rise:
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise for about 1 hour or until it doubles in size.
Shape Pretzels:
Preheat your oven to 450F 230C.
Once the dough has risen, divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a long rope, then twist into a classic pretzel shape.
Baking Soda Bath:
In a large pot, bring 9 cups of water to a boil and add the baking soda.
Dip each pretzel into the boiling water for 30 seconds, ensuring they are fully submerged.
Use a slotted spatula to remove the pretzels and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Egg Wash & Salt:
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolk and 1 tablespoon of water to create an egg wash.
Brush the egg wash over the tops of the pretzels and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake:
Bake the pretzels in the preheated oven for 1215 minutes, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm with your favorite cheese dip, mustard, or enjoy plain for a soft and chewy snack! #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

1 packet 2  tsp active dry yeast
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp granulated sugar
4 cups all-purpose flour
2/3 cup baking soda for boiling
1 large egg yolk  1 tbsp water for egg wash
Coarse salt for topping
Directions:
Activate Yeast:
In a mixing bowl, combine the warm water and active dry yeast.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes until it becomes foamy.
Make Dough:
Add the salt and granulated sugar to the yeast mixture.
Gradually mix in the all-purpose flour until a dough begins to form.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 57 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let Dough Rise:
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise for about 1 hour or until it doubles in size.
Shape Pretzels:
Preheat your oven to 450F 230C.
Once the dough has risen, divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a long rope, then twist into a classic pretzel shape.
Baking Soda Bath:
In a large pot, bring 9 cups of water to a boil and add the baking soda.
Dip each pretzel into the boiling water for 30 seconds, ensuring they are fully submerged.
Use a slotted spatula to remove the pretzels and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Egg Wash & Salt:
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolk and 1 tablespoon of water to create an egg wash.
Brush the egg wash over the tops of the pretzels and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake:
Bake the pretzels in the preheated oven for 1215 minutes, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm with your favorite cheese dip, mustard, or enjoy plain for a soft and chewy snack! #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Thick, Chocolate Chip Cookies
Ingredients:
2  cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
1 cup unsalted butter, softened
 cup brown sugar, packed
 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
Directions:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, cream together the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop cookie dough onto the prepared baking sheet in large spoonfuls.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until the edges are golden, but the center is still soft.
Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

拾 Got Beef? Dive into this Cheesy Taco Pasta! 燎
Ingredients:  
- 3 pounds of ground beef  
- 1 onion, chopped who doesnt love a good tear, right?  
- 2 cloves garlic, minced bring on the flavor!  
- 1 packet taco seasoning spice it up!  
- 1 can diced tomatoes for that saucy goodness  
- 1 cup beef broth liquid happiness  
- 2 cups elbow macaroni carbs, we love you!  
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese more cheese, please!  
- Salt and pepper to taste dont be shy!

Now, lets get cooking, shall we?  
1. Grab a large pot and get that ground beef sizzling over medium heat. Chop-chop on the onion and smash-smash on the garlic, then toss em in until the onion looks all see-through and yummy.  
2. Time to spice things up! Add the taco seasoning and give it a minute to get friendly with all that beef.  
3. Pop in the diced tomatoes and beef broth, and crank that heat to boil. Lets get this party started!  
4. Stir in the elbow macaroni like a pro, then drop the heat to a simmer. Cook it up until the macaroni is tenderabout 10-12 minutes. Go do a little dance in the meantime!  
5. When its all cooked up, stir in the melted cheesy goodness and watch your worries melt away.  
6. Sprinkle in some salt and pepper like a seasoned chef, and taste-test!  
7. Serve it hot, topped with those fancy green onions and watch everyone dig in!
Preparing time: 10 mins  
Cooking time: 20 mins  
Servings: 6-8 hungry folks  
Easy and oh-so-delicious! You might just find this becoming your new go-to dish. Enjoy the cheesy goodness! 襤

Message:
Hashbrown Chicken Casserole - Dont LOSE this Recipe 
Ingredients:
3 cups cooked chicken, shredded or diced rotisserie chicken works great
1 32 oz bag frozen hashbrowns, thawed
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1 10.5 oz can cream of chicken soup
1 cup sour cream
1/2 cup whole milk
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
1 small onion, finely chopped
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
1/2 teaspoon paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
1 cup crushed buttery crackers or breadcrumbs for topping
2 tablespoons melted butter for topping
Directions:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, thawed hashbrowns, shredded cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, milk, melted butter, chopped onion, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture into the prepared baking dish, spreading it out evenly.
In a small bowl, mix the crushed crackers or breadcrumbs with the 2 tablespoons of melted butter. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbly around the edges.
Let the casserole cool for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 50 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour 5 minutes
Kcal: 420 kcal per serving  Servings: 8 servings
Tips:
For extra crunch, add crispy fried onions to the topping.
Substitute Greek yogurt for sour cream for a lighter option.

Message:
Big Mac Sloppy Joes 
Ingredients:
Sloppy Joe Mixture:
1 lb ground beef
1 small onion, finely chopped
1/2 cup ketchup
2 tbsp mustard
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
Salt and pepper to taste
Special Sauce:
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp French dressing
1 tbsp sweet pickle relish
1 tbsp finely minced onion
1 tsp white vinegar
1 tsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
Sandwich:
4 sesame seed hamburger buns
8 slices of cheddar cheese
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/2 cup dill pickle slices
Directions:
Prepare the Sloppy Joe Mixture:
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef and chopped onion until the beef is browned and the onion is tender. Drain excess fat.
Stir in ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture is thick and flavorful.
Make the Special Sauce:
In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, French dressing, sweet pickle relish, minced onion, white vinegar, sugar, and salt. Mix until smooth and set aside.
Assemble the Sloppy Joes:
Preheat your oven to broil. Split the hamburger buns and place them on a baking sheet, cut side up. Toast under the broiler for 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Place a slice of cheddar cheese on the bottom half of each toasted bun.
Spoon a generous amount of the Sloppy Joe mixture over the cheese.
Add another slice of cheddar cheese on top of the Sloppy Joe mixture.
Top with shredded lettuce and dill pickle slices.
Drizzle with the special sauce.
Place the top half of the bun on top.

Message:
Irresistible Mini Chocolate Peanut Butter Pies #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes 
Introduction
These mini chocolate peanut butter pies are a heavenly treat that combines the creamy goodness of peanut butter with the luxurious taste of chocolate. Originating from the classic American dessert traditions, this recipe brings together the best of both worlds. Whether youre making these for a special occasion or just to satisfy a sweet craving, these mini pies are sure to impress.
Ingredients
To prepare this comforting recipe for mini chocolate peanut butter pies, youll need:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/2 cup butter, melted
1 cup creamy peanut butter
1/2 cup powdered sugar
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/2 cup heavy cream for chocolate ganache
1 tsp vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
Chocolate chips for garnish
Optional substitutions:
Use gluten-free graham crackers to make the crust gluten-free.
Substitute dairy-free butter and cream cheese for a lactose-free version.
How to Make Mini Chocolate Peanut Butter Pies
Follow these steps to create your own delicious mini chocolate peanut butter pies:
Prepare the Crust: In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press mixture into the bottoms and sides of a muffin tin lined with cupcake liners. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to set.
Make the Filling: In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla extract, and mix until well combined.
Whip the Cream: In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture.
Fill the Crusts: Spoon the peanut butter filling into the chilled crusts, smoothing the tops with a spatula.
Prepare the Ganache: In a small saucepan, heat the 1/2 cup heavy cream until just simmering. Remove from heat and add the chocolate chips, stirring until melted and smooth.
Top with Ganache: Pour the chocolate ganache over the peanut butter filling, spreading evenly.
Chill and Serve: Refrigerate the pies for at least 2 hours, or until set. Garnish with additional chocolate chips before serving.
Helpful Tips
Ensure the cream cheese is softened for a smoother filling.
Chill the crusts thoroughly before adding the filling to prevent crumbling.
Cooking Tips
Enhance Flavor: Add a pinch of sea salt to the ganache for a salted chocolate twist.
Equipment: Using a stand mixer for whipping cream can save time and effort.

Crab Rangoon Wontons
Ingredients:
5 ounces crab meat, drained 1 can or substitute with fresh or packaged crab
4 ounces cream cheese, softened
1 green onion, finely sliced
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoon soy sauce optional
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
18 wonton wrappers
Oil for frying
Directions:
Preheat 1 inch of oil in a deep skillet or pot to 325F over medium heat.
In a small mixing bowl, gently combine crab meat, cream cheese, green onion, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce if using, and garlic powder until well mixed.
Lay out 3 wonton wrappers at a time on a clean surface. Place 2 teaspoons of the filling in the center of each wrapper.
Dab the edges of the wrappers with water and fold opposite corners together to form a triangle. Wet the tips of the triangle and fold them inward to seal securely. Repeat until all filling is used.
Carefully drop the prepared wontons into the preheated oil, frying in batches for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the wontons with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Description:
Crab Rangoon Wontons
Ingredients:

4 ounces cream cheese, softened

18 wonton wrappers

Directions:

Honey Garlic Butter Roasted Carrots
Ingredients:
2 pounds carrots, washed and peeled or unpeeled
1/3 cup butter
3 tablespoons honey
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/4-1/2 teaspoon salt plus more for seasoning
1 pinch cracked black pepper
2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped

Message:
Cajun Shrimp Bake is a flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines tender shrimp, smoky turkey sausage, and hearty vegetables with bold Cajun spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a casual gathering, this recipe is packed with vibrant flavors and satisfying textures. Serve it fresh out of the oven with a sprinkle of parsley and a squeeze of lemon for a taste of Louisiana-style cooking.
Ingredients
Main Ingredients:
4 turkey sausages, sliced
1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined
4 red potatoes, quartered
2 pieces corn, quartered
2 tablespoons oil, divided
1 tablespoon butter, cubed
4 cloves garlic, minced

For the Cajun Spice Mix:
2 teaspoons garlic powder
2  teaspoons paprika
1  teaspoons dried oregano
1 teaspoon onion powder
1  teaspoons dried thyme
 teaspoon red pepper flakes
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
2 teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon pepper
Optional Garnishes:
Fresh parsley, chopped
Lemon wedges, for garnish
Instructions
Step 1:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C.
Step 2:
Prepare the Cajun spice mix by combining garlic powder, paprika, dried oregano, onion powder, dried thyme, red pepper flakes, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Mix well and set aside.
Step 3:
In a large baking dish, toss together the quartered red potatoes, corn pieces, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tablespoon of oil, and  tablespoon of the Cajun spice mix. Dot the mixture with small cubes of butter for added richness.
Step 4:
Place the baking dish in the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes, stirring halfway through to ensure even cooking.
Step 5:
Meanwhile, in a separate bowl, combine the sliced turkey sausage, shrimp, remaining minced garlic, 1 tablespoon of oil, and  tablespoon of the Cajun spice mix. Toss until everything is evenly coated.
Step 6:
After 25 minutes, remove the baking dish from the oven and add the sausage and shrimp mixture to the potatoes and corn. Stir gently to combine all the ingredients.
Step 7:
Return the baking dish to the oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and fully cooked, the sausage is heated through, and the vegetables are tender.
Step 8:
Sprinkle the dish with fresh parsley for a pop of color and garnish with lemon wedges for a zesty finish. Serve hot and enjoy!
Variations of Cajun Shrimp Bake
Seafood Alternatives: Replace the shrimp with scallops or chunks of white fish like cod for a different seafood twist.
Vegetarian Option: Omit the shrimp and sausage, and add more vegetables such as bell peppers, zucchini, or mushrooms. Use a plant-based butter substitute.
Spice Level Adjustment: Reduce the cayenne pepper and red pepper flakes for a milder version or double them for an extra kick.
Cooking Notes
Make sure the potatoes are cut into equal-sized pieces to ensure even cooking.
Fresh or frozen shrimp can be used, but if using frozen, thaw and pat them dry before tossing with the spice mix.
Use pre-cooked turkey sausage for faster preparation or raw sausage for a juicier result.
Serving Suggestions
This Cajun Shrimp Bake is a meal in itself, but it pairs wonderfully with crusty bread or a side of white rice to soak up the delicious juices. A simple green salad on the side adds freshness and balance to the meal. #recipes #recipereels #recipeideas #recipeshare #recipeoftheday #recipe

Message:
Hawaiian Pineapple Carrot Cream Cake
Hello dear readers! Today, Im thrilled to share with you a heartwarming recipe thats sure to delight your taste buds and warm your soul.
Introduction
Carrot cake is a timeless dessert beloved by many. Originating from the medieval carrot pudding, it has evolved into a moist, flavorful cake often topped with rich cream cheese frosting. This cakes unique blend of sweet carrots and spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger makes it truly special. One of my fondest memories is baking this cake with my grandmother, filling the house with its irresistible aroma.
Ingredients
To prepare this comforting Carrot Cake, youll need:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 cups granulated sugar
2 teaspoons baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
1 cup vegetable oil
4 large eggs
3 cups grated carrots
1 cup crushed pineapple, drained
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 cup chopped walnuts optional
Optional substitutions:
Use gluten-free flour for a gluten-free version.
Substitute coconut sugar for granulated sugar to lower the glycemic index.
Replace walnuts with raisins for a nut-free alternative.
How to Make Carrot Cake
Follow these steps to create your own delicious Carrot Cake:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger.
Combine Wet Ingredients: Add the vegetable oil and eggs to the dry ingredients, and mix until well combined.
Add Flavor: Stir in the grated carrots, crushed pineapple, vanilla extract, and chopped walnuts if using.
Divide Batter: Evenly distribute the batter between the prepared cake pans.
Bake: Place in the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cakes comes out clean.
Cool: Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn them out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Frost: Once the cakes are cool, frost them with cream cheese frosting.
Helpful Tips
Ensure your carrots are finely grated for a smoother cake texture.
Use room temperature eggs to help the batter mix more evenly.
Cooking Tips
Enhance Flavor: Add a teaspoon of orange zest to the batter for a citrusy twist.
Equipment: Use a food processor to quickly grate the carrots and mix the batter efficiently.
Serving Suggestions
Serve with a dollop of whipped cream or a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Pair with a hot cup of coffee or a glass of cold milk.
Nutritional Information
Nutritional Information per serving
Calories: 450 kcal
Carbohydrates: 58g
Protein: 5g
Fat: 23g
Saturated Fat: 5g
Polyunsaturated Fat: 7g
Monounsaturated Fat: 10g
Trans Fat: 0g
Cholesterol: 70mg
Sodium: 350mg
Potassium: 200mg
Fiber: 2g
Sugar: 38g
Vitamin A: 5000IU
Vitamin C: 3mg
Calcium: 50mg
Iron: 1.5mg
This cake is rich in Vitamin A due to the carrots, which are excellent for eye health. The walnuts provide healthy fats and protein, making this dessert a somewhat nutritious treat.
Storage and Leftovers
Refrigerate: Store the cake in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Reheat: To enjoy warm, microwave individual slices for about 15 seconds.
Frequently Asked Questions FAQs
Can I make this cake vegan?
Yes, substitute eggs with flax eggs 1 tbsp ground flaxseed mixed with 3 tbsp water per egg and use a dairy-free frosting.
What can I use instead of pineapple?
Applesauce is a great substitute that maintains moisture.
Why did my cake turn out dense?
Overmixing the batter can result in a dense cake. Mix until ingredients are just combined.
Related Recipes
Blueberry Lemon Sandwich Cookies
Pineapple Cheesecake 
Conclusion
I hope you enjoy baking and savoring this delightful Carrot Cake as much as I do. Please feel free to share your experiences and any creative twists you add to this recipe. Happy baking!

Message:
1. Blueberry Lemon Cheesecake
This refreshing Blueberry Lemon Cheesecake is the perfect balance of tangy lemon and sweet, juicy blueberries. Its creamy texture is complemented by the buttery graham cracker crust, making every bite an experience in itself.
Ingredients
For the crust:
1  cups graham cracker crumbs
 cup granulated sugar
 cup unsalted butter, melted
For the cheesecake filling:
3 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
3 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon lemon zest
 cup fresh lemon juice
1 cup sour cream
For the blueberry topping:
2 cups fresh blueberries
 cup granulated sugar
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
1 tablespoon cornstarch optional, for thicker topping
 cup water
Instructions
Make the crust: Preheat the oven to 325F 163C. In a bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a springform pan. Bake for 8-10 minutes, then let it cool while you prepare the filling.
Prepare the cheesecake filling: In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth and creamy. Add sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Beat until smooth and well combined. Add sour cream and mix until smooth.
Assemble the cheesecake: Pour the cheesecake filling over the cooled crust and spread it evenly with a spatula. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the center is set and slightly jiggles when gently shaken. Let it cool in the oven with the door slightly ajar for 1 hour. Then, transfer the cheesecake to the fridge and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Make the blueberry topping: In a saucepan, combine blueberries, sugar, lemon juice, water, and cornstarch if using. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes until the blueberries burst and the mixture thickens. Let it cool to room temperature.
Assemble the cheesecake: Once chilled, top the cheesecake with the blueberry topping. Garnish with additional fresh blueberries for a beautiful presentation.
This cheesecake is the perfect combination of tangy lemon and sweet blueberry, providing a refreshing dessert experience thats ideal for any celebration or casual gathering.

Message:
Decadent Layered Strawberry and Banana Cream Cake with a Crunchy Graham Cracker Crust and Chocolate Drizzle
This decadent cake is an embodiment of everything delightful about fruit-filled desserts. It combines the fresh, juicy flavors of strawberries and bananas with a rich, creamy filling, all on top of a crispy graham cracker crust. Topped with a luxurious chocolate drizzle, it provides the perfect balance of creamy, fruity, and crunchy textures.
Ingredients:
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
 cup melted butter
2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced
2 ripe bananas, sliced
2 cups heavy whipping cream
1 cup cream cheese, softened
 cup powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 cup chocolate drizzle
 cup crushed nuts for garnish
Instructions:
In a medium bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter until well combined. Press the mixture into the bottom of a 99-inch pan and chill for 20 minutes to set.
In a separate bowl, beat the softened cream cheese with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
In another bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form, then gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture.
Spread half of the cream mixture over the chilled crust, followed by a layer of sliced strawberries and bananas.
Add the remaining cream mixture on top, smoothing it out. Garnish with more strawberries, bananas, chocolate drizzle, and crushed nuts.
Chill for at least 2 hours or until set. Serve chilled for a refreshing and indulgent treat.
This dessert, with its simple yet luxurious layers, is perfect for a family gathering or any occasion where you want to impress your guests with a stunning, flavor-packed treat.

Message:
Black Forest Cheesecake Delight: A Decadent Dessert Dream
The Black Forest Cheesecake Delight is the epitome of indulgence. Combining the rich flavors of a chocolate cheesecake, a crunchy cookie crust, and the natural sweetness of cherries, this dessert is perfect for those who crave a luxurious treat. The combination of creamy cheesecake, a crisp base, and fruity toppings makes it the ideal dessert for a special celebration or holiday gathering.
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1  cups crushed chocolate cookies
1/4 cup melted butter
For the Cheesecake Filling:
3 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
3 large eggs
1/2 cup sour cream
1/4 cup cocoa powder
For the Topping:
1 can cherry pie filling
Whipped cream for garnish
Chocolate shavings for garnish
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Crust:
Preheat the oven to 325F 160C. Combine crushed chocolate cookies with melted butter and mix until well combined. Press the mixture into the bottom of a springform pan to form the crust.
2. Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in sour cream and cocoa powder until fully combined.
3. Bake the Cheesecake:
Pour the cheesecake mixture over the prepared crust in the springform pan. Bake for 55-60 minutes, until the center is set. Allow the cheesecake to cool in the oven with the door slightly ajar to prevent cracking.
4. Top and Chill:
Once cooled, spread cherry pie filling evenly on top of the cheesecake. Garnish with whipped cream swirls and chocolate shavings for an elegant finish. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight.
5. Serve and Enjoy:
Remove the cheesecake from the springform pan, slice, and serve. This rich, creamy cheesecake will surely be a hit at your next gathering.

Jello Cookies: A Fruity Twist on Classic Cookies
Jello cookies are a unique and colorful treat that infuses the bright, tangy flavor of Jello into a classic sugar cookie base. The key to these cookies delightful taste lies in the gelatin powder that gives them an added fruity punch and a vibrant hue. With only a handful of ingredients, Jello cookies are incredibly simple to make.
Ingredients:
1 cup butter softened
1 cup sugar
1 box 3 oz Jello any flavor
2 large eggs
3 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
Instructions:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
In a mixing bowl, cream the butter, sugar, and Jello powder together until fluffy and well-combined.
Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.

Message:
Sweet Strawberry Truffles: A Fruity Indulgence
Strawberries have always been a symbol of sweetness and joy, and when paired with the creamy texture of cream cheese and a rich chocolate coating, they become a truffle experience thats nothing short of delightful. These Sweet Strawberry Truffles are easy to prepare and bursting with flavor.
Ingredients:
1 cup fresh strawberries, pureed
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
2 cups powdered sugar
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1 cup chocolate chips, melted
Sprinkles or cocoa powder for coating
Directions:
Mix the Strawberry and Cream Cheese: Begin by blending fresh strawberry puree with softened cream cheese in a large bowl until smooth and creamy. This mixture forms the luscious base for your truffles.
Incorporate Dry Ingredients: Gradually add powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs to the mixture, folding them in until fully combined. The mixture should have a soft yet firm consistency, perfect for rolling into balls.
Chill for Firmness: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. This chilling time helps the mixture firm up, making it easier to roll into truffle shapes.
Form the Truffles: Once chilled, use your hands to roll small portions of the mixture into balls, about the size of a walnut.
Coat with Chocolate and Sprinkles: Melt the chocolate chips and dip each truffle ball into the chocolate, ensuring an even coat. Roll the truffles in sprinkles or cocoa powder for an extra touch of color and flavor.
Chill Again: Place the truffles on a parchment-lined baking sheet and refrigerate again to allow the chocolate coating to set.
With a prep time of just 15 minutes and a chilling time of 30 minutes, these truffles are the perfect treat when youre short on time but still want something exquisite.

Message:
Creamy Mushroom and Bacon Spaghetti
The Creamy Mushroom and Bacon Spaghetti is a perfect combination of indulgence and comfort, making it an ideal dish for a cozy evening at home. The creamy texture of the sauce, complemented by the smokiness of crispy bacon and the earthy flavor of mushrooms, creates a satisfying meal that is both rich and balanced.
Ingredients:
200 grams of spaghetti
2 tablespoons of olive oil or butter
200 grams of bacon, chopped
250 grams of mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves of garlic, minced
1 small onion, finely chopped
1 cup of heavy cream
1/2 cup of grated Parmesan cheese
Salt and pepper, to taste
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Instructions:
Cook the Pasta: Begin by boiling the spaghetti in salted water according to the package instructions until it reaches an al dente texture. Drain and set the pasta aside.
Cook the Bacon: In a large pan, heat the olive oil or butter over medium heat. Add the chopped bacon and cook until it turns crispy. Remove the bacon from the pan, set it aside, and leave the drippings in the pan for added flavor.
Sauté the Aromatics: In the same pan, add the minced garlic and finely chopped onion. Sauté for about 2-3 minutes until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Cook the Mushrooms: Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they become golden brown and tender.
Make the Creamy Sauce: Pour in the heavy cream and stir. Allow the mixture to come to a gentle simmer and cook for 3-4 minutes until it thickens.
Add the Cheese: Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese and continue mixing until it melts into the creamy sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the Pasta and Bacon: Add the cooked spaghetti and crispy bacon to the pan with the sauce. Toss everything together, ensuring that the pasta is evenly coated with the creamy sauce.
Garnish and Serve: Serve the pasta hot, garnished with freshly chopped parsley for a touch of color and flavor.
This dish serves 2-3 people and can be ready in just 30 minutes. Pair it with a light salad or some garlic bread for an even more satisfying meal.

Message:
Baked Salmon with the Best Marinade
Ingredients:
1 1/2 lb salmon fillet, cut into 4 pieces
2 Tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped
2 Tbsp olive oil
2 Tbsp fresh lemon juice
3 garlic cloves, minced or pressed
1/2 Tbsp Dijon mustard
1/2 tsp sea salt
1/8 tsp black pepper
1/2 lemon, sliced into 4 rings for garnish
Directions:
Preheat the oven to 450F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or foil.
Arrange the salmon fillets on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side down.
In a small bowl, mix parsley, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper.
Generously brush the marinade over the top and sides of the salmon fillets. Place a lemon slice on each piece.
Bake uncovered for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches an internal temperature of 145F.
Serve hot and enjoy.
Servings: 4 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipereels #recipeideas #recipes

Message:
Egg Rolls Recipe
Ingredients:
3 tablespoons olive oil
1 16-ounce package tri-color coleslaw mix
3 chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
Salt and pepper, to taste
1 16-ounce package egg roll wrappers
Vegetable oil for frying
Directions:
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the coleslaw mix for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Stir in shredded chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
Place an egg roll wrapper on a surface in a diamond shape. Add 2-3 tablespoons of the filling in the center.
Fold the bottom corner over the filling, tuck in the sides, and roll up tightly. Seal the top with water.
Heat vegetable oil to 350F 175C in a deep fryer or skillet.
Fry the egg rolls in batches, turning occasionally, for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Servings: 12-16 egg rolls

Message:
Oh my lord, the taste is so divine! Rich and delightful in every way!
Coconut Custard Pie
Ingredients
1 unbaked pie crust 9-inch
1 cup sweetened shredded coconut
1 cup whole milk
1 cup heavy cream
3 large eggs
 cup granulated sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 teaspoon salt
Directions
Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Prepare the Pie Crust: Place the unbaked pie crust into a 9-inch pie dish. Press the crust gently into the dish and crimp the edges. Set aside.
Toast the Coconut Optional: For a richer flavor, you can toast the shredded coconut. Spread it on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for about 5-7 minutes until lightly golden. Watch carefully to avoid burning.
Mix the Filling: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the milk, heavy cream, eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined.
Add Coconut: Stir in the shredded coconut toasted or untoasted into the mixture.
Pour into Crust: Pour the custard mixture into the prepared pie crust.
Bake: Place the pie in the preheated oven and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the custard is set and a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. The center might still be slightly jiggly, but it will set as it cools.
Cool: Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool completely on a wire rack. The pie will firm up as it cools.
Serve: Once cooled, slice and serve. You can top it with whipped cream or a sprinkle of extra toasted coconut if desired.
Advertisement
Variations & Tips
For a more indulgent version, you can mix in a handful of chocolate chips or a spoonful of cocoa powder to make a chocolate-coconut custard pie. If you have picky eaters, consider making mini pies in muffin tins for individual servings. You can also add a bit of zest by incorporating lime or lemon zest into the custard mixture for a citrusy twist. #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
My nana made this every year but I kept forgetting to write it down. So glad I found something that comes close to hers!.
Nanas Frozen Fruit Salad
Ingredients
- 1 8-ounce package cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 20-ounce can crushed pineapple, drained well
- 1 10-ounce package frozen strawberries or raspberries, slightly thawed and chopped
- 1 11-ounce can mandarin oranges, drained
- 1/2 cup chopped pecans
- 1/3 cup maraschino cherries, halved
- 2 ripe bananas, sliced
- Juice of 1 lemon
Directions
1. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until smooth and creamy.
2. Gently fold in the whipped cream until well combined.
3. Add the drained crushed pineapple, chopped strawberries, and mandarin oranges to the creamy mixture. Stir to incorporate the fruits evenly.
4. Incorporate the chopped pecans and halved maraschino cherries into the mixture, ensuring even distribution.
5. In a small bowl, toss the banana slices in the lemon juice to prevent browning. Then, gently fold the bananas into the salad mixture.
6. Spread the fruit salad evenly into a 9x13-inch pan. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours, or until firm.
7. To serve, remove from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes. Cut into squares and enjoy.
Variations & Tips
For a lighter version, you can substitute the cream cheese with a lower-fat or Neufchâtel cheese, and use a light whipped topping instead of heavy cream. To enhance the nutty flavor, toast the pecans beforehand. This dish is also beautifully adaptable - feel free to swap in other fruits depending on the season or your preference. Peaches, mangoes, or even a mix of berries can create delightful variations. If you are looking to add an extra dimension of flavor, a splash of rum or an orange-flavored liqueur can weave in a sophisticated note.

Message:
The moment I saw this dessert, I knew it was going to be something special. And guess what? It totally exceeded my expectations!.
Lemon Blueberry Delight
Ingredients
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
1 cup fresh blueberries
1/4 cup sugar
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1/4 cup water
1 cup sweetened condensed milk
1/2 cup lemon juice
1 tablespoon lemon zest
3 egg yolks
1 cup heavy whipping cream
2 tablespoons powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Directions
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
In a medium bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch pie pan to form the crust. Bake for 10 minutes, then let it cool.
In a small saucepan, combine the blueberries, 1/4 cup sugar, cornstarch, and water. Cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens and the blueberries burst, about 5 minutes. Let it cool slightly.
Spread the blueberry mixture evenly over the cooled crust.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and egg yolks until smooth.
Pour the lemon mixture over the blueberry layer and bake for 15 minutes, or until the lemon layer is set. Let it cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until soft peaks form.

Message:
Cinnamon Roll Muffins 療
Ingredients:
For the Muffins:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 cup granulated sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1/3 cup unsalted butter, melted
3/4 cup buttermilk
1 large egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
For the Cinnamon Filling:
1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
2 tsp ground cinnamon
3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted
For the Glaze:
1 cup powdered sugar
2-3 tbsp milk
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Directions:
For the Muffins:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease it lightly.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together the melted butter, buttermilk, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, stirring until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
For the Cinnamon Filling:
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter until it forms a thick paste.
Assemble the Muffins:
Fill each muffin liner halfway with the batter. Add about 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon filling in the center of each. Top with the remaining batter, filling each liner about 3/4 full.
Swirl the cinnamon filling into the batter using a toothpick or skewer to create a marbled effect.
Bake for 15-18 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the muffins cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
For the Glaze:
In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled muffins.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Baking Time: 18 minutes  Total Time: 33 minutes
Kcal: 210 kcal per muffin approx.  Servings: 12 muffins
Tips:
For extra indulgence, add a pinch of nutmeg to the cinnamon filling for a warm, spiced flavor.
These muffins are best enjoyed fresh, but you can reheat them in the microwave for 10 seconds to revive their softness! #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels

Cheesy Stuffed Shells 燎
Ingredients:
 20 large pasta shells
燎 2 cups ricotta cheese
燎 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
燎 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped or 1 tbsp dried basil
龍 2 cloves garlic, minced
 4 cups marinara sauce
蓼 Salt and pepper, to taste
杻 1 tbsp olive oil for greasing the pan
Instructions:
1 Preheat the oven to 375F 190C and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil.
2 Cook the pasta shells: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta shells according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside, laying them flat on a baking sheet to prevent sticking.
3 Prepare the filling: In a large bowl, combine the ricotta, 1 cup of mozzarella, Parmesan, basil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir until well mixed.
4 Stuff the shells: Once the pasta shells are cool enough to handle, fill each shell with a generous amount of the cheese mixture.

Message:
Maryland Crab Cakes
Ingredients:
For the Crab Cakes:
1 large egg
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley or 2 teaspoons dried
2 teaspoons Dijon mustard
2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoon Old Bay seasoning or up to 1 1/2 teaspoons for extra spice
1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice plus more for serving
1/8 teaspoon salt
1 pound fresh lump crab meat
2/3 cup saltine cracker crumbs about 1718 crackers
Optional for Extra Flavor:
2 tablespoons melted butter
Directions:
Preheat the oven to 450F. Generously grease a rimmed baking sheet with butter or nonstick spray, or line it with a silicone baking mat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg, mayonnaise, parsley, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, Old Bay seasoning, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the crab meat and cracker crumbs to the bowl. Gently fold with a silicone spatula or spoon, being careful not to break apart the crab meat.
Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day.
Using a 1/2-cup measuring cup, portion the crab cake mixture into 6 mounds on the baking sheet. Do not flatten the mounds. Use your hands or a spoon to compact each crab cake to ensure they hold together.
Optional: Brush the tops of the crab cakes with melted butter for added flavor.
Bake for 12-14 minutes, or until the tops and edges are lightly browned.
Drizzle with fresh lemon juice before serving.
Servings: 6

Message:
Hot Fudge Chocolate Pudding Cake
헜헻헴헿헲헱헶헲헻혁혀
For the Cake Batter:
1 cup 125g all-purpose flour
3/4 cup 150g granulated sugar
1/4 cup 30g unsweetened cocoa powder
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup 120ml milk
1/4 cup 60g unsalted butter, melted
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
For the Chocolate Topping:
1/2 cup 100g packed brown sugar
1/4 cup 30g unsweetened cocoa powder
1 3/4 cups 420ml hot water
헜헻혀혁헿혂헰혁헶헼헻혀:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and lightly grease a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Add milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract to the dry mixture. Stir until smooth and fully combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and spread it evenly.
In a separate bowl, mix brown sugar and cocoa powder for the topping.
Evenly sprinkle the topping mixture over the cake batter.
Carefully pour hot water over the top without stirring, creating the fudgy sauce layer beneath the cake.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is firm and the edges have slightly pulled away from the dish.
Let the cake cool for 10-15 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken.
Scoop warm cake into bowls, ensuring to include some of the rich chocolate sauce. Serve as-is, or top with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream for an extra treat!
Enjoy!

Message:
Mexican Beef Enchiladas
Ingredients:
For the Sauce:
1 pound 90% lean ground beef
Heaping  teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons vegetable oil
1 medium white onion, finely chopped
1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and minced
2 cloves garlic, finely chopped
3 tablespoons chili powder
1 teaspoon ground cumin
 teaspoon dried oregano
3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
1 8-oz can tomato sauce
2 cups chicken broth
For the Enchiladas:
2 tablespoons vegetable oil, for brushing the tortillas
10 6- to 7-inch yellow corn tortillas
3 cups shredded Mexican blend cheese
Directions:
Mix the ground beef with baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and jalapeño, cooking for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano, cooking for 1 minute. Stir in flour and cook for another minute.
Gradually pour in chicken broth and tomato sauce, stirring until smooth. Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened, then remove from heat.
In another skillet, cook the seasoned ground beef over medium heat, breaking it into crumbles. Drain excess fat and mix in 1 cup of the prepared sauce.
Preheat oven to 375F 190C.
Brush both sides of the tortillas with vegetable oil and warm them until pliable.
Spoon 2-3 tablespoons of the beef mixture onto each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the rolled tortillas and sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Servings: 6-8

Message:
Pineapple Cowboy Candy 鸞
Ingredients:
- 3 cups of diced fresh pineapple 
- 1 cup of thinly sliced jalapeño peppers 
- 1 cup of apple cider vinegar 
- 2 cups of granulated sugar 籠
- 2 tablespoons of lemon juice 
- 1 teaspoon of mustard seeds 
- 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder 
- 1 tablespoon of grated ginger 
- 2 cloves of finely chopped garlic 龍
Instructions:
1. Combine the apple cider vinegar, granulated sugar, lemon juice, mustard seeds, turmeric powder, grated ginger, and chopped garlic in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the sugar dissolves completely 北.
2. Add the diced pineapple and sliced jalapeños to the saucepan. Simmer over medium heat for about 20 minutes, or until the pineapple softens and the liquid thickens to a syrupy consistency .
3. Sterilize jars and lids by boiling them in water for at least 5 minutes while the mixture cooks 龎.
4. Spoon the hot mixture into the sterilized jars, leaving a little space at the top. Clean the rims, secure the lids, and process the jars in a hot water bath for about 10 minutes .
5. Remove the jars from the bath and let them cool completely. Check the seals before storing in a cool, dark place .
Enjoy this sweet and spicy treat with your favorite dishes!

Message:
Bourbon Chicken with Broccoli
Ingredients:
For the Bourbon Chicken:
2 lbs boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
1-2 tablespoons olive oil
1 garlic clove, crushed
 teaspoon ginger
 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
 cup apple juice
 cup light brown sugar
2 tablespoons ketchup
1 tablespoon cider vinegar
 cup water
 cup soy sauce
For the Broccoli:
2 cups broccoli florets, steamed
Directions:
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook for 5-7 minutes until browned and fully cooked.
Add the crushed garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper flakes to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
In a bowl, whisk together the apple juice, light brown sugar, ketchup, cider vinegar, water, and soy sauce.
Pour the sauce over the chicken in the skillet. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce slightly thickens.
Serve the bourbon chicken over steamed broccoli florets.
Servings: 4-6

Message:
Mini Cinnamon Rolls with Syrup
Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
1 tbsp baking powder
3/4 cup milk
4 tbsp unsalted butter melted
1/3 cup brown sugar
2 tsp ground cinnamon
For the Syrup:
1/2 cup maple syrup or honey
2 tbsp butter
Instructions:
1. Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 375F 190C and grease a baking dish.
2. Make Dough: In a bowl, mix flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder. Add milk and 2 tbsp melted butter. Mix until a dough forms.
3. Roll Dough: Roll the dough on a floured surface into a rectangle about 1/4 inch thick.
4. Add Filling: Spread the remaining 2 tbsp of melted butter over the dough. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon, then sprinkle evenly on top.
5. Shape Rolls: Roll the dough tightly into a log and slice into 1-inch pieces. Arrange in the greased baking dish.
6. Bake: Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
7. Make Syrup: In a small saucepan, heat maple syrup and butter until combined.
8. Serve: Drizzle warm syrup over the cinnamon rolls and serve immediately.

Ingredients: 
- 1 cup sour cream
- 1/2 cup butter softened, ya know, like your heart when you smell this baking!
- 1 cup sugar sweeten up, baby!

- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract the secret sauce!

Applesauce Cake with Cinnamon Cream Cheese Frosting 
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups unsweetened applesauce
For the Frosting:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
3 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
12 tablespoons milk optional, for desired consistency
Directions
Prepare the Cake:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Grease and flour a 913-inch baking pan, or line it with parchment paper for easy removal.
Mix the Dry Ingredients:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
Cream the Wet Ingredients:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then mix in the vanilla extract.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the applesauce, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients.
Mix until just combineddo not overmix.
Bake the Cake:
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and spread it evenly.
Bake for 3035 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cake to cool completely in the pan.
Prepare the Frosting:
In a large bowl, beat together the cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract, beating until creamy.
If the frosting is too thick, add milk, one tablespoon at a time, until the desired consistency is reached.
Frost the Cake:
Spread the frosting evenly over the cooled cake.
Slice into squares and serve.

Banana Cream Dessert with Crumble
Ingredients:
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/2 cup unsalted butter melted
1/4 cup sugar
2 cups cream cheese softened
1 cup heavy whipping cream
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 ripe bananas sliced
1/4 cup honey or maple syrup
Instructions:
1. Prepare Crust: In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar until combined. Press into a baking dish and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
2. Make Filling: Whip cream cheese, heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and fluffy.
3. Assemble Layers: Spread the cream mixture over the crust. Layer banana slices on top.
4. Add Topping: Sprinkle extra graham cracker crumbs over the bananas and drizzle with honey or maple syrup.
5. Chill: Refrigerate for 2-3 hours before serving.

Message:
Creamy Chicken and Vegetable Pasta
Ingredients:
2 cups cooked chicken breast cubed
300g egg noodles or fettuccine
2 tbsp unsalted butter
3 garlic cloves minced
1 cup carrots diced
1 cup green peas frozen or fresh
2 cups heavy cream
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese grated
1/2 tsp black pepper
Salt to taste
Fresh parsley chopped, for garnish
Instructions:
1. Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Sauté garlic until fragrant.
3. Add diced carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes, then stir in peas.
4. Pour in the chicken broth and simmer until vegetables are tender.
5. Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan cheese, letting the sauce thicken slightly. Season with salt and black pepper.
6. Add the cooked chicken and pasta to the skillet. Toss until everything is evenly coated.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
#CreamyChickenPasta#ComfortFood

Ingredients:
300g penne pasta
2 cups cooked chicken breast cubed
1 cup cherry tomatoes halved
1 cup mushrooms sliced
2 cups heavy cream
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese grated
1 cup mozzarella cheese shredded
2 garlic cloves minced
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp black pepper
Salt to taste
1 tbsp chives chopped, for garnish
Instructions:

2. Cook penne pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
3. In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Sauté garlic until fragrant, then add mushrooms and cook until softened.
4. Stir in heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, black pepper, and salt. Simmer until sauce thickens slightly.
5. Combine cooked pasta, chicken, and cherry tomatoes in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over and mix until well coated.
6. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cheese is golden and bubbly.
7. Garnish with chopped chives and serve hot.

Lazy Double Smash Burger & Chips Recipe 
Ingredients:
For the Double Smash Burgers:
1 lb ground beef 80/20 blend recommended 
Salt and pepper, to taste 蓼
4 slices of cheese American or cheddar 燎
4 burger buns 
Toppings: lettuce, tomato, pickles, ketchup, mustard, onions as desired 塞勒
For the Chips:
2 large potatoes, cut into wedges or use frozen chips 凜
2 tablespoons olive oil 㮝
Salt and pepper, to taste 蓼
1 teaspoon paprika optional 
Instructions:
1. Make the Chips:
If using fresh potatoes, preheat your oven to 425F 220C. Toss the potato wedges with olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika. Spread them on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for about 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy.
If using frozen chips, follow the package instructions for cooking.
2. Prepare the Burgers:
While the chips are baking, heat a skillet or griddle over high heat.
Divide the ground beef into 8 equal portions about 2 oz each. Roll into balls but do not compact them too much.
Place 2 balls in the skillet, spacing them apart. Use a spatula to press down firmly to smash them into thin patties. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Cook the Burgers:
Cook for about 2-3 minutes until the edges are crispy. Flip the patties and place a slice of cheese on each. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the cheese is melted.
4. Assemble the Burgers:
Toast the burger buns lightly if desired. Place two patties on each bun and add your favorite toppings and condiments.
5. Serve:
Serve the burgers hot with a side of crispy chips.
Enjoy Your Lazy Double Smash Burger & Chips! 
This easy and delicious meal is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or a weekend treat! Enjoy!

Wanna Rock Like Elvis? Try This Cake!   Its as delicious as it soundsfull of juicy pineapple, creamy frosting, and a sprinkle of pecans. Youll be singing for joy after one bite! 
Ingredients:

- 1/2 cup Butter, softened  
- 3 cups Powdered Sugar

4. Top It Off: Throw the remaining crushed pecans on top of your masterpiece. Fancy!

Message:
Mini Coconut Cream Pies 便
Ingredients:
For the crust:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
For the coconut cream filling:
1 1/2 cups whole milk
1/2 cup canned coconut milk
3/4 cup granulated sugar
1/4 cup cornstarch
4 large egg yolks
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup sweetened shredded coconut
For the topping:
1 cup heavy whipping cream
2 tablespoons powdered sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/4 cup toasted shredded coconut
Directions:
Make the crust:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
In a medium bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Mix until evenly combined.
Divide the mixture evenly among a 12-cup muffin tin, pressing it firmly into the bottom and slightly up the sides to form mini crusts.
Bake for 8 minutes, then let cool completely before adding the filling.
Make the coconut cream filling:
In a medium saucepan, combine the whole milk, coconut milk, sugar, and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens and begins to bubble about 5-7 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks. Slowly pour about 1/2 cup of the hot milk mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly, to temper the eggs.
Gradually add the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan, whisking constantly. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and shredded coconut.
Let the filling cool slightly, then spoon it evenly into the prepared crusts. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to set.
Make the whipped cream topping:
In a large bowl, beat the heavy whipping cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Assemble the pies:
Pipe or spoon the whipped cream over the chilled pies. Sprinkle with toasted shredded coconut for garnish.
Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 15 minutes  Chill Time: 2 hours  Total Time: 2 hours 35 minutes
Kcal: 250 kcal per mini pie  Servings: 12 mini pies
Tips:
Toast the shredded coconut in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden brown.
Use a mini tart pan instead of a muffin tin for a fancier presentation.

1 large egg
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 package vanilla or white cake mix
1/2 cup salted butter, cold, sliced into thin pats
Fresh strawberries, whole or halved optional, for serving
Directions:
Preheat the oven to 350F.
Spread the strawberry pie filling evenly across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese, egg, and sugar until creamy and well combined.
Drop spoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture over the strawberry filling, spreading slightly to create an even layer.
Evenly sprinkle the dry cake mix over the strawberry and cream cheese layers.
Distribute the slices of butter across the top, covering as much of the cake mix as possible.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is golden and the strawberry filling is bubbling at the edges.
Serve warm or cooled, garnished with fresh strawberries if desired.
Servings: 8-10

Ingredients:
For the apple filling:
1 cup apple pie filling store-bought or homemade, chopped into small pieces
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
For the dough:
1 can 16.3 oz refrigerated biscuit dough 8 large biscuits
2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
For the cinnamon-sugar coating:
1/3 cup granulated sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
Directions:
Prepare the filling:
In a small bowl, mix the chopped apple pie filling with the cinnamon. Set aside.
Prepare the dough:
Open the can of biscuit dough and separate into 8 biscuits. Flatten each biscuit into a 4-inch circle using your hands or a rolling pin.
Fill the bombs:
Place about 1 tablespoon of the apple pie filling mixture into the center of each flattened biscuit. Gently bring the edges of the dough together and pinch tightly to seal, forming a ball. Make sure the seams are fully sealed to prevent the filling from leaking.
Air fry or bake:
Air Fryer Method: Preheat your air fryer to 350F 175C. Place the bombs seam-side down in the air fryer basket, leaving space between each one. Air fry for 8-10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Oven Method: Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Place the bombs seam-side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Coat with cinnamon sugar:
In a small bowl, mix the granulated sugar and cinnamon for the coating. Brush the warm apple pie bombs with melted butter, then roll them in the cinnamon-sugar mixture until fully coated.
Serve:
Serve warm as is or with a drizzle of caramel sauce for extra indulgence.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 25 minutes
Kcal: 180 kcal per bomb  Servings: 8 apple pie bombs
Tips:
Add a small cube of cream cheese to the filling for an extra creamy twist.
Use crescent roll dough instead of biscuit dough for a lighter texture.

Message:
Valentine Strawberry Cookies
Celebrate love with these soft and chewy strawberry-flavored cookies! With their delightful pink hue and sweet bursts of white chocolate, theyre the perfect treat for Valentines Dayor any time you want to share some sweetness.
 Ingredients
 1 box 15.25 oz strawberry cake mix
 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
 2 large eggs
 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 1/2 cup white chocolate chips
 1/2 cup chopped dried strawberries optional
 Directions
Step 1: Prepare the Dough
1. Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the strawberry cake mix, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract. Stir until a soft dough forms.
3. Fold in the white chocolate chips and dried strawberries if using for added texture and flavor.
Step 2: Shape the Cookies
1. Scoop about 1 tablespoon of dough and roll it into a ball. Place the dough balls on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
2. Gently press down each ball to slightly flatten.
Step 3: Bake
1. Bake in the preheated oven for 9-11 minutes, or until the edges are set but the centers are still soft.
2. Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
 Tips
 Decorate for Valentines Day: Drizzle melted white chocolate over the cookies and sprinkle with heart-shaped sprinkles for a festive touch.
 Storage: Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days.
 Add a Twist: Swap the white chocolate chips for dark chocolate or add a pinch of freeze-dried strawberry powder for extra strawberry flavor.
These cookies are as sweet as they are beautifulperfect for gifting or sharing with someone special!

Message:
Strawberry Earthquake Cake 
Ingredients:
1 box 15.25 oz strawberry cake mix plus ingredients listed on the box
1/2 cup shredded sweetened coconut
1/2 cup chopped pecans
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
2 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups fresh strawberries, diced
Directions:
Prepare for baking:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Layer the base:
Evenly sprinkle the coconut and chopped pecans across the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Prepare the cake mix:
Mix the strawberry cake batter according to the instructions on the box. Pour the batter evenly over the coconut and pecans in the baking dish.
Make the cream cheese mixture:
In a medium bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, melted butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Add the cream cheese layer:
Drop spoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture onto the cake batter. Use a knife or skewer to gently swirl the cream cheese mixture into the batter, leaving visible streaks.
Add the strawberries:
Scatter the diced strawberries evenly over the top of the batter.
Bake:
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the cake is set but still slightly gooey in the center. The cream cheese layer will create cracks and pockets, giving the ""earthquake"" effect.
Cool and serve:
Let the cake cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before serving. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 45 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour
Kcal: 350 kcal per slice  Servings: 12 slices
Tips:
For added texture, sprinkle white chocolate chips on top of the batter before baking.
Store leftovers in the refrigerator and reheat gently in the microwave for a warm treat.

Message:
Hawaiian Pineapple Coconut Thumbprint Cookies 便
Ingredients:
1 cup unsalted butter softened
1/2 cup sugar granulated for a hint of sweetness
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon vanilla extract for extra flavor depth
1/2 cup shredded coconut for rolling
1/2 cup pineapple jam or preserves for filling; opt for a natural jam with visible pineapple chunks for the best taste
Optional Add-Ins:
For a vegan version, substitute butter with coconut oil or vegan butter.
Use gluten-free flour for a gluten-free option, ensuring its suitable for baking.
Instructions
Step 1: Preheat and Prepare
Start by preheating your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent sticking and ensure even baking.
Step 2: Mix the Dough
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. This may take about 23 minutes. Add in the vanilla extract for a hint of flavor. Gradually add the flour and salt, mixing until just combined to form a dough thats soft but not sticky.
Step 3: Form and Roll
Take small portions of dough and roll them into 1-inch balls. Roll each ball in shredded coconut to coat them generously, adding a delightful crunch and flavor to the cookies.
Step 4: Create the Thumbprints
Place the coconut-coated balls on the prepared baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Use your thumb or the back of a spoon to press a gentle indentation in the center of each cookie, creating a well for the filling.
Step 5: Add the Pineapple Filling
Fill each indentation with about 1/2 teaspoon of pineapple jam. Be careful not to overfill, as the jam may spill out while baking.
Step 6: Bake to Golden Perfection
Bake the cookies for 1215 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden. The coconut will become toasty, adding extra flavor. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for about 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.

The Biała Pavlova: A Symphony of Lightness and Flavor
The Pavlova is a classic dessert that originated in Australia and New Zealand, named after the famous Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova. Known for its delicate balance between crispy meringue and creamy toppings, the Biała Pavlova White Pavlova version is especially refined. With its crisp meringue shell, fluffy whipped cream, and fresh, vibrant fruit, it offers a sophisticated yet refreshing treat perfect for any special occasion.
Ingredients for the Meringue:
4 large egg whites room temperature
1 cup 200g granulated sugar
1 teaspoon white vinegar
1 teaspoon cornstarch
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
Ingredients for the Topping:
1 cup 240ml heavy whipping cream, chilled
2 tablespoons powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Fresh fruit for garnish e.g., strawberries, kiwi, blueberries, raspberries
Optional: Mint leaves for garnish
Method:
The process begins with preheating the oven to 250F 120C and preparing the baking sheet with parchment paper. The meringue is made by beating egg whites to soft peaks before gradually adding sugar, creating a glossy, stiff mixture. Vinegar, cornstarch, and vanilla are then folded into the meringue to stabilize it. This mixture is spooned into a circle shape on the parchment paper and baked for 90 minutes, followed by a cooling period to avoid cracks. While the meringue cools, whipped cream is prepared by beating heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
To assemble the Pavlova, the meringue is topped with a generous layer of whipped cream and garnished with fresh fruit. A few mint leaves can be added for a pop of color and an aromatic touch. The result is a show-stopping dessert that combines sweetness with a light and airy texture, offering the perfect balance between creaminess and crispness.
Nutritional Information:
Each serving of this delicious dessert contains approximately 230 calories, 3 grams of protein, 30 grams of carbohydrates, and 11 grams of fat. With its light, refreshing nature, the Biała Pavlova is a guilt-free indulgence perfect for those seeking a sophisticated dessert. #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Message:
The Best Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe
Ingredients
 
14 tablespoons 196g salted butter
2 and 1/2 300g cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon flaky sea salt
1 cup  2 Tablespoons 237g dark brown sugar packed
1/2 cup 99g granulated sugar
2 teaspoons vanilla
2 large eggs room temperature
1 cup milk chocolate chips
1 cup dark chocolate chips
1/2 cup bittersweet chocolate chips
Instructions
 
Place the butter in a small sauce pan over medium-high heat and cook for about 2 minutes  stirring almost constantly  until the butter has completely melted and lightly browned.
Remove from heat and scrape butter and any brown specks into a heatproof bowl. Place the bowl in the refrigerator and bring the butter back to room temperature; this will take about an hour to an hour and a half.  
Once the butter is at room temperature
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.
In a medium sized bowl whisk together the flour, baking soda, and sea salt; set aside.
In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, add the chilled brown butter and both sugars; beat on medium speed for about 2 minutes, or until light and fluffy. Add in the vanilla and beat smooth. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Turn the mixer off.
Gently fold in the flour mixture with a wooden spoon, stirring only until the flour begins to disappear. Fold in chocolate chips.
Roll 3 tablespoon sized balls of dough between your palms to form a ball they should be big; almost a 1/4 cup, then place on prepared sheet make sure to leave enough room in between each cookie for inevitable spreading. Continue this process until all the dough has been rolled. Place baking sheets in preheated oven  one at a time  and bake for 11 minutes, or until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Let cookies cool for 10 minutes on the sheet before transferring to a wire wrack to cool completely.
 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes

Ingredients
 
For the Cranberry Bundt Cake:

Message:
Ingredients
 
1 and 1/2 cups warm water, between 110 and 115 degrees F
2/3 cup granulated sugar
2 and 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
2 large eggs, at room temperature
1 cup evaporated milk
2 and 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
7 cups bread flour
1 and 1/2 teaspoons salt
5 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature
4 cups peanut oil, for deep frying
2 cups confectioners sugar
Instructions
 
In a medium-size bowl, add the warm water, sugar, and yeast and whisk well to combine. Sit aside for about 10 minutes, or until the mixture has bubbled up and become foamy.
In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment,  beat the eggs until smooth. Beat in the vanilla and evaporated milk. Beat in 3 and 1/2 cups of the flour until smooth. Turn the mixer to low speed and slowly pour in the yeast mixture careful here - this mixture can splash up if added to quickly!; beat until smooth. Add in the butter and beat until incorporated. Finally, beat in the remaining 3 and 1/2 cups of flour and salt. Beat until dough is smooth and cohesive; about 2 minutes. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate the dough for at least 2 hours, or up to 24 hours.
Line a large rimmed baking sheet with three layers of paper towels, set aside.
In a large enameled cast-iron pan, heat 4-inches of oil to 360 degrees F. Remove the dough from the refrigerator. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out into a 1/4-inch thick rectangle. Cut the dough into 2 and 1/2-inch squares.
In batches, fry the dough until they puff up and are golden brown in color, about 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beignets to the prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining dough.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve at once!

Message:
Overnight Cinnamon Rolls with Sweet Glaze
Ingredients
 
For the Cinnamon Rolls:
1 cup 227ml whole milk full-fat
4 tablespoons 57g unsalted butter room temperature
3 and 1/3 cups 400g all-purpose flour divided
1 0.25 ounce package active dry yeast
3 tablespoons 42g granulated sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 large egg room temperature
For the Filling: 
1 cup 213g light brown sugar
1/4 cup 50g granulated sugar
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
3/4 cup 170g unsalted butter melted
For the Glaze:
3 and 1/2 cups 392g confectioners sugar sifted
1/2 cup 113ml heavy cream
1/4 teaspoon salt
Instructions
 
For the Cinnamon Rolls:
Lightly grease a large bowl and set it aside.
In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, warm the milk just until small bubbles begin to form around the edge of the pan; remove from heat. Add in the butter and stir until its completely melted; let mixture cool while you mix your dry ingredients.
In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook attachment, combine 2 and 1/2 cups of flour, yeast, sugar and salt; mix on medium-low speed until ingredients are evenly combined. Add in the egg, then add in the warm milk mixture and beat until combined.
Add the remaining flour, a little bit at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Once all of the flour has been added, increase the speed to medium and beat for 5 minutes. The dough should form a ball around the hook and pull away from the edges of the bowl. 
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead it with your hands for 1 minute. Form the dough into a ball and transfer it to the prepared bowl.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let sit in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Generously grease the sides and bottom of a 913-inch baking pan and set it aside.
Gently punch down the risen dough, then turn it out onto a lightly floured work surface and, using a rolling pin, roll it into a 1218-inch rectangle. Be sure the dough is evenly thick before adding the filling.

Message:
Easy Bananas Foster French Toast
Ingredients
 
For the French Toast:
1/2 cup 113 grams unsalted butter
4 large eggs, plus 3 egg yolks
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
3 and 1/2 tablespoons 44 grams granulated sugar
1 Tablespoon 14 grams dark brown sugar, packed
1/3 cup 76 grams milk
1/3 cup 78 grams heavy cream
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 Tablespoon 14 grams dark rum
8 slices brioche, cut about 3/4"" thick
For the Bananas Foster Topping:
1/2 cup 113 grams unsalted butter
3/4 cup 142 grams dark brown sugar, packed
1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 cup 113 grams heavy cream
1/4 teaspoon salt
1 cup 110 grams pecans, roughly chopped or whole
2 large firm bananas, peeled and sliced
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2 and 1/2 Tablespoon 35 grams dark rum
Instructions
 
For the French Toast:
Melt a few Tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-heat. 
In a large shallow bowl or pie plate, whisk the eggs and egg yolks until well combined.
Add in the cinnamon, nutmeg, and both sugars, and whisk until well combined. Finally, whisk in the milk, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and rum.
Dip each slice of brioche into the egg mixture, making sure both sides are well coated. 
Place brioche slices into skillet and cook until the undersides are golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Flip, and continue cooking on the other side until equally golden brown, about another 2 to 3 minutes.
Continue with all french toast, adding more butter to the pan as needed.

Message:
Maple Butter Pecan Fudge 杻 #recipe #recipeoftheday #recipeshare #recipeideas #recipereels #recipes 
Ingredients
  
  cup butter
  cup heavy whipping cream
  cup brown sugar
  cup granulated sugar
  tsp salt
  tsp cinnamon
 1 tsp maple extract
 2  cups powdered sugar
 1  cups toasted pecans chopped
Instructions
 
Melt the butter in a medium saucepan. Add the cream, brown sugar, granulated sugar, salt, and cinnamon. Stir and bring the mixture to a boil until it reaches 235F.
Remove the saucepan from heat and add the maple extract, but do not stir. Let the mixture cool to 105F, which takes about 30 minutes.
Stir the cooled mixture vigorously until it thickens. Mix in the powdered sugar and toasted pecans until everything is well combined.
Spoon the fudge mixture onto parchment paper, shape it into a log, and refrigerate for 12 hours.
Slice and enjoy your delightful Maple Butter Pecan Fudge!
Notes
 
Toasting Pecans: Toast the pecans beforehand for a richer, nuttier flavor. Let them cool before adding to the fudge.
Temperature Precision: Use a candy thermometer to ensure the mixture reaches the correct temperatures 235F when boiling, 105F before stirring.
Consistency: Stir vigorously after cooling to achieve the perfect fudge texture.
Storage: Keep the fudge in an airtight container in the fridge to maintain freshness.
Variations: Swap pecans for walnuts or add a drizzle of melted chocolate for an extra twist.
