Message:
Crumbl Cosmic Brownie Cookies 
Indulge in a chocolate lovers dream with these Cosmic Brownie Cookies. With a rich, fudgy cookie base and a gooey chocolate ganache topping, they taste just like your favorite cosmic brownie! These cookies are perfect for any occasion, offering a delicious blend of flavors in every bite.
Ingredients:
Cookies:
 cup butter room temperature 杻
 cup light brown sugar packed 
 cup white granulated sugar 
3 large eggs 讀
2 tbsp light corn syrup 
1 tbsp pure vanilla extract 
3  cups all-purpose flour 
1 cup cocoa powder 
1 tbsp cornstarch 
2 tsp baking soda 籠
1 tsp kosher salt 蓼
Topping Ganache:
 cup heavy cream 拏
2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips 
 cup rainbow-coated chocolate chips 
Instructions:
Cookies:
1 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
2 Mix dry ingredients: In a large bowl, combine flour, cocoa powder, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt. Whisk to combine. Set aside.
3 Cream butter and sugars: In a mixing bowl, beat together butter, light brown sugar, and white sugar using an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
4 Add eggs and flavorings: Mix in the eggs, vanilla extract, and corn syrup until fully combined.
5 Add dry ingredients: Gradually add the dry flour mixture to the wet ingredients. Mix until a soft cookie dough forms.
6 Scoop and shape: Use a large ice cream scooper to scoop dough into balls. Flatten them with your hands into circles about 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.
7 Bake: Bake at 350F 175C for 15-17 minutes, or until the cookies are set and slightly firm around the edges.
Ganache Topping:
8 Heat the cream: Pour heavy cream into a small pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
9 Make the ganache: Pour the hot cream over the chocolate chips in a small bowl. Whisk together until smooth and creamy.
 Top the cookies: Spoon the warm ganache over each cookie, spreading it slightly with the back of the spoon. Immediately sprinkle rainbow-coated chocolate chips on top for a fun, colorful touch! 
Enjoy
Let the cookies cool slightly before devouring them. These Cosmic Brownie Cookies are rich, fudgy, and perfectly chocolatyjust like the classic cosmic brownies you love!

Message:
Oreo Cookie Whoopie Pies 
Chocolate cake mix transforms into thick, cakey Oreo Cookie Whoopie Pies, filled with creamy cookies and cream frosting. These sandwich cookies are irresistible and perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
Cookies:
1 box chocolate cake mix 13.25 ounces 
 cup all-purpose flour 
 cup butter melted 杻
3 large eggs 讀
 cup sour cream 拏
Cookies n Cream Frosting:
 cup butter softened 杻
4 oz cream cheese softened 燎
2 cups powdered sugar 
 cup Oreo cookies crushed, about 8 cookies 
Instructions:
Cookies:
1 Prepare the baking sheet: Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Set aside.
2 Mix the dough: In a medium bowl, combine the cake mix, flour, melted butter, eggs, and sour cream. Mix until just combined using a hand mixer or by hand.
3 Scoop the dough: Use a medium cookie scoop to place 24 mounds of dough on the prepared baking sheet. Refrigerate for 1-2 hours to chill the dough.
4 Bake: Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Roll chilled dough into smooth balls and place them about 2 inches apart on the baking sheet. Bake for 9-11 minutes until the edges are set and the tops start to crack. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Frosting:
1 Prepare the frosting: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter and cream cheese until creamy and smooth. Add powdered sugar and mix until fully incorporated.
2 Crush the cookies: Crush the Oreo cookies in a Ziploc bag or food processor. Add crushed cookies to the frosting and mix until even.
3 Pipe the frosting: Transfer the frosting to a piping bag or a large Ziploc bag with the tip cut off.
Finishing the Whoopie Pies:
1 Assemble: Pipe a generous amount of cookies and cream frosting onto half of the cookies, then sandwich with the remaining cookies.
2 Serve: Enjoy immediately or store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days. You can refrigerate them for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 3 months.
These Oreo Whoopie Pies are the ultimate treat for cookie lovers! Enjoy the perfect blend of rich chocolate cookies with creamy cookies and cream filling.

Message:
Stuffed Carrot Cake Cookies 凌
Enjoy all the delicious flavors of carrot cake in a cookie form! These moist and spiced carrot cake cookies are stuffed with a rich cream cheese filling for the perfect bite.
Ingredients:
3 cups all-purpose flour 
 tsp baking soda 籠
 tsp salt 蓼
2 tsp cinnamon 
 tsp ginger 
 tsp nutmeg 
 tsp cloves 
12 tbsp 1.5 sticks unsalted butter, softened 杻
 cup granulated sugar 
 cup brown sugar 
1 large egg 讀, plus 1 egg yolk 讀
2 tsp vanilla extract 
1 cup grated carrots 凌
 cup chopped raisins 
 cup chopped walnuts 
Cream Cheese Filling:
6 oz brick of cream cheese, room temperature 燎
3 tbsp granulated sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Pinch of salt 蓼
Instructions:
1 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2 Make the cream cheese filling: In a mixer, combine cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Chill in the freezer.
3 Prepare the ingredients: Grate the carrots, chop raisins and walnuts, and set aside.
4 Combine dry ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves. Set aside.
5 Mix wet ingredients: In a large bowl, cream together the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla extract, mixing until smooth.
6 Combine dry and wet ingredients: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture. Stir in the grated carrots, walnuts, and raisins until just combined.
7 Form the cookies: Scoop two balls of cookie dough. Flatten them into discs and place a teaspoon of chilled cream cheese filling in between. Seal the edges well to prevent leakage.
8 Bake for 8-12 minutes until golden around the edges. Let the cookies cool on a wire rack.
These stuffed carrot cake cookies offer the perfect blend of spiced cake and creamy filling in each bite! Enjoy warm or at room temperature.

Message:
Salted Honey Pie 不
A perfectly salty and sweet pie with creamy custard in a buttery pie crust. Simple, scrumptious, and totally irresistible!
Yield: 10 servings
Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 40 mins
Total Time: 55 mins
Ingredients:
Pie crust refrigerated or homemade 不
4 large egg yolks, lightly beaten 讀
2 1/2 cups 600ml heavy whipping cream 拏
1 cup 144g light brown sugar 
1/3 cup 45g cornstarch, sifted 
1/2 tsp salt 蓼
1/2 cup 120ml honey 
2 tsp vanilla extract 
Sea salt optional 蓼
Instructions:
1 Prepare the pie crust in a deep dish 8-inch or 9-inch pie pan, and chill it in the fridge no pre-baking required. Preheat the oven to 375F 190C.
2 Whisk the egg yolks in a large bowl, and set aside.
3 Make the filling: In a saucepan, heat the cream, brown sugar, cornstarch, and salt over medium heat. Stir regularly until it comes to a rolling boil and thickens.
4 Temper the eggs: Gradually whisk a little bit of the hot cream mixture into the egg yolks to avoid curdling. Slowly whisk in the rest of the cream mixture, ensuring it is well combined.
5 Add flavor: Stir in honey and vanilla extract to the custard.
6 Pour the custard into the chilled pie crust.
7 Bake for 40-45 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly. The pie will still be a bit jiggly but will firm up as it cools.
8 Cool the pie to room temperature, then refrigerate until fully chilled and set.
9 Top with sea salt, if desired, before serving.
Enjoy this sweet and salty treat with a delightful custard filling

Message:
Black Forest Flourless Brownie Cookies 
These indulgent, gluten-free cookies are a delicious take on the classic Black Forest gateau, with fudgy flourless chocolate cookies, vanilla whipped cream, and a luscious cherry filling. Luxurious and easy to assemble!
Prep Time: 45 mins
Cook Time: 8 mins
Chill Time: 36 mins
Total Time: 1 hr 29 mins
Servings: 8 sandwich cookies
Ingredients:
Cherry Filling:
300 g 10  oz halved pitted cherries  fresh or frozen
50 g  cup caster/superfine or granulated sugar 
1  tbsp lemon juice 
8 g 1 tbsp cornstarch or cornflour 
Flourless Brownie Cookies:
150 g 5  oz dark chocolate 60-70% cocoa solids, chopped 
70 g  stick  1 tbsp unsalted butter 杻
150 g  cup caster/superfine or granulated sugar 
2 large eggs room temperature 讀
30 g  cup Dutch processed cocoa powder 
 tsp salt 蓼
Vanilla Whipped Cream:
230 g 1 cup double or heavy cream cold from the fridge 林
30-40 g - cup powdered/icing sugar 
1 tsp vanilla bean paste or 2 tsp vanilla extract 
Instructions:
Cherry Filling:
1 In a saucepan, combine cherries, sugar, and lemon juice. Cook over medium-high heat until cherries are soft and have released juices.
2 Mix a few tablespoons of the juices with cornstarch to form a slurry, then add back to the cherry mixture. Cook until it boils and thickens about 1 minute.
3 If needed, strain the cherries, return the thickened juices to the pan, and cook until desired consistency.
4 Cool the cherry filling by placing the saucepan in a water bath ice optional, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Flourless Brownie Cookies:
1 Preheat the oven to 350ºF 180ºC and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
2 Melt the chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl until smooth, and set aside to cool.
3 Whisk together sugar and eggs until pale and fluffy tripled in volume.
4 Pour in the warm chocolate mixture, whisking until combined. Sift in cocoa powder and salt, then mix until smooth.
5 Chill the batter in the fridge for 6-8 minutes to slightly thicken.
6 Scoop 16 cookies using 2 tbsp each onto the baking sheets, leaving space between them. Bake for 8-9 minutes until puffed and cracked.
7 Allow the cookies to cool on the sheet for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
Vanilla Whipped Cream:
1 Whip the cold cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla until soft peaks form.
2 Transfer to a piping bag with a star nozzle.
Assembling the Black Forest Cookies:
1 Pipe whipped cream on the bottom of a cooled cookie.
2 Spoon a generous amount of cherry filling over the cream.
3 Top with another cookie to form a sandwich.
4 Serve with any extra cream and cherry filling, or enjoy as open-faced cookies!
Storage: Keep the cookies in an airtight container in the fridge for 3-4 days.

Copycat Crumbl Biscoff White Chip Cookies 
Loaded with cookie butter, Biscoff cookies, and white chocolate chips, these giant cookies are an absolute treat!
Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 12 mins

Servings: 5 giant cookies

Message:
Cranberry Cheesecake 燎
This luscious Cranberry Cheesecake is a holiday dream with a spiced graham cracker crust, orange-infused creamy filling, and topped with cranberry sauce and sugared cranberries. Perfect for a festive dessert!
Ingredients:
Cheesecake Crust:
2 cups graham cracker crumbs 
2 tbsp white sugar 
1 tsp cinnamon 
 tsp nutmeg 
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
Cheesecake Filling:
32 oz full-fat cream cheese, room temp 燎
1  cups sugar 
3 large eggs, room temp 讀
8 oz full-fat sour cream, room temp 
 cup all-purpose flour 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
1 tbsp orange zest 
2 cups cranberry sauce 𢡄
Sugared Cranberries:
 cup water 
2 tbsp orange juice 
1  cups sugar 
1 cup fresh cranberries 𢡄
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Crust:
Preheat oven to 325F 165C.
Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and melted butter in a bowl.
Press mixture into the bottom and halfway up the sides of a buttered 9-10.5 inch springform pan. Set aside in the fridge for 20-30 minutes.
2 Cheesecake Filling:
In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
Add sugar and flour, mixing well.
Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by sour cream, vanilla, and orange zest.
Pour the cheesecake batter into the crust.
Spoon cranberry sauce over the batter and swirl using a knife for a marbled effect.
3 Baking the Cheesecake:
Wrap the outside of the springform pan with foil to avoid water leakage.
Place the pan in a larger roasting pan and pour hot water until it reaches halfway up the springform.
Bake for 40-50 minutes. The center should wobble slightly, and the edges should puff.
Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool inside with the door slightly open for 1 hour.
4 Chill the Cheesecake:
Transfer the cheesecake to a cooling rack for 2 hours.
Run a butter knife along the edges, then refrigerate for 6-8 hours or overnight.
5 Sugared Cranberries:
Combine water, orange juice, and  cup sugar in a saucepan and heat until the sugar dissolves.
Toss in cranberries, then cool them on parchment paper.
Roll cooled cranberries in the remaining sugar to coat.
6 Serve:
Top the chilled cheesecake with sugared cranberries.
Slice and enjoy your festive dessert!

Cookie Monster Cookies 
 These vibrant blue cookies are bursting with chocolate chips and sprinkles, perfect for parties or a whimsical treat! 
Ingredients:
1 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
1 cup packed brown sugar 
2 large eggs 讀
2 tsp vanilla extract 
3 cups all-purpose flour 
1 tsp baking soda 籠
1/2 tsp baking powder 蓼
1/4 tsp salt 蓼
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 
1/2 cup blue candy-coated chocolate pieces or sprinkles 
Instructions:
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2 In a bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth and fluffy.
3 Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract.
4 In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
5 Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
6 Fold in the chocolate chips and blue candy-coated chocolate pieces.
7 Scoop tablespoon-sized dough balls onto the baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
8 Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden.
9 Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack.
 Serve and enjoy your delightful Cookie Monster treats!

Red Velvet Marble Cupcakes 
These Red Velvet Marble Cupcakes combine a light vanilla batter with a rich red velvet swirl and are topped with a beautifully marbled red velvet cream cheese frosting. Perfect for any celebration!
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1/2 cup milk, room temperature 拏
1/2 cup sour cream, room temperature 
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 tablespoons cornstarch 
1/2 teaspoon baking powder 療
1/4 teaspoon baking soda 籠
1/2 teaspoon Kosher or sea salt 蓼
1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
2 large eggs, room temperature 讀讀
2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 
For the Red Velvet Portion:
1 tablespoon cocoa powder 
1 tablespoon milk 拏
1-2 teaspoons liquid red food coloring or gel  water 
For the Marbled Red Velvet Cream Cheese Frosting:
8 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
1 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
1 lb confectioners sugar 
Pinch of Kosher or sea salt 蓼
2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 
1 tablespoon natural unsweetened cocoa powder 
1-2 teaspoons liquid red food coloring 
Instructions:
1 Make the Cupcakes:
Preheat oven to 350F 180C and line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
In a liquid measuring cup, whisk together the milk and sour cream. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat the butter until light and fluffy. Add sugar and continue beating. Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla.
Gradually mix in half of the dry ingredients, followed by half of the milk mixture. Repeat with the remaining ingredients until just combined.
2 Make the Red Velvet Portion:
In a small bowl, combine 1 cup of the batter with cocoa, milk, and red food coloring. Stir to combine.
3 Assemble the Cupcakes:
Add 1 tablespoon of plain batter to each liner, followed by 1 tablespoon of red velvet batter, then another tablespoon of plain batter. Fill liners 2/3 full.
Tap the pan on the counter to release air bubbles. Bake for 18-19 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool cupcakes in the pan for 5-10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
4 Make the Marbled Frosting:
Beat cream cheese and butter together until light and fluffy. Gradually add confectioners sugar and salt, and beat until combined. Stir in vanilla and beat for 2 additional minutes.
Divide the frosting in half. Add cocoa powder and red food coloring to one half and mix.
5 Frost the Cupcakes:
Fill one side of a piping bag with plain frosting and the other side with red velvet frosting. Pipe swirled frosting on top of cooled cupcakes.
Enjoy these delightful treats! 
#RedVelvetCupcakes #MarbleCupcakes #CreamCheeseFrosting #DeliciousDesserts #CupcakeLove

Message:
Kit Kat Candy Bar Cupcakes Recipe 療
If youre a Kit Kat lover or a chocolate enthusiast, these Kit Kat cupcakes are the perfect dessert! They feature a moist chocolate cupcake base with crushed Kit Kat bars mixed into the batter and a creamy frosting topped with even more Kit Kats. A crunchy, sweet treat for any occasion!
 Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1  cups all-purpose flour
1 cup sugar
1/3 cup cocoa powder 
1 tsp baking soda
 tsp baking powder
 tsp salt
1 large egg, room temperature 讀
 cup buttermilk, room temperature
 cup hot coffee 
 cup vegetable oil
1  tsp vanilla extract
12 Kit Kats half crushed, half cut into quarters
For the Frosting:
1 cup butter, room temperature 杻
4 cups powdered sugar 
2 tsp vanilla extract
2 tbsp heavy cream
6 Kit Kats, crushed for mixing into the frosting
6 Kit Kats, cut into quarters for garnish
Fudge sauce optional, for drizzling
 Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Cupcakes
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2 Place half of the Kit Kat bars in a resealable bag and use a rolling pin to crush them.
3 In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
4 In a separate bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, and hot coffee. Add the egg and whisk until combined.
5 Gradually add the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients while mixing on low speed using a stand or hand mixer. Continue mixing for 2 minutes on medium speed, scraping down the sides as needed.
6 Fold in the crushed Kit Kat pieces.
7 Divide the batter evenly among the cupcake liners, filling them about 2/3 full.
8 Bake for 13 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cupcakes to cool completely on a wire rack.
Step 2: Make the Frosting
1 In a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter on medium speed for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy.
2 Add powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and heavy cream, mixing on low speed until combined.
3 Fold in the crushed Kit Kats and increase the speed to medium-high, whipping the frosting for 3-4 minutes until fluffy.
4 Transfer the frosting to a piping bag and pipe onto the cooled cupcakes.
Step 3: Decorate
1 Drizzle fudge sauce on top of the frosted cupcakes optional.
2 Garnish with Kit Kat quarters for an extra crunch.
 Total Time: 38 minutes
 Servings: 12 cupcakes
 Calories: 481 kcal per cupcake
Enjoy these delicious Kit Kat Candy Bar Cupcakes that combine the creamy and crunchy textures of Kit Kats with a moist chocolate base and fluffy frosting. Perfect for birthdays, parties, or just a fun treat

Message:
Butter Pecan Donuts Recipe 
These Butter Pecan Donuts are soft, spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, and topped with a rich butter pecan glaze. Perfect for a cozy morning treat or a delightful snack!
 Ingredients:
For the Donuts:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled 杻
1/2 cup buttermilk 拏
1 large egg 讀
1 tsp vanilla extract 
1/2 cup chopped pecans, toasted 
For the Butter Pecan Glaze:
1/2 cup unsalted butter 杻
1/2 cup brown sugar 
2 tbsp heavy cream 拏
1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
Pinch of salt
Additional chopped pecans for garnish optional 
 Directions:
Step 1: Prepare the Oven and Pan
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
2 Lightly grease a donut pan or spray it with non-stick cooking spray.
Step 2: Make the Donut Batter
1 In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
2 In a separate bowl, mix the melted butter, buttermilk, egg, and vanilla extract until well combined.
3 Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined dont overmix!.
4 Gently fold in the toasted chopped pecans.
Step 3: Fill the Donut Pan
1 Spoon the batter into the donut pan, filling each cavity about 2/3 full.
2 Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a donut comes out clean.
3 Let the donuts cool in the pan for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Step 4: Make the Butter Pecan Glaze
1 In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
2 Stir in the brown sugar and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture begins to bubble and the sugar fully dissolves.
3 Add the heavy cream and cook for another 1-2 minutes until the glaze thickens slightly.
4 Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt.
Step 5: Glaze the Donuts
1 Dip the cooled donuts into the butter pecan glaze, letting any excess drip off.
2 Place the glazed donuts back on a wire rack and optionally sprinkle additional chopped pecans on top of the glaze before it sets.
Step 6: Serve
Enjoy these Butter Pecan Donuts fresh and warm for the ultimate treat! 
 Total Time: 25 minutes
 Servings: 12 donuts
These donuts are a perfect balance of soft, fluffy dough and rich, nutty glazeideal for autumn mornings or whenever youre craving something sweet and special!

Red Velvet French Toast with Vanilla Bean Cheesecake Filling 
This decadent Red Velvet French Toast is filled with a sweet, creamy Vanilla Bean Cheesecake mixture, making it a perfect breakfast for special occasions like Mothers Day or Valentines Day!
 Ingredients:
For the Red Velvet French Toast:
4 eggs 讀
1 cup buttermilk or 1 cup milk  1 tbsp vinegar, set aside for 5 mins 拏
2 tbsp sugar or natural granulated sweetener 
2 tsp pure vanilla extract 
2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder 
2 tsp red food coloring 
8 slices of bread, halved for 16 bread halves 
For the Vanilla Bean Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz reduced-fat cream cheese, softened 燎
2 tbsp sugar or natural granulated sweetener 
1 tsp vanilla bean paste 
1 handful fresh raspberries 
 Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the French Toast 1 In a shallow bowl, whisk together eggs, buttermilk, sugar, vanilla extract, cocoa powder, and red food coloring until smooth and lump-free.
2 Dip the bread slices into the egg mixture, pressing lightly to ensure theyre soaked through. Flip to coat both sides evenly.
3 Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Fry the bread slices in batches 3-4 slices at a time, flipping once, until cooked through and golden. Place cooked toast onto a warmed plate.
Step 2: Prepare the Vanilla Bean Cheesecake Filling 1 In a medium bowl, combine the cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla bean paste. Whip the mixture until light and fluffy.
2 Spoon 1-2 tablespoons of the cheesecake filling onto 6 toast halves and spread evenly.
3 Top with the remaining toast halves to create sandwiches.
Step 3: Serve 1 Drizzle the Red Velvet French Toast with melted chocolate, dust with icing sugar, and top with fresh raspberries or cream if desired.
2 Serve immediately and enjoy the deliciousness!
 Total Time: 25 minutes
 Serves: 4
This luxurious French toast is sure to impress with its rich red velvet flavor and creamy cheesecake filling. Perfect for breakfast in bed or a romantic brunch!

Message:
Christmas Pavlova Trifle 
This Christmas pavlova trifle is a festive and delicious showstopper! With layers of custard, whipped cream, macerated fruits, and meringue kisses, its the perfect centerpiece for your holiday dessert table.
 Ingredients:
For the Custard:
1 cups 375ml full cream milk 拏
1 cups 375ml thickened cream 拏
5 extra-large egg yolks 讀
 cup 110g caster sugar 
2 tbsp cornflour 
30g unsalted butter, cubed, softened 杻
1 tsp vanilla bean paste or pure vanilla extract 
For the Macerated Fruit:
250g cherries, halved, pitted 
1 white peach, pitted, cut into wedges 
1 yellow peach, pitted, cut into wedges 
1 white nectarine, pitted, cut into wedges 
1 yellow nectarine, pitted, cut into wedges 
 cup 60ml lemon juice 
 cup 55g caster sugar 
250g raspberries 
For Assembly:
2 cups 500ml thickened cream, whipped to soft peaks 拏
100g vanilla meringue kisses 
100g flavored meringue kisses 
 Method:
Step 1: Make the Custard 1 In a saucepan, heat the milk and cream over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until it simmers.
2 In a separate bowl, whisk together egg yolks, sugar, and  tsp sea salt until pale and light about 3 minutes.
3 Whisk in the cornflour, then gradually add the hot milk mixture to the egg mixture, whisking continuously.
4 Pour the mixture back into the saucepan and cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thick and glossy about 3 minutes.
5 Remove from heat, whisk in butter and vanilla, and strain the custard through a fine sieve. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing it directly onto the surface of the custard, and refrigerate for 2 hours or until thickened.
Step 2: Macerate the Fruit 1 Toss cherries, peaches, nectarines, lemon juice, and sugar in a bowl to coat. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until juices form.
2 Gently fold in the raspberries.
Step 3: Assemble the Trifle 1 Spoon one-third of the macerated fruit into a 12-cup 3L glass serving dish.
2 Layer with one-third of the custard, one-third of the whipped cream, and one-quarter of the meringues.
3 Repeat the layers with the remaining fruit, custard, whipped cream, and two-thirds of the meringues.
Step 4: Chill and Decorate 1 Refrigerate the trifle for 30 minutes before serving.
2 Decorate the top with the remaining meringues.
 Serves: 12
Prep Time: 40 minutes
Cook Time: 10 minutes
Chill Time: 2.5 hours
This trifle combines all the best holiday flavors with the irresistible texture of meringue and cream. Enjoy!

Message:
Barbie Pink Strawberry Cake with Strawberry Cream Cheese Icing 
Add a splash of vibrant pink and fruity sweetness to your celebrations with this Barbie Pink Strawberry Cake! This moist cake is full of fresh strawberry flavor and topped with luscious strawberry cream cheese icing, making it the perfect treat for birthdays, parties, or any fun gathering!
 Ingredients:
For the Strawberry Cake:
1  cups all-purpose flour 
1 cup granulated sugar 
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
 cup strawberry puree fresh or canned 
 cup milk 拏
2 large eggs 讀
 cup sour cream 
1  tsp baking powder 
 tsp baking soda 籠
 tsp salt 蓼
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Pink food coloring optional 
For the Strawberry Cream Cheese Icing:
8 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
2 cups powdered sugar 
 cup strawberry puree fresh or canned 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Pink food coloring optional 
 Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Strawberry Cake
1 Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans or line them with parchment paper.
2 Mix Dry Ingredients: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
3 Cream Butter and Sugar: In a separate large bowl, cream the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
4 Add Wet Ingredients: Beat in the eggs one at a time. Then mix in the vanilla extract and strawberry puree. Add the sour cream and milk, mixing until smooth and well-combined.
5 Combine: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. For an extra pop of pink, stir in pink food coloring if desired.
6 Bake: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely.
Step 2: Prepare the Strawberry Cream Cheese Icing
1 Beat Cream Cheese and Butter: In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and butter until smooth and creamy.
2 Add Powdered Sugar and Strawberry Puree: Gradually add the powdered sugar and strawberry puree, mixing until well incorporated. Add pink food coloring for that extra Barbie pink pop, if desired.
3 Beat Until Smooth: Continue beating until the icing is smooth and spreadable.
Step 3: Assemble the Cake
1 Layer: Place one cooled cake layer on a serving platter. Spread a generous layer of strawberry cream cheese icing on top.
2 Top: Place the second cake layer on top of the first. Frost the top and sides of the cake with the remaining icing.
3 Decorate: Optionally, garnish the cake with fresh strawberries, edible glitter, or colorful sprinkles for an extra festive touch.
Step 4: Serve
1 Chill and Enjoy: Refrigerate the cake for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the icing to set. Slice, serve, and enjoy the delicious strawberry-filled goodness!

Message:
Biscoff Cookie Butter Cinnamon Rolls 
Soft, fluffy cinnamon rolls filled with rich Biscoff cookie butter and topped with creamy icingan indulgent treat thats perfect for breakfast, dessert, or any special occasion!
Ingredients:
For the Dough:
3  cups all-purpose flour 
 cup granulated sugar 
2  tsp active dry yeast 蓼
 cup warm milk 110F/45C 拏
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
 cup water 
1 large egg 讀
 tsp salt 蓼
For the Filling:
 cup Biscoff cookie butter, softened 
 cup brown sugar, packed 
2 tsp ground cinnamon 
2 tbsp unsalted butter, softened 杻
For the Icing:
4 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup Biscoff cookie butter 
1 cup powdered sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
2-3 tbsp milk 拏
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Dough:
In a small bowl, combine warm milk, yeast, and a pinch of sugar. Let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, and salt. Add the yeast mixture, melted butter, water, and egg. Mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let it rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size.
2 Prepare the Filling:
In a bowl, mix Biscoff cookie butter, butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon until smooth.
3 Assemble the Rolls:
Roll out the dough into a 12x18-inch rectangle. Spread the filling evenly over the dough.
Roll up the dough tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Place the rolls in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
4 Second Rise & Bake:
Let the rolls rise for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350F 175C.
Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown.
5 Make the Icing:
Beat softened cream cheese, Biscoff cookie butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually add milk until spreadable.
6 Ice the Rolls:
Drizzle the icing generously over the warm cinnamon rolls. Serve and enjoy! 
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Rising Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Bake Time: 25 minutes
Total Time: 2 hours 15 minutes
Servings: 12 rolls
These Biscoff Cookie Butter Cinnamon Rolls are the ultimate cozy indulgence, with a sweet cookie butter filling and a creamy, dreamy icing! Perfect for special mornings or as a dessert for any gathering.

Message:
Blueberry Cheesecake Chimichangas 
These crispy, golden chimichangas are filled with a delicious cream cheese and blueberry filling, making them the perfect sweet treat. Ready in just 26 minutes!
Ingredients:
Blueberry Sauce:
2 cups fresh blueberries 𢡄
1/4 cup sugar 
1 tablespoon lemon juice 
1/4 teaspoon lemon zest 
5 tablespoons water 
2 tablespoons cornstarch 
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1/8 teaspoon salt 蓼
Cheesecake Filling:
6 oz cream cheese 燎
1 tablespoon granulated sugar 
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
Chimichangas:
4 8 inch soft flour tortillas 
1/3 cup granulated sugar 
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 
Vegetable oil for frying 
Instructions:
1 Blueberry Sauce:
In a medium pan, combine blueberries, sugar, 5 Tbsp of water, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes. 
In a small dish, mix 2 Tbsp water with cornstarch, vanilla, and salt. Stir and add to the blueberry mixture. Continue to cook for 20-30 seconds until thickened. Remove from heat and let cool completely. 
2 Cheesecake Filling:
In a medium dish, mix together cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until smooth and creamy. 療
3 Chimichangas:
In a small bowl, stir together sugar and cinnamon. Set aside. 
Place 1/4 cup cheesecake filling on the lower third of each tortilla. Add 1/4 cup blueberry sauce over the cheesecake. 
Fold the sides of each tortilla toward the center and roll them up into chimichangas. Use toothpicks to secure them. 
Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry each chimichanga until golden brown and crispy, flipping as needed. 
Transfer chimichangas to a paper towel to drain for a minute. Remove toothpicks and roll them in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. 
Enjoy these crispy, creamy, and fruity Blueberry Cheesecake Chimichangas warm, with a touch of cinnamon and sugar! Perfect for a dessert or a special treat.

MEDITERRANEAN CHICKEN AND AVOCADO SALAD 綾陋
Ingredients:
塞 2 cups romaine lettuce, chopped
 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
勒 1 cup cucumber, diced
陋 1 avocado, sliced
 1 cup cooked chicken breast, sliced
讀 2 hard-boiled eggs, quartered
 1/4 cup kalamata olives
燎 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled
 Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
 Lemon wedges for serving
Dressing:
 2 tablespoons lemon juice
籠 2 tablespoons olive oil
蓼 Salt and pepper to taste
龍 1 clove garlic, minced
Instructions:
Prepare the Dressing:
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Assemble the Salad:
On a large plate or in a salad bowl, arrange the chopped romaine lettuce as the base.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, sliced avocado, and cooked chicken breast on top.
Arrange the hard-boiled egg quarters and kalamata olives around the salad.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the salad.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve:
Drizzle the prepared dressing over the salad just before serving.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side for an extra burst of freshness.
Enjoy this healthy and delicious Mediterranean Chicken and Avocado Salad, perfect for a light lunch or dinner! 綾陋

Banana Vanilla Pudding 
Ingredients:
- 4 bananas, sliced
- 1 package vanilla pudding mix
- 2 cups cold milk
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 box vanilla wafers
Directions:
1. Prepare the vanilla pudding mix according to the package instructions using the cold milk. Set aside to thicken.
2. In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.

Message:
Cheesy Garlic Chicken Wraps
Ingredients 
2 chicken breasts, cubed
1 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1/4 cup sour cream
1/4 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
4 large flour tortillas
Directions 
Cook the Chicken: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add cubed chicken, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Sauté until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown, about 6-8 minutes.
Make the Garlic Sauce: In a small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, minced garlic, and parsley. Stir well and set aside.
Assemble the Wraps: Lay out the tortillas. Divide the cooked chicken evenly between the tortillas. Sprinkle cheddar and mozzarella cheese over the chicken. Drizzle with the garlic sauce.
Wrap and Toast: Fold the sides of the tortillas and roll them tightly. Heat a clean skillet over medium heat and toast the wraps for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and crispy, and the cheese is melted.
Serve: Cut in half and enjoy your cheesy, garlicky goodness!
Prep Time : 10 minutes
Cook Time : 15 minutes
Total Time : 25 minutes
Servings : 4
Calories : 500 kcal per serving

Message:
Filet Mignon in Mushroom Wine Sauce!
Ingredients
2 6 oz filet mignon steaks, about 1-1.5 inches thick 數
Salt and pepper, to taste 蓼
2 tablespoons olive oil 㮝
2 tablespoons unsalted butter 杻
8 oz 225g mushrooms, sliced 
2 cloves garlic, minced 龍
1/2 cup dry red wine 
1 cup beef broth 北
1 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme 
1 teaspoon Dijon mustard optional 
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish 
Instructions
Season the Steaks: Generously season the filet mignon steaks with salt and pepper on both sides. 數
Sear the Steaks: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the steaks and sear for about 4-5 minutes on each side for medium-rare, or until your desired doneness is reached. Remove the steaks from the skillet and set aside to rest. 
Sauté the Mushrooms: In the same skillet, add the butter. Once melted, add the sliced mushrooms and sauté for about 5-7 minutes, or until they are browned and tender. Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant. 龍
Deglaze with Wine: Pour in the red wine, scraping the bottom of the skillet to release any browned bits. Bring to a simmer and let it cook for about 2-3 minutes, allowing the wine to reduce slightly. 
Add Broth and Seasonings: Stir in the beef broth, thyme, and Dijon mustard if using. Simmer for about 5-7 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. 北
Return the Steaks: Once the sauce has thickened, return the filet mignon steaks to the skillet. Spoon the mushroom wine sauce over the steaks and let them simmer in the sauce for an additional 2-3 minutes to heat through. 數
Serve: Plate the filet mignon and spoon additional mushroom wine sauce over the top. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley. Enjoy your delicious Filet Mignon in Mushroom Wine Sauce! 
This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner at home, offering rich flavors and a tender steak experience! 數

Salmon and Shrimp Alfredo Recipe
Ingredients:
200g salmon fillet
150g shrimp peeled and deveined
200g fettuccine pasta
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper to taste
Fresh parsley for garnish
Directions:

Toss the cooked pasta with the sauce, flaked salmon, and shrimp. Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

Message:
Steak with Shrimp and Lobster Sauce
Just made this incredible Steak with Shrimp and Lobster Sauce - a perfect blend of flavors! 
Ingredients:
2 ribeye steaks
8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 lobster tail, cut into small pieces
1 cup heavy cream
1/4 cup white wine
1 small shallot, finely chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions:
Season the steaks with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steaks for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they reach your desired doneness. Remove from skillet and let rest.
In the same skillet, add the remaining olive oil and butter. Sauté the shallot and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and lobster pieces to the skillet and cook until the shrimp turn pink and the lobster is cooked through, about 4-5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Pour the white wine into the skillet to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Let it reduce by half.
Add the heavy cream to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Cook until the sauce thickens slightly, about 5-7 minutes.
Return the shrimp and lobster to the skillet, stirring to coat them in the sauce. Simmer for another 2 minutes.
Serve the steaks topped with the shrimp and lobster sauce. Garnish with chopped parsley.
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 35 minutes
Kcal: 650 kcal  Servings: 2 servings
Ina Garten Family

Garlic Butter Chicken Bites with Creamy Parmesan Pasta 龍
Ingredients:
For the Chicken Bites:
1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 tablespoons olive oil
4 tablespoons unsalted butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
For the Creamy Parmesan Pasta:
12 oz fettuccine or pasta of your choice
2 tablespoons butter
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 cup chicken broth
Salt and pepper to taste
Extra garlic butter optional, for drizzling
Directions:
Cook the Pasta: Boil a large pot of salted water and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Cook the Chicken Bites: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken bites, seasoning with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Make the Garlic Butter Sauce: In the same skillet, reduce the heat to medium and add the butter. Once melted, add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and toss to coat in the garlic butter sauce.
Prepare the Creamy Parmesan Sauce: In a separate skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for another 30 seconds. Stir in the heavy cream and chicken broth, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer. Gradually whisk in the grated Parmesan cheese until smooth, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine Pasta and Sauce: Toss the cooked pasta in the creamy Parmesan sauce, ensuring its well coated.
Serve: Plate the creamy Parmesan pasta and top with the garlic butter chicken bites. Drizzle with extra garlic butter if desired and garnish with fresh parsley.

Cooking Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 30 minutes

Message:
Ribeye Steak with Caramelized Onions and Shrimp Sauce 
Indulge in this luxurious and hearty meal, perfect for any special occasion or a cozy dinner at home! 
---
Ingredients:
For the Ribeye Steak:
- 2 ribeye steaks about 1 inch thick
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Fresh rosemary sprigs optional
For the Caramelized Onions:
- 3 large onions, thinly sliced
- 3 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon sugar
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/4 cup beef broth
- 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves optional
For the Shrimp Sauce:
- 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/4 cup white wine
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/4 cup chicken broth
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped optional, for garnish
---
Directions:
Step 1: Caramelize the Onions 暈
1. In a large skillet, melt the butter and olive oil over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced onions, sugar, salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are caramelized and golden brown, about 25-30 minutes.
3. Add the beef broth and fresh thyme if using, and cook for an additional 5 minutes until the liquid is mostly absorbed. Remove from heat and set aside.
Step 2: Cook the Ribeye Steaks 數
1. Preheat your grill or a large skillet over high heat.
2. Rub the ribeye steaks with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
3. Place the steaks on the hot grill or skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, or until your desired level of doneness.
4. For the last minute of cooking, add the butter, minced garlic, and rosemary sprigs to the pan and baste the steaks with the melted butter.
5. Remove the steaks from the heat and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Step 3: Make the Shrimp Sauce 
1. In a medium skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the shrimp and cook until pink and opaque, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
4. Pour in the white wine and simmer until reduced by half, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the heavy cream and chicken broth, stirring to combine. Cook until the sauce thickens, about 3-5 minutes.
6. Return the shrimp to the skillet, season with salt and black pepper, and stir to coat in the sauce.
Step 4: Serve 
1. Arrange the ribeye steaks on serving plates.
2. Spoon the caramelized onions over the steaks.
3. Pour the shrimp sauce over the steaks and onions.
4. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
---
Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour  Servings: 2
---

1 tablespoon olive oil
2 tablespoons butter
2 cloves garlic, minced
Fresh thyme or rosemary optional, for garnish
For the French Onions:
2 large onions, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 tablespoon butter
1 teaspoon sugar
Salt, to taste
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar optional
For the French Fries:
2 large russet potatoes, cut into fries
2 tablespoons vegetable oil
Salt, to taste
Paprika or garlic powder optional, for seasoning
Instructions:
1. Prepare the French Fries:
Preheat the oven to 425F 220C.
Rinse and soak the cut potatoes in cold water for about 30 minutes this helps to remove excess starch and results in crispier fries.
Drain and pat dry. Toss the potatoes with vegetable oil and season with salt and optional spices if using.
Spread the fries in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy.

While the fries are baking, heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions, season with salt, and sprinkle with sugar.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 15-20 minutes, until the onions are caramelized and golden brown. If desired, stir in balsamic vinegar for added flavor.

Season the ribeye steaks generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
In another skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the steaks to the hot skillet and sear for about 4-5 minutes on each side for medium-rare adjust time based on thickness and desired doneness.
In the last minute of cooking, add butter and minced garlic to the pan, spooning the melted butter over the steaks for added flavor.
4. Serve:
Let the steaks rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Serve the ribeye steaks topped with the caramelized French onions

Message:
Cajun Shrimp and Steak Alfredo Pasta
A flavorful and satisfying dish that combines the spice of Cajun cuisine with the creaminess of Alfredo sauce.
Ingredients:
For the steak:
1 pound boneless, sirloin steak, thinly sliced
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
For the shrimp:
1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon olive oil
1/2 teaspoon paprika
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
For the Alfredo sauce:
1 10.75 oz can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 cup milk
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
For the pasta:
1 pound penne pasta
Instructions:
Cook pasta: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Season steak and shrimp: In a bowl, combine the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Season the steak and shrimp with the mixture.
Cook steak: Grill or sauté the steak until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Cook shrimp: Sauté the shrimp until pink and cooked through.
Make Alfredo sauce: In a large skillet, combine the cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, oregano, garlic powder, and black pepper. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the sauce thickens.
Combine ingredients: Add the cooked steak and shrimp to the Alfredo sauce. Toss to coat.
Toss with pasta: Add the cooked pasta to the sauce mixture. Toss to coat.
Serve: Serve immediately and enjoy!
Tips:
For a spicier dish, add more cayenne pepper to the seasoning mixture.
You can substitute the steak with chicken or shrimp.
Serve with a side salad or garlic bread.
Enjoy this delicious and flavorful Cajun Shrimp and Steak Alfredo Pasta!

Message:
Creamy Parmesan Chicken and Orzo
Ingredients 
1 lb chicken breast, diced
Salt and pepper, to taste
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp butter
1 small onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup orzo pasta
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 tsp Italian seasoning
Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
Directions 
Cook Chicken: Season the diced chicken with salt and pepper. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Sauté Onion and Garlic: In the same skillet, add butter and let it melt. Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Toast Orzo and Add Broth: Add orzo to the skillet, stirring to coat with butter and garlic. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer. Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Make It Creamy: Lower the heat, then stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. Return the cooked chicken to the skillet, stirring to combine until everything is creamy and well-coated. Adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Prep Time  10 minutes
Cook Time  25 minutes
Total Time  35 minutes
Servings  4
Calories  550 kcal
This Creamy Parmesan Chicken and Orzo is a one-pan wonder, with tender chicken pieces, flavorful orzo, and a creamy Parmesan sauce. Perfect for a cozy and satisfying weeknight meal! 燎

Message:
Hamburger steaks with onion gravy 
Ingredients
1lb. ground beef
1 egg
1/3 cup bread crumbs
1/2tsp. black pepper
1 tsp. salt
1/2 tsp. onion powder
1 clove garlic minced
1tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1tbsp. oil
1 1/2 cup thinly sliced onion
2tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 cup beef broth
1/2tsp. salt
Directions
In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, pepper, salt, onion powder, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce.
Form into thick patties.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the patties and onion in the oil until patties are nicely browned.
Remove the beef patties to a plate, and keep warm.
Sprinkle flour over the onions and drippings in the skillet. Stir in flour with a fork, scraping bits of beef off of the bottom as you stir.
Gradually mix in the beef broth. Season with seasoned salt. Simmer and stir over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes, until the gravy thickens. Turn heat to low, return patties to the gravy, cover, and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Enjoy

Message:
Mac and Cheese Meatloaf Casserole 燎
Ingredients:
For the Meatloaf Layer:
1 pound ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup ketchup
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
Salt and pepper to taste
For the Mac and Cheese Layer:
2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
2 cups milk
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 teaspoon mustard powder optional
Salt and pepper to taste
For Topping:
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 cup breadcrumbs optional
Directions:
Prepare the Meatloaf:
Preheat your oven to 375F 190C. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Press the meatloaf mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Bake for 20-25 minutes until partially cooked.
Make the Mac and Cheese:
While the meatloaf is baking, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in the milk and bring to a simmer. Cook until thickened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese, mustard powder if using, salt, and pepper. Mix until the cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir until well coated.
Assemble the Casserole:
Remove the meatloaf layer from the oven and carefully spread the mac and cheese mixture over the top.
Sprinkle the extra shredded cheese and breadcrumbs over the mac and cheese layer for a crispy topping.
Bake:
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden and the meatloaf is fully cooked.
Serve:
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy this hearty comfort dish!
Prep Time: 15 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 55 minutes
Kcal: 550 kcal  Servings: 6 servings

Message:
Cheesy Garlic Chicken Wraps 
Ingredients:
2 cups cooked chicken shredded or diced
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1/2 cup cream cheese softened
2 cloves garlic minced
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Salt and pepper to taste
4 large flour tortillas
1 cup fresh spinach or lettuce optional
Olive oil for cooking
Instructions:
Prepare the Filling: In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked chicken, mozzarella cheese, softened cream cheese, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until all ingredients are thoroughly blended.
Assemble the Wraps: Take a tortilla and lay it flat. Spoon a generous portion of the chicken mixture into the center. If you like, add fresh spinach or lettuce for an extra crunch. Fold in the sides and roll the tortilla tightly to secure the filling.
Cook the Wraps: Heat a splash of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place the wraps seam-side down in the skillet. Cook for about 3-4 minutes on each side until they turn golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Serve: Slice the wraps in half and serve them warm. Pair with your favorite dipping sauce or a refreshing side salad for a complete meal.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Total Time: 20 minutes  Servings: 4

Message:
Salmon and Shrimp with Cajun Cream Sauce
Dive into the rich flavors of the sea with my latest creation: Salmon and Shrimp with Cajun Cream Sauce! Perfect for a cozy dinner. #seafooddelight #cajuncuisine #creamygoodness
Ingredients:
- 2 salmon fillets
- 10 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon Cajun seasoning
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 onion, finely chopped
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped for garnish
- Cooked pasta or rice, for serving
Directions:
1. Season the salmon fillets and shrimp with Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper.
2. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the salmon fillets and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Remove and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, add the shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until they turn pink and opaque. Remove and set aside with the salmon.
4. In the same skillet, add a bit more oil if needed, then add garlic and onion. Sauté until the onion is translucent.
5. Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Add the Parmesan cheese and stir until the sauce thickens.
6. Return the salmon and shrimp to the skillet and coat with the sauce. Heat through.
7. Serve the salmon and shrimp with sauce over cooked pasta or rice, garnished with chopped parsley.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cooking Time: 20 minutes  Total Time: 30 minutes
Kcal: 650 kcal  Servings: 2 servings #CreamyGoodness

Message:
WOULD YOU EAT THIS PANKO-CRUSTED FISH WITH LEMON DILL SAUCE 
For the Panko-Crusted Fish:
4 white fish fillets such as cod, haddock, or tilapia
1 cup panko breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
2 large eggs
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard
Salt and pepper to taste
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon lemon zest
2 tablespoons olive oil for pan-frying
For the Lemon Dill Sauce:
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
1 teaspoon lemon zest
1 clove garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
Instructions:
For the Panko-Crusted Fish:
Prepare the coating: In one bowl, mix the panko breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. In another bowl, whisk together the eggs and Dijon mustard. Place the flour in a third bowl.
Coat the fish: Pat the fish fillets dry with paper towels. Dredge each fillet in the flour, shaking off any excess. Dip the fillets into the egg mixture, then coat them in the panko breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere the crumbs.
Cook the fish: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the coated fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. The fish should be opaque and flake easily with a fork.
For the Lemon Dill Sauce:
Make the sauce: In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, chopped dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve: Plate the crispy panko-crusted fish and drizzle with the lemon dill sauce. Serve with lemon wedges, and garnish with extra dill or parsley for a fresh touch. Pair with roasted vegetables, a side salad, or rice for a complete meal.
Helpful Tips:
For a lighter version, bake the fish at 400F 200C for 12-15 minutes, or until golden and crispy.
You can substitute Greek yogurt for mayonnaise in the sauce for a healthier option.
Add a pinch of cayenne pepper to the panko mixture for a little heat.
Enjoy this crispy, flavorful panko-crusted fish with a refreshing lemon dill sauceperfect for a light, satisfying dinner!

Message:
Ribeye Steak with Caramelized Onions and Mashed Potatoes 數暈凜
Ingredients:
For the Ribeye Steak:
2 ribeye steaks about 1-inch thick
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 tablespoons butter
Salt and pepper, to taste
1 teaspoon garlic powder optional
1 teaspoon fresh rosemary or thyme optional
For the Caramelized Onions:
2 large onions, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons butter
1 tablespoon olive oil
Salt, to taste
1 teaspoon sugar optional, to enhance caramelization
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar optional, for added flavor
For the Mashed Potatoes:
2 lbs potatoes Yukon Gold or Russet
1/2 cup milk or cream, for richer flavor
1/4 cup butter
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/4 cup sour cream optional, for creaminess
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Mashed Potatoes:
Boil Potatoes: Peel and cut the potatoes into even chunks. Place them in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Mash: Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Add the butter, milk, and sour cream if using. Mash until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Keep warm.
2. Caramelize the Onions:
Heat Oil and Butter: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil and butter over medium heat.
Cook Onions: Add the sliced onions and a pinch of salt. Cook for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are golden brown and caramelized. If desired, add sugar to help the onions caramelize.
Add Balsamic optional: Stir in the balsamic vinegar during the last few minutes of cooking for extra flavor. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. Cook the Ribeye Steaks:
Prepare the Steaks: Pat the steaks dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and herbs if using.
Heat Skillet: In the same skillet used for the onions, increase the heat to medium-high and add a bit more olive oil if needed.

1 lb 450g large shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese

Message:
Peach Cobbler Cookies
These delicious peach cobbler cookies are a summer favorite, combining chewy, cinnamon-spiced cookies with a fresh peach filling, crumble topping, and a drizzle of vanilla glaze. They bring all the flavors of a classic peach cobbler into a handheld treat!
Ingredients
For the Peach Filling:
4 large ripe peaches, diced about 4 cups or 701 g 
1/4 cup granulated sugar 
1/4 cup  1 tbsp light brown sugar, packed 
3/4 tsp cinnamon 
1/4 tsp nutmeg 
1 tsp lemon juice 
2 tsp corn starch 
2 tsp water 
1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
For the Cookies:
1 cup salted butter, softened at room temp 226 g 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed 
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
2 large eggs 讀
3 cups all-purpose flour 390 g 北
1 tsp baking soda 
1 tsp baking powder 
1/4 tsp salt 蓼
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon 
1/2 tsp nutmeg 
For Rolling the Dough:
1/2 cup granulated sugar 
2 tsp cinnamon 
1/8 tsp nutmeg 
For the Crumble:
1/4 cup salted butter, melted 57 g 杻
1/4 cup light brown sugar, packed 
1 1/2 tbsp granulated sugar 
1/2 cup  1 tbsp all-purpose flour 73 g 北
3/4 tsp cinnamon 
For the Glaze optional:
1/3 cup powdered sugar 
1/4 tsp vanilla extract 
Pinch of cinnamon 
1-2 tbsp milk 拏
Instructions
Make the Peach Filling: 1 In a saucepan, combine diced peaches, sugars, lemon juice, cinnamon, and nutmeg over medium heat. Cook for 6 minutes until bubbly.
2 Stir in corn starch mixed with water and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Cool completely in the fridge.
Make the Cookie Dough: 1 Cream butter and sugars with an electric mixer. Add vanilla and eggs, mixing until combined.
2 Mix in the dry ingredients until a dough forms. Chill for 30 minutes.
Scoop & Chill: 1 Scoop dough into balls about 55 g each and chill for at least 3 hours in the fridge.
Make the Crumble: 1 Preheat oven to 350F 177C. Combine crumble ingredients and bake for 12-14 minutes until golden brown. Cool and break into small pieces.
Bake the Cookies: 1 Preheat the oven to 350F 177C and roll the dough balls in cinnamon sugar. Bake for 11-13 minutes. Create an indent in the cookies with a tablespoon and let them cool completely.
Assemble Cookies: 1 Fill each cookie with peach filling, sprinkle crumble on top, and drizzle with optional glaze.
 Enjoy these Peach Cobbler Cookies immediately or store in the fridge for 4-5 days!

Message:
The Best Baked Strawberry Cheesecake Gluten-Free Option
This is THE BEST strawberry cheesecake youll ever try! With a creamy, rich strawberry filling and a syrupy strawberry topping, it bursts with flavor and is easy to makeno water bath needed!
Ingredients
For the Cheesecake Crust:
225 g 2  cups finely crushed digestive biscuits 
Use gluten-free if needed
75 g  stick unsalted butter, melted 杻
For the Strawberry Cheesecake Filling:
50 g 2 cups freeze-dried strawberry slices 
200 g 1 cup caster or granulated sugar 
600 g 2  cups full-fat cream cheese 燎
115 g  cup full-fat plain or Greek-style yogurt 拏
3 large eggs 讀
 tsp vanilla bean paste or 1 tsp vanilla extract 
20 g 3 tbsp cornflour UK/cornstarch US 
Red food coloring optional 
For the Strawberry Topping:
320 g 2  cups strawberries, halved or quartered 
50 g  cup caster or granulated sugar 
1 tbsp lemon juice 
 tsp vanilla bean paste or 1 tsp vanilla extract 
Instructions
For the Crust: 1 Preheat the oven to 350ºF 180ºC. Line an 8-inch 20 cm springform pan with baking paper, including the sides.
2 Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter until it resembles wet sand. Press it into the pan, forming a 1  inch 4 cm rim.
3 Bake for 10 minutes, then cool.
For the Strawberry Cheesecake Filling: 1 Lower the oven temperature to 285ºF 140ºC.
2 Blend freeze-dried strawberries with sugar until powdered.
3 In a large bowl, mix cream cheese and yogurt until smooth. Add eggs one by one, vanilla, strawberry sugar, and cornstarch. Stir gently.
4 Optionally, add red food coloring for a vibrant pink. Pour the filling into the crust.
5 Bake for about 55 minutes, until the edges are set and the center wobbles slightly.
6 Let cool in the oven with the door ajar, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
For the Topping: 1 Mix strawberries, sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla. Let them sit for 1-2 hours or overnight.
2 Drain the juice and reduce it over medium heat until syrupy.
3 Combine the syrup with the strawberries and set aside.
Assembling: 1 Remove the chilled cheesecake from the pan.
2 Spoon the strawberry topping over the cheesecake just before serving.
 Enjoy this beautifully rich, strawberry-packed cheesecake!
Storage: Keeps in the fridge for 4-5 days.
#StrawberryCheesecake #GlutenFree #EasyDesserts #CheesecakeLovers

Oreo Brownie & Smores Ice Cream Cake 
A decadent dessert combining a rich Oreo brownie crust, smores ice cream, marshmallows, graham crackers, and a luscious chocolate ganache. The perfect treat for any occasion!
Ingredients
Oreo Brownie Crust
 cup unsalted butter 杻
 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 
1 cup granulated sugar 
2 eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
 cup all-purpose flour 
1 teaspoon baking powder 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
1 cup crushed Oreo cookies 
Ice Cream Layer
 gallon Tillamook Fireside Smores Ice Cream 
1  - 2 cups mini marshmallows 
 cup crushed graham crackers 
Chocolate Ganache
 cup heavy cream 拏
 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 
Instructions
1. Oreo Brownie Crust
1 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Spray the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan with non-stick spray.
2 Melt butter in a skillet over medium-low heat, then mix in cocoa powder and allow to cool for 10 minutes.
3 Whisk sugar into the cocoa mixture, followed by the eggs one at a time, then whisk in vanilla extract.
4 In another bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Slowly whisk this mixture into the cocoa mixture. Fold in crushed Oreos.
5 Spoon the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted comes out with just a few crumbs.
6 Remove from the oven and let the brownies cool completely.
2. Ice Cream Layer
7 Let the ice cream sit at room temperature for 20 minutes to soften.
8 Spread the softened ice cream over the cooled brownie crust.
9 Top with mini marshmallows and crushed graham crackers.
 Freeze for at least 4 hours or overnight until set.
3. Chocolate Ganache
11 Heat the heavy cream in the microwave for 30 seconds or until steaming. Stir in the chocolate chips. Let sit for 1 minute before stirring until smooth and shiny.
12 Carefully remove the outer ring of the springform pan and drizzle the ganache over the ice cream cake.
13 Slice and serve. Enjoy!
 Oreo Brownie & Smores Ice Cream Cake is the ultimate indulgencerich, creamy, and oh-so-delicious. Perfect for summer parties or cozy gatherings!

Message:
Cotton Candy Cupcakes 療
These fun and fluffy Cotton Candy Cupcakes bring a burst of sweetness and color, perfect for any celebration! Featuring the delightful flavor of cotton candy and a colorful swirl of frosting, these cupcakes are sure to be a hit.
Ingredients:
For the cupcakes:
1  cups all-purpose flour 
1 cup sugar 
 tsp baking soda 
1  tsp baking powder 療
3 egg whites 讀
1  tsp cotton candy extract 
 cup sour cream 
 cup milk 拏
 cup melted butter, cooled 杻
Pink and blue icing color 
For the frosting:
 cup butter 杻
 cup shortening 
4 cups powdered sugar 
1 tsp cotton candy extract 
23 tbsp water or cream 
Pink and blue icing color 
Cotton candy or cotton candy-flavored suckers for decorating 
Instructions:
1 Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Line cupcake trays with paper liners. 療
2 Mix dry ingredients: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking soda, and baking powder. 
3 Mix wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, combine the egg whites, cotton candy extract, sour cream, milk, and melted butter. Stir until smooth. 
4 Combine: Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until smooth. 
5 Separate the batter: Divide the batter into two bowls, dye one pink and the other blue with icing color. 
6 Fill cupcake liners: Alternate spoonfuls of pink and blue batter into each cupcake liner, creating a marble effect. 冀
7 Bake: Bake in the preheated oven for 1820 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 
8 Make the frosting: Cream together butter and shortening. Gradually add powdered sugar, cotton candy extract, and water or cream until smooth. 
9 Color the frosting: Divide the frosting into two bowls and dye one pink and the other blue. 
 Decorate: Pipe swirled pink and blue frosting onto the cooled cupcakes. Top with cotton candy or cotton candy-flavored suckers for a fun finishing touch. 
Tips:
 Add cotton candy or suckers just before serving to avoid melting.
 For best results, use icing color instead of food dye for vibrant, true colors.

M&Ms Oreo Cookie Bars 
Easy, indulgent, and loaded with M&Ms and Oreos, these cookie bars are the perfect dessert for any occasion. No mixer needed, just 30 minutes to prep, and theyre always a hit!
Ingredients:
 cup unsalted butter 1 stick, melted 杻
1 large egg 讀
1 cup light brown sugar, packed 
1 tablespoon vanilla extract 
1 cup all-purpose flour 
18 Oreo cookies, coarsely chopped 
 cup M&Ms plain or your favorite flavor 
Instructions:
1 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with aluminum foil, spray with cooking spray, and set aside. 
2 In a large microwave-safe bowl, melt the butter in the microwave about 1 minute. 
3 Let the butter cool slightly, then whisk in the egg, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth. 
4 Add flour and stir until just combined. Dont overmix! 籠
5 Stir in chopped Oreos. 
6 Pour the batter into the prepared pan, smoothing it out with a spatula. 療
7 Evenly sprinkle M&Ms on top and gently press them down. 
8 Bake for 20-22 minutes, or until the edges are firm and a toothpick comes out clean. 
9 Allow bars to cool in the pan for 30 minutes before slicing and serving. 
Enjoy these soft, chewy cookie bars with chunks of Oreos and a candy-crunch finish! Perfect for sharing at parties or enjoying with a cold glass of milk.

Message:
Carrot Cake Cheesecake Recipe 燎凌
This Carrot Cake Cheesecake is a delightful combination of the warm, spiced flavors of carrot cake with the creamy richness of cheesecake. Its a perfect dessert for any occasion, especially for those who love both carrot cake and cheesecake!
Ingredients Serves 8 slices
Carrot Cake Layer:
2 cups shredded carrots
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
 cup vegetable oil
 cup light brown sugar
 cup granulated sugar
 cup raisins
1 cup gluten-free 1:1 flour
2 tsp baking powder
 tsp baking soda
 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
1 tsp cinnamon
 tsp ground cloves
 tsp allspice
 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp orange zest
Cheesecake Filling:
24 oz cream cheese, room temperature
12 oz sour cream
2 eggs
2 egg yolks
1  cups granulated sugar
1  tbsp vanilla extract
Instructions:
Make the Carrot Cake:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C.
Prepare the cake pan: Spray an 8"" round cake pan with non-stick baking spray.
Mix wet ingredients: In a large mixing bowl, beat the eggs and both sugars for about 3 minutes until the mixture is creamy and well-blended.
Add wet ingredients: Add the vanilla extract, vegetable oil, and orange zest. Mix until smooth.
Combine dry ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, baking powder, baking soda, cocoa, cinnamon, cloves, allspice, and kosher salt. Gradually add this to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined dont overmix.
Fold in carrots and raisins: Gently fold in the shredded carrots and raisins.
Bake: Pour the batter into the prepared 8"" round cake pan. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let the cake cool completely.
Prepare the springform pan: Spray a 9"" springform pan with non-stick baking spray. Once the carrot cake has cooled, break it apart and layer half of it at the bottom of the springform pan.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
Preheat the oven to 325F 160C.
Mix cream cheese: In a mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese for about 2 minutes until smooth and creamy.
Add sugar and sour cream: Add the sugar and sour cream to the cream cheese and mix until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla: Mix in the eggs, egg yolks, and vanilla extract until just incorporated be careful not to overmix.
Assemble the cheesecake: Pour  of the cheesecake filling into the springform pan with the carrot cake base. Layer the remaining broken-up carrot cake on top, pressing it down slightly. Then pour the remaining cheesecake filling over the carrot cake and spread evenly.
Bake: Place the springform pan in the center of the oven and bake for 55-65 minutes. The center should jiggle slightly, but the top should not be shiny.
Cool: Once baked, remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Then refrigerate for at least 8 hours before serving.
Optional Topping:
You can decorate the cheesecake with cream cheese frosting for an extra touch of indulgence!
Enjoy! 
Slice up your Carrot Cake Cheesecake and enjoy the best of both worlds: the soft, spiced carrot cake and the creamy cheesecake!

Message:
Salted Caramel Apple Pie Cheesecake 
This Caramel Apple Pie Cheesecake is the ultimate fall dessert! It combines a creamy vanilla cinnamon cheesecake with layers of caramelized apples, a graham cracker crust, and is topped with an oat crumble and salted caramel sauce. A delightful twist on apple pie thats both decadent and delicious!
Ingredients:
For the Apple Filling:
4 medium apples 588g, peeled and sliced 
3 tbsp salted butter 杻
1-2 tbsp apple cider or water 
 cup light brown sugar packed 
1  tsp cinnamon 
 tsp nutmeg 
 tsp ground cloves 
 tsp allspice 
1-2 tsp lemon juice 
2 tsp cornstarch
2 tsp water
For the Crust:
3 cups cinnamon graham cracker crumbs 300g 
 cup  3 tbsp salted butter, melted 155g 杻
For the Cheesecake:
32 oz cream cheese, at room temperature 燎
1  cups granulated sugar 308g 
4 large eggs, at room temperature 讀
1 cup full-fat sour cream 240g 拏
2 tsp vanilla extract 
1 tsp cinnamon 
 tsp nutmeg 
 tsp ground cloves 
For the Apple Topping:
4 medium apples 588625g, peeled and sliced 
3 tbsp salted butter 杻
1-2 tbsp apple cider or water 
 cup brown sugar packed 
1  tsp cinnamon 
 tsp nutmeg 
 tsp ground cloves 
 tsp allspice 
1-2 tsp lemon juice 
2 tsp water
2 tsp cornstarch
For the Crumble Topping:
 cup all-purpose flour 33g 
 cup old-fashioned rolled oats 48g 北
 cup brown sugar packed 55g 
 tsp cinnamon 
 tsp salt 蓼
 cup cold salted butter cubed 杻
For the Salted Caramel Sauce:
1 cup granulated sugar 210g 
6 tbsp salted butter cubed 杻
 cup  1 tbsp heavy cream 拏
Pinch of flaky sea salt 蓼
Instructions:
Make the Apple Filling:
1 Peel and slice the apples 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick. In a medium pan, combine all apple filling ingredients and cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until apples are tender 8-14 minutes. 2 If needed, thicken with a cornstarch-water slurry and cook for another 30-60 seconds until thickened. Set aside to cool.
Make the Crust:
3 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Spray a 9-inch springform pan with non-stick spray. Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter, then press mixture into the bottom of the pan. 4 Bake the crust for 10 minutes. Set aside to cool.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
5 Beat softened cream cheese with sugar until creamy about 1-2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each addition. Stir in vanilla, sour cream, and spices. 6 Pour half of the cheesecake batter into the crust. Add the apple filling as an even layer, then cover with the remaining cheesecake batter.
Bake the Cheesecake:
7 Preheat a pot of water for a water bath. Carefully place the cheesecake pan into a large roasting pan and fill the pan with boiling water about 1 inch of water around the cheesecake. 8 Bake at 350F 175C for 1 hour 30 minutes to 1 hour 50 minutes, until edges are set and the center wobbles slightly. Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool in the oven for 1 hour.
Chill the Cheesecake:
9 After an hour, remove the cheesecake and let it cool at room temperature. Then, refrigerate for 6-12 hours preferably overnight.
Make the Apple Topping:
 Peel and slice apples for topping. In a pan, combine all apple topping ingredients and cook until apples are tender. Thicken the mixture with cornstarch if necessary. Let cool.
Make the Crumble Topping:
11 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Mix flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Cut butter into the mixture until crumbly. Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 12-20 minutes until golden brown. Let cool completely.
Make the Salted Caramel Sauce:
12 In a saucepan, melt the sugar over medium heat until golden brown. Add butter and cream, stir until smooth. Let cool and add a pinch of sea salt.
Assemble the Cheesecake:
13 Once cheesecake has cooled, top it with the apple topping, sprinkle the crumble topping, and drizzle with salted caramel sauce.
Serve & Enjoy:
Slice and enjoy this delightful Salted Caramel Apple Pie Cheesecake with your family and friends! 
Make-Ahead Tips:
Apple Filling/Topping: Can be made 1 day ahead and stored in the fridge.
Crumble Topping: Can be made 2-3 days ahead.
Salted Caramel Sauce: Can be made up to 5 days ahead.
