Message:
No-Bake Nutella and Dulce de Leche Cheesecake 
This Nutella and Dulce de Leche Cheesecake is a creamy, delicious dessert that requires no baking! With rich Nutella and sweet dulce de leche, combined with a crisp cookie base, this cheesecake is sure to impress. Its a perfect treat for any occasion!
Ingredients for 10 servings:
For the Crust:
130 g digestive biscuits or graham crackers
50 g unsalted butter, melted
For the Cheesecake Filling:
450 g cream cheese, at room temperature
130 g powdered sugar sifted
 tsp vanilla extract
 cup 60 ml heavy cream cold, 35% fat
5 g unflavored gelatin powder enough to set 420 ml of liquid
1 tbsp water
For the Flavorings:
 cup Nutella 150 g
 cup dulce de leche 150 g
Instructions:
Prepare the Crust:
Crush the Biscuits: Crush the digestive biscuits into fine crumbs. You can use a food processor or place them in a plastic bag and crush them with a rolling pin.
Mix with Butter: In a bowl, mix the biscuit crumbs with the melted butter until well combined.
Form the Crust: Press the mixture into the bottom of an 18 cm springform pan or similar. Ensure its packed evenly and firmly. Chill in the fridge while preparing the filling.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
Beat the Cream Cheese: In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth and airy.
Add Sugar & Vanilla: Add the sifted powdered sugar and vanilla extract, and beat until well combined.
Whip the Cream: Add the cold heavy cream and beat until it thickens slightly, but dont over-whip to avoid separating the cream.
Hydrate the Gelatin: In a small bowl, add the gelatin powder and water. Let it hydrate for about 5 minutes. Then, heat it in the microwave in 15-second intervals until fully dissolved, stirring between intervals.
Incorporate Gelatin: Add 2-3 tablespoons of the cheesecake mixture into the dissolved gelatin, one tablespoon at a time, mixing well after each addition. Then, fold the gelatin mixture back into the full cheesecake mixture. Make sure everything is well combined.
Flavoring the Cheesecake:
Divide the Mixture: Split the cheesecake mixture into 3 bowls.
In one bowl, add the Nutella and mix well.
In the second bowl, add the dulce de leche and mix well.
Leave the third bowl plain.
Tip: Warm up the Nutella and dulce de leche slightly in the microwave to make them easier to mix.
Assemble the Cheesecake:
Layer the Cheesecake: Remove the crust from the fridge. Randomly spoon the 3 different cheesecake mixtures onto the crust, alternating between plain, Nutella, and dulce de leche mixtures.
Create Swirls: Using a toothpick or skewer, gently swirl the three mixtures together to create a marbled effect.
Chill: Place the cheesecake in the fridge and chill for at least 8 hours, or overnight, to allow it to set properly.
Serve:
Unmold & Serve: The next day, carefully remove the cheesecake from the springform pan. Slice and enjoy!
Notes:
Gelatin: Make sure to follow the instructions on your gelatin package for proper setting.
Storage: Store the cheesecake in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Enjoy your delicious Nutella and Dulce de Leche Cheesecake!

Layer the Cheesecake: Remove the crust from the fridge. Randomly spoon the 3 different cheesecake mixtures onto the crust, alternating between plain, Nutella, and dulce de leche mixtures.
Create Swirls: Using a toothpick or skewer, gently swirl the three mixtures together to create a marbled effect.
Chill: Place the cheesecake in the fridge and chill for at least 8 hours, or overnight, to allow it to set properly.
Serve:
Unmold & Serve: The next day, carefully remove the cheesecake from the springform pan. Slice and enjoy!
Notes:
Gelatin: Make sure to follow the instructions on your gelatin package for proper setting.
Storage: Store the cheesecake in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Enjoy your delicious Nutella and Dulce de Leche Cheesecake!

Message:
Pineapple Cream Pie 
Indulge in this Pineapple Cream Pie, a delicious and refreshing no-bake dessert thats quick to prepare. With a tropical flavor and a creamy filling, this pie is perfect for potlucks, holidays, or summer gatherings.
Ingredients
For the Crust:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs 
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 杻
1/4 cup granulated sugar 
For the Filling:
8 ounces full-fat cream cheese, softened to room temperature 燎
3/4 cup powdered sugar 
20 ounces crushed pineapple, well drained 
1 cup shredded coconut 便
8 ounces Cool Whip, thawed 籠
For the Topping:
1 cup whipped cream 
Maraschino cherries optional 
Instructions
To Make the Crust: 1 Spray a 9-inch pie plate with non-stick spray. In a medium-sized bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar. Stir until all crumbs are evenly coated.
2 Press the mixture down into the bottom and up the sides of the pie plate using a hard object a measuring cup works well. Place in the fridge while preparing the filling.

4 In a large bowl, beat together the cream cheese and powdered sugar on low speed until smooth.

6 Gently fold in the Cool Whip until well incorporated.
7 Spread the filling over the graham cracker crust and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight.

9 Decorate with the reserved crushed pineapple and shredded coconut, and add maraschino cherries if desired.

Prep Time: 10 minutes
Chill Time: 6 hours
Total Time: 6 hours 10 minutes
Enjoy this delightful Pineapple Cream Pie, perfect for any occasion!

Message:
Caramel Brownie Cheesecake 
This indulgent dessert combines three irresistible layersrich brownie, creamy cheesecake, and luscious caramel. Its a show-stopping treat perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
1 package brownie mix plus ingredients required on the box 
24 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
1 cup granulated sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
3 large eggs 讀
1/4 cup sour cream 籠
1/4 cup heavy cream 拏
1/2 cup caramel sauce plus extra for drizzling 
Whipped cream and chocolate shavings for garnish 
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Brownie Base:
Preheat oven to 350F 175C.
Mix and bake the brownie batter as per package instructions in a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Once baked, let the brownie base cool completely.
2 Make the Cheesecake Layer:
Reduce oven temperature to 325F 160C.
In a large bowl, beat together the softened cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Add vanilla extract and eggs, one at a time, mixing until just combined.
Stir in the sour cream and heavy cream.
Pour the cheesecake mixture over the cooled brownie base.
3 Add the Caramel Swirl:
Drizzle 1/2 cup caramel sauce over the cheesecake layer.
Use a knife to gently swirl the caramel into the cheesecake mixture.
4 Bake the Cheesecake:
Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until the center is set but slightly jiggly.
Turn off the oven, crack the oven door open slightly, and let the cheesecake cool gradually in the oven to avoid cracking.
Once cooled, refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
5 Chill and Garnish:
Once fully chilled, drizzle extra caramel sauce over the top.
Garnish with whipped cream and chocolate shavings before serving.
Enjoy this decadent dessert, a perfect blend of brownies, caramel, and cheesecake! 
#CaramelBrownieCheesecake #DessertLovers #CheesecakeDelight #DecadentDesserts #SweetIndulgence

Message:
Why choose between brownies and cookies when you can have both? These brownie-stuffed chocolate chip cookies bring together fudgy brownies and tender, golden cookies in one indulgent treat. Perfect for those who cant decide and need the best of both worlds!
Ingredients
For the brownies:
1 box 18 oz brownie mix 
Ingredients as listed on the box eggs, water, oil 讀
1 cup semisweet chocolate chips 
For the cookies:
1 cup butter, softened 2 sticks 杻
1/2 cup sugar 
1 cup brown sugar 
2 tsp vanilla extract 
2 large eggs 讀
1  tsp baking soda 籠
1 tsp salt 蓼
3 cups flour 
2 cups chocolate chips 
Instructions
Make the brownies:
1 Preheat oven to 350F 175C. Line an 8x8 or 9x9 pan with parchment paper or greased foil.
2 Prepare brownie batter according to box instructions and fold in 1 cup of chocolate chips.
3 Pour into prepared pan and bake per package instructions, checking for a fudgy center by underbaking slightly. Let cool completely.
4 Cut cooled brownies into 1 -inch squares 5 rows by 5 columns for 25 pieces.
Make the cookies:
5 Preheat oven to 350F 175C.
6 In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugars until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
7 Beat in vanilla and eggs.
8 Add flour, but dont stir yet. Stir baking soda and salt into the flour, then mix until just combined.
9 Fold in the chocolate chips.
Assemble the cookies:
 Scoop out two 1  tablespoon-sized balls of cookie dough. Flatten each one with your hands.
11 Place a brownie square on one flattened cookie dough ball and top with the other, pinching the dough around the brownie to seal it in. Repeat with remaining dough and brownies.
12 For best results, freeze the dough for 30 minutes before baking. This will help prevent the cookies from spreading too quickly.
13 Bake for 13-15 minutes until the edges are golden brown.
14 Let cool on the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack. Enjoy warm for maximum gooeyness!

Message:
Oreo Cheesecake 
This Oreo Cheesecake is the ultimate treat for Oreo lovers! A rich, buttery Oreo crust beneath a luscious, creamy, Oreo-studded cheesecake filling, topped with ganache and whipped cream. Its indulgence at its finest!
Ingredients:
For the crust:
32 Oreo cookies 367g 
4 tbsp butter, melted 杻
For the filling:
32 oz cream cheese, softened 907g 燎
5 large eggs 讀
1 cup granulated sugar 200g 
1/2 cup sour cream 119g 籠
1  tbsp vanilla extract 
20 Oreo cookies, quartered 230g 
For the ganache:
1 cup semisweet chocolate chips 170g 
1/2 cup heavy cream 119g 拏
Optional whipped cream topping:
1 cup heavy cream 237g 拏
2 tbsp powdered sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Instructions:
Make the crust:
1 Preheat the oven to 325F 163C. Crush Oreo cookies into fine crumbs reserve  cup for topping.
2 Mix the remaining crumbs with melted butter and press into a 9-inch springform pan, halfway up the sides.
3 Bake for 10 minutes. Keep the oven on.
Make the filling:
4 Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each.
5 Mix in sugar, sour cream, and vanilla extract. Fold in quartered Oreo cookies.
6 Pour filling into baked crust. Bake for 1 hour or until the top looks slightly dry and the center is wobbly.
7 Turn off oven and cool the cheesecake inside for 30 minutes with the door slightly open.
8 Cool completely on a wire rack for 2-3 hours, then refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight.
Make the ganache:
9 Heat the cream until simmering and pour over chocolate chips. Let sit for 3 minutes, then stir until smooth.
 Pour ganache over the cheesecake and refrigerate to set.
Optional whipped cream:
11 Beat the cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
12 Spread half on top of the cheesecake, and pipe swirls around the edges with the rest. Sprinkle reserved Oreo crumbs on top.
Enjoy this decadent Oreo Cheesecake masterpiece! 
#OreoCheesecake #UltimateDessert #ChocolateLovers #BakingJoy #SweetTreats #CheesecakeIndulgence #WhippedCream

Message:
Gooey Chocolate Chip Pie
This decadent dessert combines the best of both worldsa giant, gooey chocolate chip cookie in the form of a pie! Perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth with every bite.
Ingredients:
 cup butter room temperature 杻
 cup brown sugar 
 cup granulated sugar 
1 egg 讀
2 tsp vanilla extract 
2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 tsp cornstarch 
1 tsp baking soda 籠
 tsp salt 蓼
1 cup semisweet chocolate chips 
 cup mini chocolate chips 
1 cup mini marshmallows reserve some for garnish 
Directions:
1 Preheat Oven: Preheat to 350F 175C. Grease a 9-inch pie plate and dust with flour.
2 Cream Ingredients: Cream together butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla extract, mixing well.
3 Mix Dry Ingredients: Gradually add flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt to the wet ingredients. Mix until just combined.
4 Fold in Extras: Gently fold in semisweet chocolate chips, mini chocolate chips, and mini marshmallows.
5 Prepare for Baking: Press the dough evenly into the prepared pie plate.
6 Bake: Bake for 20-25 minutes for a gooey center, or up to 30 minutes for a firmer texture. Let cool before slicing.
Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 25 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Calories: 350 kcal per slice
Servings: 8 slices
Tips:
For extra gooeyness, bake for a shorter time and enjoy while warm!
Garnish with extra marshmallows and a drizzle of chocolate syrup for added sweetness.

Message:
Pink Lemonade Cake 
This vibrant Pink Lemonade Cake combines the perfect balance of tart lemon flavor and soft sweetness. Topped with lemon buttercream, its a delightful summer dessert with its refreshing taste and fun pink colorperfect for any celebration!
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
1 cup butter, softened 杻
1.5 cups sugar 
6 egg whites 讀
1.5 cups whole milk 拏
Zest of 2 lemons 
3 tbsp fresh lemon juice 
3.5 cups cake flour 
3.5 tsp baking powder 籠
0.5 tsp salt 蓼
Pink gel food coloring 
For the Lemon Buttercream Frosting:
1 cup butter, softened 杻
4-5 cups powdered sugar, sifted 
Juice and zest of 1 lemon 
1-2 tbsp whole milk or cream 拏
Dash of salt 蓼
Yellow gel food coloring 
Instructions:
1 Preheat Oven:
Preheat to 350F 175C. Butter and line baking pans with parchment paper.
2 Prepare Cake Batter:
Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
In a separate bowl, whisk cake flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add the egg whites and milk to the butter mixture, beating to combine.
Mix in lemon juice, lemon zest, and the dry ingredients, adding in thirds.
Add pink gel food coloring and mix until you reach your desired color.
3 Bake Cake:
Divide the batter evenly among three pans.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
4 Prepare Frosting:
Beat butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, lemon juice, zest, milk, and yellow food coloring. Beat until fluffy.
5 Assemble Cake:
Trim the cake tops if needed.
Layer and frost each cake layer upside down for a flat surface. Frost the top and sides.
Tips:
Add more pink food coloring than you think, as it lightens while baking.
Use parchment paper to ensure the cake doesnt stick to the pans.
Prep Time: 10 minutes  Cook Time: 30 minutes  Total Time: 40 minutes
Calories: 692.5 kcal per serving

Message:
Oreo Sushi Recipe 
A creative and fun snack idea using just Oreos and milk! This sweet ""sushi"" is great for parties or a unique treat for any Oreo lover.
Ingredients:
24 Oreos, separated into cookies and cream filling 懶
1/4 cup milk 拏
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Oreo Dough:
Create Crumbs: Place the Oreo cookies without the cream into a food processor and blitz until they turn into fine crumbs.
Form Dough: Add 3 tablespoons of milk to the crumbs and blend until it forms a dough ball.
2 Shape the Dough:
Roll Out: Lay plastic wrap on a flat surface and press the Oreo dough into a square shape. Use a rolling pin to roll it evenly to about 1/4 inch thick.
Trim: Trim the edges to make a perfect square.
3 Prepare the Filling:
Mix Cream Filling: In a bowl, mix the reserved Oreo cream filling with 2 teaspoons of milk until smooth.
4 Assemble the Sushi:
Spread Filling: Evenly spread the creamy filling over the rolled-out Oreo dough.
Roll Dough: Roll the dough tightly into a log, using the plastic wrap to help you.
5 Chill and Serve:
Chill Optional: Wrap the Oreo roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm it up.
Slice and Serve: Slice the roll into sushi-sized pieces and enjoy!

Description:
Oreo Sushi Recipe 
A creative and fun snack idea using just Oreos and milk! This sweet ""sushi"" is great for parties or a unique treat for any Oreo lover.
Ingredients:
24 Oreos, separated into cookies and cream filling 懶
1/4 cup milk 拏
Instructions:

Roll Out: Lay plastic wrap on a flat surface and press the Oreo dough into a square shape. Use a rolling pin to roll it evenly to about 1/4 inch thick.

Mix Cream Filling: In a bowl, mix the reserved Oreo cream filling with 2 teaspoons of milk until smooth.

Roll Dough: Roll the dough tightly into a log, using the plastic wrap to help you.

Reeses Cheesecake Cookies 
A decadent cookie combining the rich flavors of Reeses peanut butter cups and a creamy cheesecake fillingperfect for any sweet tooth!
Ingredients:
1  cups all-purpose flour 
 teaspoon baking soda 籠
 teaspoon salt 蓼
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
 cup granulated sugar 
 cup brown sugar, packed 
1 large egg 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1 cup mini Reeses peanut butter cups, chopped 樂
4 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup powdered sugar 
 cup Reeses peanut butter chips 樂
 cup semisweet chocolate chips 
Instructions:
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2 In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
3 In a large bowl, cream the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until fluffy.
4 Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until smooth.
5 Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and fold in the chopped Reeses peanut butter cups.
6 In a separate bowl, mix the softened cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy.
7 Roll a tablespoon of cookie dough into a ball, flatten it slightly, add a teaspoon of the cream cheese filling, and top with another tablespoon of dough. Seal the edges.
8 Place the filled cookie dough balls on the baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden.
9 While the cookies cool, melt the peanut butter chips and chocolate chips in separate bowls.
 Drizzle the melted chips over the cooled cookies for a final touch!

Message:
Christmas Cranberry Cake 
This festive cake is inspired by the flavors of Starbucks Cranberry Bliss Bars, packed with tart cranberries and topped with a creamy frosting and white chocolate drizzle. Perfect for the holiday season!
Yield: Serves 12
Prep Time: 30 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hour
Total Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
3 eggs
2 cups sugar
3/4 cup unsalted butter, slightly softened and cut into chunks
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp salt
2 tbsp whole milk
2 cups flour, plus more to coat the cranberries
2 1/2 cups fresh cranberries one 12 oz bag
For the Frosting:
1 stick 1/2 cup butter, softened
8 oz cream cheese, softened
3 cups powdered sugar, sifted add more for desired consistency
1 tsp vanilla extract
Garnish:
Handful of dried cranberries
1/2 cup white chocolate chips
Instructions:
Make the Cake:
Preheat the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease a 9-inch springform pan.
Coat the Cranberries: In a small bowl, toss the fresh cranberries with a handful of flour to coat them completely. Set aside.
Beat the Eggs and Sugar: In a large mixing bowl, beat the eggs and sugar for 5-7 minutes until the mixture has increased in volume and falls in thick ribbons when lifted from the beaters.
Add Butter and Vanilla: Add the softened butter and vanilla extract, and beat for about 2 minutes until well incorporated. Then, beat in the milk and salt.
Stir in Flour and Fold in Cranberries: Gradually stir in 2 cups of flour. Fold in the coated cranberries gently.
Bake: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean cranberry juices may stick to the tester.
Cool: Let the cake cool on a wire rack. Run a knife around the edge and release it from the springform pan.
Prepare the Frosting:
Beat the Cream Cheese and Butter: Using an electric mixer, beat the cream cheese and butter together until smooth and fluffy.
Add the Powdered Sugar: Gradually mix in the powdered sugar, adding about 1 cup at a time until the frosting reaches your desired sweetness and spreadable consistency. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Assemble and Garnish:
Frost the Cake: Once the cake has completely cooled, spread the frosting evenly over the top.
Chill: Refrigerate the frosted cake for about 30 minutes until the frosting is set.
Melt White Chocolate: Melt the white chocolate chips in the microwave in 20-second intervals, stirring until smooth.
Garnish: Sprinkle the top of the cake with dried cranberries. Drizzle the melted white chocolate over the top using a spoon or a makeshift piping bag a zip-top bag with a snipped corner.
Serve: Allow the cake to set before serving. Enjoy!
This Christmas Cranberry Cake is a beautiful and delicious centerpiece for any holiday gathering. The tart cranberries paired with the creamy frosting and white chocolate drizzle will have everyone coming back for seconds! See

Message:
Rainbow Drizzle Macarons 懶
These colorful macarons are perfect for celebrations, with vibrant rainbow frosting and a stunning drizzle design.
Yield: Approx. 24 macarons
Prep Time: 2 hours
Cook Time: 40 minutes
Total Time: 2 hours 40 minutes
Calories: 90 kcal per macaron
Ingredients:
Macaron Shells:
1/3 cup  1 tbsp egg whites
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1 cup  1 tbsp almond flour
1 cup powdered sugar
Black powder food coloring for black shells
White powder food coloring optional, for white shells
Rainbow Drizzle Decoration:
1/4 cup each of candy melt colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple
Rainbow Frosting Filling:
3 oz cream cheese, softened
3 tbsp unsalted butter, softened
1 cup powdered sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Powder food coloring: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple
Instructions:
Prepare the Macaron Shells:
Sift Dry Ingredients: Sift together almond flour and powdered sugar into a bowl. Set aside.
Make the Meringue: Place egg whites and granulated sugar in a heatproof bowl. Whisk continuously over a water bath until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is warm to the touch.
Whip Meringue: Transfer the mixture to a mixer. Beat until stiff peaks form, adding black food coloring or white if making white shells while mixing.
Combine: Gently fold the sifted dry ingredients into the meringue until the batter flows like lava. The batter should fall off the spatula in thick ribbons and smooth out after a few seconds.
Pipe the Macarons: Transfer the batter to a piping bag fitted with a round tip. Pipe circles about 1.5 inches in diameter onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Dry the Shells: Allow the piped shells to sit at room temperature for 20-40 minutes, until a skin forms on the surface and they no longer feel sticky.
Bake: Preheat the oven to 325F 160C. Bake the shells for 15-20 minutes, until the tops are firm. Let them cool completely.
Prepare the Rainbow Drizzle:
Melt the Candy Melts: Melt each color of candy melts red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple in the microwave in 30-second intervals until smooth.
Drizzle the Shells: Transfer each melted color into small piping bags. Drizzle the colors in a rainbow pattern over the cooled macaron shells.
Make the Rainbow Frosting:
Beat the Cream Cheese and Butter: In a medium bowl, beat cream cheese and butter until smooth and creamy.
Add Sugar and Vanilla: Gradually add powdered sugar and vanilla extract, beating until the frosting is light and fluffy.
Color the Frosting: Divide the frosting evenly into separate bowls and color each with a different powder food coloring red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.
Create a Rainbow Log: On a piece of plastic wrap, spread each color of frosting side by side. Roll the plastic wrap into a log, then place the log into a piping bag fitted with a decorative tip.
Assemble the Macarons:
Pipe the Filling: Pipe the rainbow frosting onto half of the macaron shells.
Sandwich: Top each with another shell, pressing gently to create a sandwich.
Tips:
Weigh all ingredients for accuracy: Macarons require precision for best results.
Use gel or powder food coloring: These wont alter the consistency of the batter like liquid coloring can.
Mature the macarons: Let the assembled macarons sit in the fridge overnight for optimal flavor and texture.
For white shells, add white powder food coloring for a brighter finish.
Enjoy these festive and eye-catching Rainbow Drizzle Macarons at your next celebration!

Message:
Boston Cream Pie Cookie Bites Recipe
These bite-sized Boston Cream Pie Cookie Cups combine the classic flavors of the traditional Boston Cream Pie into easy-to-make cookie cups. They have a yellow cake base filled with creamy vanilla pudding and topped with a rich chocolate ganache. Perfect for parties or a fun dessert!
Yield: 36 cookie bites
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 15 minutes
Total Time: 30 minutes
Ingredients:
Cookie Cups:
1 box yellow cake mix
2 eggs
 cup butter, softened
Vanilla Cream:
1 3.25 oz package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 cup heavy whipping cream
 cup milk
Chocolate Ganache:
2 tbsp semi-sweet baking chips
2 tbsp heavy whipping cream
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Cookie Cups:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Grease a mini muffin pan with non-stick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, sift or whisk the yellow cake mix to remove any lumps.
Add the softened butter and eggs to the cake mix and mix until a thick, sticky dough forms.
Using a small cookie scoop or about  tbsp, place a mound of cookie dough into each muffin cup.
Flatten each mound with your fingers to create a level surface.
Bake for 9-11 minutes, or until the edges are slightly golden.
Remove from the oven and immediately run a knife or offset spatula around the edge of each cookie to loosen them from the pan.
Once slightly cooled, press down the center of each cookie with a tart shaper or the back of a spoon to create an indentation for the filling.
Transfer the cookie cups to a cooling rack to cool completely.
2. Make the Vanilla Cream:
In a medium bowl, combine the instant vanilla pudding mix, heavy cream, and milk.
Using a hand mixer or whisk, mix until the pudding thickens and forms stiff peaks.
Transfer the vanilla cream to a pastry bag or Ziploc bag with the corner snipped off.
3. Fill the Cookie Cups:
Pipe a generous amount of vanilla cream into the indentation of each cookie cup.
4. Prepare the Chocolate Ganache:
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the semi-sweet chocolate chips and heavy cream.
Microwave for 20 seconds, then whisk until smooth and silky. If needed, microwave in 10-second increments until you reach the right consistency.
Spoon  teaspoon of ganache onto the top of each cookie cup.
5. Serve:
Refrigerate the cookie bites until the ganache is set. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
These Boston Cream Pie Cookie Bites are a delightful treat with the perfect balance of creamy filling, sweet cake, and chocolate topping. Enjoy

Message:
Black Licorice Ice Cream 
This Black Licorice Ice Cream is a creamy, decadent treat for those who adore the bold flavor of black licorice. The smooth custard base and the intense licorice syrup blend together to create a one-of-a-kind ice cream thats perfect for fans of black licorice and jelly beans.
Yield: 6 Servings
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 45 minutes
Chilling/Freezing Time: 7 hours
Total Time: 8 hours
Ingredients:
4 oz black licorice candy, roughly chopped
1-2 cups water to melt the licorice
4 large egg yolks
 cup granulated sugar
1 cups whole milk
 tsp kosher salt
1 cups heavy cream
1 tsp vanilla extract
Black food coloring optional
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Ice Cream Bowl:
Chill the ice cream machines bowl for at least 24 hours, or until solid. Shake it to check if its readyyou should not hear any water sloshing inside.
2. Make the Licorice Syrup:
Add the black licorice and 1 cup of water to a saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally for about 15 minutes until the licorice melts down into a syrup.
If the water evaporates before the licorice has fully melted, add more water  cup at a time. Aim for about 1 cup of licorice syrup when done.
There may still be small particles of licorice left, which is fine. Set the syrup aside.
3. Prepare the Custard Base:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and granulated sugar until smooth and pale yellow.
In a saucepan, heat the milk and salt over medium heat until it just starts to simmer do not boil. Remove from heat.
Gradually add  cup of the hot milk to the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to temper the eggs and prevent them from cooking.
Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk, along with the black licorice syrup.
4. Thicken the Custard:
Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon about 5-7 minutes.
Strain the custard through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl to remove any small pieces of egg or licorice.
5. Add Final Ingredients:
Stir in the heavy cream, vanilla extract, and black food coloring if using.
Cover the custard with plastic wrap, ensuring the plastic touches the surface to prevent a skin from forming.
Refrigerate the mixture for at least 3 hours, or until fully chilled.
6. Churn the Ice Cream:
Once chilled, churn the ice cream mixture in your ice cream machine according to the manufacturers instructions about 20 minutes or until the consistency of soft-serve ice cream.
7. Freeze the Ice Cream:
Transfer the churned ice cream to a loaf pan. Press a layer of plastic wrap or wax paper on the surface to prevent ice crystals from forming.
Freeze the ice cream for at least 4 hours, or until firm.
8. Serve:
Let the ice cream sit at room temperature for about 5 minutes before scooping and serving.
Notes:
Depending on the type of black licorice you use, it may melt faster or slower than the suggested 15 minutes. Stir frequently to prevent it from burning.
If the licorice doesnt fully melt before the water evaporates, simply add more water in small increments.
Black food coloring is optional. Without it, the ice cream may turn a light brown color instead of the traditional black.
Enjoy this bold and unique dessert!

Message:
Lychee Jelly Cream Puffs 
These Lychee Jelly Cream Puffs feature a crispy choux craquelin shell filled with luscious lychee cream and a refreshing disk of lychee jelly. They are perfect for special occasions or a fun, exotic twist on classic cream puffs!
Ingredients:
Craquelin:
50g butter softened
50g flour
50g sugar
Optional: food coloring
Pâte à Choux Choux Pastry:
70g water
50g butter
60g flour
2 medium eggs
Lychee Cream / Filling:
400g cold heavy whipping cream
2 tbsp sugar
Powdered sugar to taste
12 lychees fresh or canned
2 tbsp lemon juice
4 large lychee jelly cups or 8 small cups
Instructions:
Make the Jelly Disk:
Melt the Lychee Jelly: In a saucepan over low to medium heat, melt the lychee jelly cups carefully, being cautious not to burn them. If desired, you can add food coloring for a vibrant look.
Set the Jelly: Pour the melted jelly into lightly greased muffin pans or silicone molds. Allow it to set in the fridge until firm. Tip: You may need to trim the jelly to fit inside the cream puffs later.
Make Lychee Puree:
Blend Lychees: Blend the lychees until smooth.
Cook the Puree: In a small saucepan, cook the blended lychees with lemon juice and sugar over low to medium heat. Cook until the mixture thickens, then refrigerate. Optional: pass through a sieve for a smoother texture.
Make the Craquelin:
Cream Butter and Sugar: Mix the softened butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add Flour: Stir in the flour until fully combined.
Form the Dough: Roll the dough between two pieces of parchment paper. Chill in the freezer until firm enough to cut into disks.

Add the Flour: Turn off the heat and quickly stir in the flour. Mix vigorously until the dough pulls away from the pan.
Cool the Dough: Let the dough cool for 10 minutes.
Add Eggs: Pour in 1 egg and mix quickly until fully incorporated. In a separate bowl, beat the second egg, then stream it into the dough a little at a time while mixing. Test the consistency of the dough by lifting a spatulathe dough should form a V shape and break off. If too stiff, add a little more egg.

Shape the Choux: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and pipe the choux dough into mounds.
Add the Craquelin Disks: Using the chilled craquelin dough, cut out circular disks and place them on top of each mound of dough.
Bake: Bake at 200C 392F for approximately 20 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed up.
Cool: Let the choux cool completely.
Whip the Cream:
Make the Lychee Cream: Whip the cold heavy cream with sugar until stiff peaks form. Add 3 tablespoons of chilled lychee puree and continue whipping until stiff.
Assembly:
Cut the Tops of the Puffs: Slice off the tops of the cream puffs.
Fill with Lychee Cream: Pipe the lychee cream mixture into the puffs, filling them halfway.
Insert the Jelly Disk: Place a disk of lychee jelly inside each puff.
Top with More Cream: Pipe more lychee cream to fill the puff to the top.
Finish with Whipped Cream: Pipe a swirl of whipped cream on top of each puff and decorate as desired.
Serving Tips:
Decorate: Garnish with extra lychee, edible flowers, or fresh fruit for a beautiful presentation.
Chill: Keep the cream puffs in the fridge before serving to keep them fresh and cool.
These Lychee Jelly Cream Puffs are sure to impress with their crisp shells, creamy lychee filling, and refreshing jelly centerperfect for parties, gatherings, or just a special treat!

Message:
Strawberry Custard Tarts aka Tim Tarts 
These nostalgic Strawberry Custard Tarts, or ""Tim Tarts"" as theyre fondly known in Canada, bring back classic 80s memories. With a buttery pastry shell filled with creamy vanilla custard and topped with fresh strawberries, these tarts are perfect for special occasions like Canada Day or any celebration!
Ingredients:
For the Pastry:
2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 tsp salt
3/4 cup soft butter
1/3 cup white sugar
1 extra-large egg, lightly beaten
For the Vanilla Custard:
3 cups whole milk
1/3 cup all-purpose flour
2/3 cup sugar
Pinch of salt
3 extra-large egg yolks, slightly beaten
4 tbsp butter
1-2 tbsp good-quality vanilla extract
For the Strawberry Glaze Optional:
1/2 cup strawberry jelly or jam
1-2 tbsp water
Instructions:
To Prepare the Pastry:
Cream the butter and sugar: In a bowl, mix the butter and sugar until smooth. Add the beaten egg and mix for another minute until light and fluffy.
Add dry ingredients: Combine the flour and salt in another bowl, then slowly add it to the butter mixture. Mix until a dough forms.
Chill the dough: Divide the dough into two rounds, wrap them in plastic wrap, and let them rest in the fridge for about 1 hour.
Roll and shape the tarts: Roll out the dough on a floured surface and cut out circles that fit your tart pans. Chill the pans in the fridge for 20 minutes. Poke several holes in the bottom of each pastry shell with a fork to prevent puffing.
Bake the shells: Preheat the oven to 400F 200C. Bake the tart shells for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let them cool completely on a wire rack.
To Prepare the Vanilla Custard:
Scald the milk: Heat the milk in the microwave or on the stovetop just until it reaches under boiling point.
Thicken the custard: In a saucepan, combine the flour, sugar, and salt. Slowly whisk in about 1/3 of the scalded milk, stirring constantly over medium heat until the mixture begins to thicken. Add the next 1/3 of the milk, continuing to whisk until thickened again. Repeat with the last third of milk.
Temper the eggs: Remove from heat and slowly pour about 1/2 cup of the mixture into the beaten egg yolks, whisking constantly. Then, pour the egg mixture back into the saucepan and stir constantly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until it reaches a pudding-like consistency.
Finish the custard: Remove from heat, stir in the butter and vanilla extract. Cool completely in the fridge.
To Assemble the Tarts:
Fill the tart shells: Place a whole strawberry in the center of each pastry shell. Transfer the custard to a piping bag or a Ziploc bag with the corner snipped off. Pipe the custard around the strawberry, covering it completely.
Top with strawberries: Place strawberry halves on top of the custard for decoration.
Glaze Optional: To prepare the glaze, microwave the strawberry jelly for 30 seconds, stir, and then brush it over the strawberry halves for a shiny finish.
Enjoy!
Serve chilled or at room temperature. These sweet and creamy tarts are perfect for any special occasion, and their delicious strawberry topping makes them irresistible!
These Strawberry Custard Tarts are not only tasty but also fun to make and share. Celebrate a classic Canadian treat with family and friends!

Message:
Strawberry Crunch Cheesecake No Bake 
This Strawberry Crunch Cheesecake is a no-bake dessert that features layers of creamy strawberry and vanilla cheesecake on a buttery Golden Oreo crust, topped with a delightful strawberry crunch crumble. Its perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
Crust:
24 Golden Oreo cookies 
4 tbsp salted butter, melted 杻
Cheesecake Filling:
24 oz cream cheese 3 packages, softened 燎
2 cups powdered sugar 
2 tsp lemon juice 
1 cup fresh strawberries, puréed 
2 tsp vanilla extract 
1  cups heavy whipping cream 拏
Strawberry Crunch Topping:
Prepare separately or use store-bought strawberry shortcake crumble
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Crust:
Crush Golden Oreos in a food processor or place in a Ziploc bag and crush using a rolling pin.
Mix crushed cookies with melted butter until the crumbs are well-moistened.
Spray a 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray. Press the crust mixture evenly into the bottom and about 1 inch up the sides of the pan.
Place the pan in the freezer while you prepare the cheesecake filling.
2 Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large bowl, mix together softened cream cheese, vanilla extract, lemon juice, and powdered sugar with an electric mixer until smooth.
In a separate bowl, use a mixer to beat heavy whipping cream until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture, being careful not to deflate the whipped cream.
3 Create Two Layers:
Divide the cheesecake filling mixture in half. Set one half aside.
To the first half, fold in the puréed strawberries until fully combined.
4 Assemble the Cheesecake:
Pour the strawberry cheesecake mixture into the prepared crust, smoothing the surface.
Layer the plain cheesecake mixture on top, smoothing the surface again.
Cover the cheesecake with plastic wrap and place it in the freezer for at least 4-5 hours, or overnight, until fully set.
5 Add the Strawberry Crunch Topping:
Remove the cheesecake from the freezer and carefully remove the springform pan.
Coat the top and sides of the cheesecake with strawberry crunch topping.
Return the cheesecake to the freezer until ready to serve. Before slicing, allow it to thaw for 10-15 minutes for easier cutting.
Enjoy this no-bake strawberry cheesecake bursting with fruity flavor and a delicious crunch! 
#NoBakeCheesecake #StrawberryCheesecake #SummerDessert #CheesecakeLovers #StrawberryCrunch

Message:
Keto Panna Cotta 
This simple and creamy keto panna cotta is the perfect low-carb dessert. With only 2g of net carbs per serving and requiring just 5 ingredients, its both quick and delicious!
Yield: 8 servings
Prep Time: 5 minutes
Cook Time: 5 minutes
Chill Time: 4 hours
Total Time: 10 minutes plus chilling
Ingredients:
1 tablespoon gelatin 1 envelope
2 tablespoons cold water
2 cups heavy cream
1 cup milk of choice e.g., unsweetened coconut milk
1/3 cup allulose or preferred keto sweetener
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
Instructions:
Prepare Gelatin:
Lightly grease eight 1/2-cup or four 1-cup ramekins and set them aside. In a small bowl, whisk together the gelatin and cold water. Let it sit to thicken.
Heat Cream Mixture:
In a saucepan, add the heavy cream, milk, allulose, and vanilla extract. Heat over medium heat, stirring regularly, until it begins to boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to very low and simmer for a few minutes.
Combine with Gelatin:
Remove the saucepan from heat and whisk in the thickened gelatin mixture until fully combined and smooth.
Distribute:
Pour the panna cotta mixture into the prepared ramekins and allow them to cool to room temperature. Once cooled, refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until firm.
Serve:
To serve, run a slightly wet knife around the edges of the ramekins for easy removal. Turn each ramekin upside down onto a plate and enjoy your keto panna cotta!
Tip: Garnish with fresh berries or a sugar-free syrup for extra flavor!

Message:
Orange Cheesecake 
Samanthas Orange Cheesecake is a delightful treat that captures the refreshing flavor of orange creamsicle with the indulgent creaminess of classic cheesecake. This dessert is perfect for any occasion, providing a citrusy twist thats sure to impress!
Ingredients:
Crust:
1 cup graham cracker crumbs 
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
Cheesecake:
750 grams cream cheese, softened 燎
1 cup sugar 
 cup vanilla yogurt 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
 tsp salt 蓼
Zest from 3 oranges 
 cup fresh squeezed orange juice 
4 large eggs 讀
Instructions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven 
1 Preheat your oven to 325F 160C and spray a 9-inch springform pan with non-stick spray. Set aside.
Step 2: Prepare the Crust 籠
2 In a bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Mix until well combined, then press the mixture firmly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
Step 3: Make the Cheesecake Filling 
3 In the bowl of a stand mixer or a large bowl using a hand mixer, add the cream cheese and mix until smooth and creamy.
4 Gradually add the sugar and mix until fully incorporated.
5 Add the vanilla yogurt, vanilla extract, salt, orange juice, and orange zest. Mix until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 4: Incorporate the Eggs 讀
6 With the mixer on low speed, add the eggs one at a time, mixing just until barely incorporated after each addition. Be careful not to overmix.
Step 5: Bake the Cheesecake 
7 Pour the cheesecake batter into the prepared springform pan. To prevent leaks, place the springform pan on a cookie sheet lined with foil.
8 Place the cheesecake in the preheated oven on the center rack and bake for 85-90 minutes. The edges should be slightly puffed and golden, while the center should jiggle like jello but spring back to the touch.
Step 6: Cool the Cheesecake 
9 Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. Gently use a knife to loosen the sides of the cheesecake from the springform pan to prevent cracking as it cools.
 Allow the cheesecake to cool for an additional 2 hours at room temperature. Then transfer it to the refrigerator and chill for 6 hours or overnight.
Step 7: Serve 
11 Once chilled, cut the cheesecake into 10 equal slices and enjoy!
Prep Time: 12 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hour 25 minutes
Total Time: 3 hours 37 minutes
Servings: 16 slices
Calories: 296 kcal per slice
Enjoy this refreshing Orange Cheesecake thats sure to brighten any gathering!

9 Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. Gently use a knife to loosen the sides of the cheesecake from the springform pan to prevent cracking as it cools.
 Allow the cheesecake to cool for an additional 2 hours at room temperature. Then transfer it to the refrigerator and chill for 6 hours or overnight.
Step 7: Serve 
11 Once chilled, cut the cheesecake into 10 equal slices and enjoy!

9 Prep Pan: If needed, grease the sides of your cheesecake pan.
 Beat Cream Cheese: In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese for about 3 minutes until creamy.

Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake Roulade 
Indulge in this delightful Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake Rouladea luscious combination of rich chocolate cake and creamy peanut butter filling. Perfect for any chocolate lover, this cake roll is sure to impress with its stunning presentation and mouthwatering flavor!
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 cups granulated sugar 
2 cups unsweetened cocoa powder 
1 teaspoons baking powder 離
 teaspoon salt 蓼
2 cups unsalted butter, softened 杻
3 large eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
2 cups milk 拏
For the Peanut Butter Filling:
 cup creamy peanut butter 樂
1 cups powdered sugar 
2 cups heavy cream 
Directions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven 
1 Set your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Prepare the Dry Ingredients 籠
2 In a bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar 療
3 In a separate large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract and milk until combined.
Step 4: Combine Mixtures 
4 Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the butter mixture until just incorporated.
Step 5: Bake the Cake 
5 Pour the batter into the prepared baking sheet, spreading it evenly. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow it to cool slightly.
Step 6: Make the Peanut Butter Filling 樂
6 In a bowl, mix the creamy peanut butter and powdered sugar until smooth. In another bowl, whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the peanut butter mixture until well combined.
Step 7: Assemble the Roulade 
7 Once the cake has cooled, carefully invert it onto a clean kitchen towel dusted with cocoa powder. Peel off the parchment paper, then spread the peanut butter filling evenly over the cake. Starting from one edge, roll the cake into a log shape using the towel to assist.
Step 8: Chill and Serve 
8 Wrap the cake roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour. Once chilled, slice and enjoy your delicious chocolate peanut butter cake roulade!

Message:
Banana Caramel Cupcakes with Caramel Cream Cheese Frosting 
These banana caramel cupcakes are a delicious combination of moist banana cake, filled with rich homemade caramel sauce, and topped with creamy caramel-infused cream cheese frosting. The cupcakes are garnished with toffee bits and fresh banana slices for an irresistible finish!
Ingredients
Homemade Caramel Sauce:
Use your favorite caramel sauce recipe or a store-bought version.
For the Banana Cupcakes:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon optional
1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
3/4 cup granulated sugar
1/4 cup light brown sugar, packed
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1/2 cup sour cream, room temperature
1 1/2 tsp pure vanilla extract
2 large eggs, room temperature
2-3 overripe large bananas, puréed or mashed about 1 1/2 cups
For the Salted Caramel Cream Cheese Frosting:
Use your preferred recipe or adapt it with caramel sauce from above.
Optional Garnishes:
Toffee bits
Extra caramel sauce
Fresh banana slices
Instructions
1 Make the Caramel Sauce:
Prepare a batch of homemade caramel sauce and let it chill in the refrigerator while you bake the cupcakes.
2 Banana Cupcakes:
Preheat the oven: to 350F 177C. Line a standard 12-cup cupcake pan and a second pan with 5 liners this recipe makes about 17 cupcakes.
Mix dry ingredients: In a large bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon if using. Whisk to combine and set aside.
Cream butter and sugars: In the bowl of a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, beat the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy 2-3 minutes. Scrape down the bowl.
Add wet ingredients: Mix in the oil, sour cream, and vanilla until combined.
Incorporate eggs: Lower the mixer speed and add eggs one at a time, beating until fully incorporated and scraping down the sides as needed.
Add dry ingredients and banana: Gradually add the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in the banana purée, being careful not to overmix. The batter will be thick.
Fill cupcake liners: Scoop batter into cupcake liners, filling each about 2/3 full.
Bake: Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let the cupcakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
3 Make the Salted Caramel Cream Cheese Frosting:
Prepare your frosting using caramel sauce from earlier, or your favorite recipe. Adjust sweetness to taste.
4 Assemble the Cupcakes:
Core the cupcakes optional: If desired, core the center of each cupcake using the bottom of a piping tip or an apple corer.
Fill with caramel: Spoon or pipe caramel sauce into the cored centers of the cupcakes.
Frost the cupcakes: Use two piping bagsone fitted with a large round tip and the other with a star tip. First, pipe an even layer of frosting with the round tip, smoothing the top with an offset spatula and rolling in toffee bits. Then, use the star tip to swirl a decorative layer on top.
Garnish: Drizzle additional caramel sauce over the frosting and garnish with fresh banana slices and more toffee bits if desired.
Enjoy these luscious Banana Caramel Cupcakes!

Spiced Peach Cobbler Cinnamon Rolls with Creamy Frosting 葉
Indulge in these soft, spiced cinnamon rolls filled with juicy peaches and topped with a rich, creamy frosting. Perfect for breakfast, brunch, or dessert on cozy mornings!
Ingredients
For the Dough:
1 cup warm milk about 110F
2 tsp active dry yeast
 cup granulated sugar
 cup melted butter 杻
1 tsp salt
2 large eggs 讀
4 cups all-purpose flour
For the Filling:
2 cups diced peaches fresh or canned 
 cup brown sugar
2 tsp ground cinnamon
For the Frosting:
4 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup butter, softened 杻
1 cup powdered sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Directions
Prepare the Dough:
Activate the Yeast: Dissolve the yeast in warm milk with a pinch of sugar. Let it sit for about 5 minutes until frothy.
Mix Ingredients: In a large bowl, combine sugar, melted butter, salt, eggs, and flour. Add the yeast mixture and knead the dough until smooth.
Let Rise: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Make the Filling:
Prepare Peaches: In a bowl, mix the diced peaches with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Assemble the Rolls:
Roll Out the Dough: Roll the dough into a large rectangle on a lightly floured surface.
Add the Filling: Spread the peach mixture evenly over the dough.
Roll and Slice: Roll the dough tightly from the long side, then cut it into 12 even slices.
Let Rise: Place the rolls in a greased baking dish, cover, and let them rise for 30 minutes.
Bake the Rolls:
Preheat Oven: Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
Bake Rolls: Bake the rolls for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Prepare the Frosting:
Mix Ingredients: Beat together the cream cheese, softened butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
Finish the Rolls:
Frost the Rolls: Drizzle the creamy frosting generously over the warm rolls before serving.
Prep Time: 30 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Total Time: 55 minutes
Yield: 12 servings
Calories: 320 kcal per serving
Enjoy these Spiced Peach Cobbler Cinnamon Rolls for a cozy morning treat or a special occasion!  The soft rolls with sweet peaches and cinnamon, topped with creamy frosting, are sure to be a hit!

Message:
Cookie Dough Cheesecake 
This Cookie Dough Cheesecake is the ultimate dessert for cookie dough lovers! It combines creamy cheesecake with chunks of edible cookie dough and chocolate chips, topped with whipped cream and mini cookies for extra indulgence.
Ingredients
For the Cookie Dough:
200g unsalted butter
120g brown sugar
120g granulated sugar
2 tsp vanilla extract
2 eggs
300g plain flour
50g corn flour
 tsp salt
 tsp baking powder
 tsp baking soda
 tsp ground cinnamon optional
150g chocolate chips
For the Cheesecake:
600g full-fat cream cheese
150g granulated sugar
45g corn flour
2 tsp vanilla extract
220ml double cream, warm
120g white chocolate, melted
100g chocolate chips
Extras:
Whipped cream optional, for piping on top
Mini cookies optional, for topping
Directions
Making the Cookie Dough:
Preheat your oven to 180C 350F and grease an 8-inch cake tin. Line the bottom and sides with baking paper.
Brown the butter: In a pot, heat the butter over medium heat, stirring until it turns light brown. Once it begins foaming and then subsides, remove it from heat and transfer the brown butter to a large bowl.
Add both sugars and vanilla extract to the browned butter. Whisk vigorously for about 1 minute. Add eggs and whisk again for 30 seconds.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon if using. Slowly add this mixture into the wet ingredients, mixing until no flour remains visible.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Weigh out 200g of the cookie dough and place it in the fridge for later use.
Spread the remaining cookie dough into the prepared tin, then bake for 20-25 minutes until slightly brown on top. It wont be fully cooked yet. Let it cool completely.
Making the Cheesecake:
Lower the oven temperature to 170C 325F.
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, sugar, corn flour, and vanilla extract until smooth and combined.
Add half of the warm double cream and whisk until combined, then add the remaining cream and continue whisking.
Whisk in melted white chocolate until fully incorporated.
Take the cookie dough that was set aside in the fridge and roll it into small balls. Gently fold these cookie dough balls and chocolate chips into the cheesecake batter.
Pour the cheesecake batter over the slightly baked cookie dough crust. Smooth the top.
Baking the Cheesecake:
Place the cake tin in a larger roasting pan with high sides. Carefully pour boiling water into the larger pan until it reaches about halfway up the cheesecake tin.
Bake the cheesecake in the oven at 170C 325F for 45-50 minutes, until the edges are set but the center remains slightly jiggly.
After baking, turn off the oven and leave the cheesecake in the oven with the door slightly open for 1 hour.
Once cooled, remove from the oven and let the cheesecake cool completely. Then refrigerate for overnight to fully set.
The Next Day:
After the cheesecake has set, carefully remove it from the springform tin.
Decorate with whipped cream and mini cookies, if desired.
Slice, serve, and enjoy your delicious Cookie Dough Cheesecake!
Prep Time: 25 minutes plus chilling overnight
Cook Time: 50 minutes
Servings: 8-10 slices
Calories: Approximately 400-500 kcal per slice depending on toppings
This Cookie Dough Cheesecake is a dream dessert for those who love the sweet, chewy texture of cookie dough and the smooth, creamy richness of cheesecake. Perfect for celebrations or indulgent treats!

Message:
Jelly Roll Topped Cheesecake 
This Jelly Roll Topped Cheesecake is the ultimate dessert fusion, combining the rich, creamy texture of cheesecake with the light, fluffy sponge of a jelly roll. Finished with a sweet jam swirl and topped with whipped cream, its a showstopper for any occasion!
Ingredients
For the Cheesecake:
2 cups graham cracker crumbs
 cup unsalted butter, melted
2 tbsp granulated sugar
4 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
 cup sour cream
4 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp lemon juice optional
For the Jelly Roll Cake:
3 large eggs
1 cup granulated sugar
 cup water
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
 tsp salt
 cup strawberry or raspberry jam
For the Topping:
Whipped cream for garnish
Icing drizzle 1 cup powdered sugar  2 tbsp milk
Extra jam optional
Directions
1 Prepare the Cheesecake:
Preheat the oven to 325F 160C and grease a 9-inch springform pan.
In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar. Press into the bottom of the pan to form the crust.
In a large mixing bowl, beat softened cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar, sour cream, vanilla, and lemon juice. Mix well until combined.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing gently after each addition to avoid overmixing.
Pour the cheesecake batter over the crust and bake for 50-60 minutes or until set. Let it cool in the oven with the door cracked for 1 hour, then chill in the fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight.
2 Prepare the Jelly Roll Cake:
Preheat the oven to 375F 190C and line a 10x15-inch jelly roll pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs for about 5 minutes until frothy and pale. Gradually add sugar, then water, and vanilla. Continue beating until smooth.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gently fold into the egg mixture, being careful not to deflate the batter.
Spread the batter evenly in the prepared pan and bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Once baked, roll the warm cake in a towel dusted with powdered sugar. Allow it to cool completely, then unroll the cake and spread jam on top. Re-roll the cake tightly.
3 Assemble the Cheesecake:
Once the cheesecake has fully chilled, remove it from the springform pan.
Slice the jelly roll cake into 1-inch slices and arrange the slices on top of the cheesecake.
Drizzle the icing powdered sugar mixed with milk over the jelly roll slices and garnish with whipped cream.
Optional: Add extra jam for a more pronounced fruity topping.
Serve & Enjoy!
Each bite of this Jelly Roll Topped Cheesecake combines the rich flavor of creamy cheesecake with the light texture of the jelly roll and a burst of jam sweetness. Perfect for any special celebration or just a treat to share with family and friends!
Prep Time: 45 minutes
Calories: 450 kcal per slice

Message:
Red Velvet Cheesecake 
This Red Velvet Cheesecake is a show-stopping dessert perfect for any special occasion. With a rich, creamy cheesecake filling on an Oreo cookie crust and topped with velvety cream cheese frosting, this cake is sure to impress.
Ingredients
For the Crust:
2  cups 250 g crushed Oreo cookies about 30 cookies
5 tbsp unsalted butter, melted
For the Cheesecake:
32 oz 908 g cream cheese, softened
1  cups 267 g granulated sugar
 cup 42 g unsweetened cocoa powder
1 cup 227 g sour cream, room temperature
1 tbsp white vinegar
1 tbsp vanilla extract
1-2 oz red food coloring adjust to desired shade
4 large eggs, room temperature, lightly beaten
For the Frosting:
4 oz 113 g cream cheese, softened
 cup 56 g unsalted butter, softened
2 cups 260 g confectioners sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
Instructions
1 Make the Crust:
Preheat the oven to 350F and move the oven rack to the lower third position just below the center.
Wrap the outer bottom of a 9-inch springform pan tightly with two layers of heavy-duty aluminum foil to prevent leaks.
Combine the Oreo cookie crumbs and melted butter. Press the mixture into the bottom and about 2 inches up the sides of the pan.
Bake for 10 minutes and set aside to cool while you prepare the cheesecake filling.
2 Make the Cheesecake Filling:
Reduce the oven temperature to 300F.
In a stand mixer or with a handheld mixer, beat the cream cheese on medium-low speed until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.
Add sugar and cocoa powder, mixing on medium-low speed until fully combined.
Add sour cream, white vinegar, vanilla extract, and red food coloring. Mix until smooth.
Gently stir in the lightly beaten eggs using a silicone spatula just until incorporated.
Pour the batter over the cooled crust.
Set the cheesecake inside a large roasting pan. Carefully fill the roasting pan with enough boiling water to come halfway up the sides of the springform pan.
Bake for 1 hour, or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly. Turn the oven off and leave the cheesecake in the water bath for 1 more hour.
Remove the cheesecake from the water bath and place it on a wire rack. Run a small knife around the edge of the cheesecake to loosen it from the pan, then let it cool completely.
Once cooled, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
3 Make the Frosting:
In a stand mixer or with a handheld mixer, beat together cream cheese and butter until smooth and creamy.
Add confectioners sugar and vanilla extract, beating on low speed until just combined. Increase to medium speed and beat until smooth.
Spread the frosting over the chilled cheesecake.
Serving & Enjoying:
Once the cheesecake is fully chilled, remove the sides of the springform pan. Slice and serve with a dollop of whipped cream or fresh berries if desired.
Prep Time: 1 hour 25 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hour 17 minutes
Additional Time: 4 hours for chilling
Total Time: 6 hours 42 minutes
Servings: 12
This Red Velvet Cheesecake combines the flavors of classic red velvet cake with creamy cheesecake, all topped with a luxurious cream cheese frosting. Its a decadent and beautiful dessert thats perfect for celebrations or as a special treat!

Message:
No-Bake Key Lime Parfaits 㮝
These Key Lime Parfaits are the perfect blend of creamy, tangy lime filling with a buttery graham cracker crust. A light, refreshing dessert thats easy to make and perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients
For the Graham Cracker Crust:
1  cups graham cracker crumbs
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
For the Key Lime Filling:
1 cup cold heavy cream
12 ounces cream cheese, softened
1 cup sweetened condensed milk
 cup freshly squeezed key lime juice or regular lime juice
For the Topping:
 cup heavy cream
2 tablespoons confectioners sugar
Lime zest for garnish
Instructions
1 Prepare the Graham Cracker Crust:
In a bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs with melted butter until fully blended.
Use your fingers to ensure an even mix. Set the mixture aside.
2 Make the Key Lime Filling:
In a food processor, whip the cold heavy cream until it thickens and holds its shape. Be careful not to over-whip.
Add the cream cheese, breaking it into chunks as you add it. Process until smooth.
Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and key lime juice. Process until everything is creamy and well combined.
3 Assemble the Parfaits:
In each of the 6 parfait jars or glasses, layer the ingredients as follows:
Start with 2 tablespoons of the graham cracker mixture at the bottom.
Add about  cup of the key lime mixture on top.
Repeat the layers with 2 more tablespoons of crumbs, followed by another  cup of lime mixture.
4 Chill:
Cover the parfaits and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or longer if desired to allow the flavors to set.
5 Prepare the Topping:
Before serving, whip the heavy cream with confectioners sugar until soft peaks form.
6 Serve:
Top each parfait with whipped cream and garnish with lime zest for a fresh pop of flavor.
Enjoy! 㮝
These Key Lime Parfaits are a cool, delicious treat perfect for warm days or any time youre craving a refreshing dessert!

Message:
Luxurious Chocolate Caramel Pecan Cake 
This Luxurious Chocolate Caramel Pecan Cake is the ultimate indulgence, combining rich chocolate cake layers with caramel sauce, crunchy pecans, and sweet coconut, all topped with a silky chocolate ganache. Perfect for any special occasion, this cake is a decadent treat that will wow your guests!
Ingredients
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 cups granulated sugar 
 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 
2 tsp baking powder 籠
1  tsp baking soda 籠
1 tsp salt 蓼
1 cup buttermilk, room temperature 拏
 cup vegetable oil 
2 large eggs, room temperature 讀讀
2 tsp vanilla extract 
1 cup boiling water 
For the Caramel Pecan Filling:
1  cups caramel sauce 
1 cup chopped pecans 
1 cup sweetened shredded coconut 便
For the Ganache:
1 cup chocolate ganache melted chocolate mixed with heavy cream 
Instructions
1 Prepare the Cake:
Preheat the oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour three 9-inch round cake pans.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the buttermilk, vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla extract to the flour mixture. Beat on medium speed until well combined.
Reduce the mixer speed to low and carefully add the boiling water to the batter. Mix until smooth.
Divide the batter evenly among the prepared cake pans.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cakes comes out clean. Allow cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then remove from the pans and cool completely on a wire rack.
2 Assemble the Cake:
Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread  cup of caramel sauce over the top. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup of chopped pecans and 1/3 cup of shredded coconut.
Place the second cake layer on top and repeat the process: Spread with  cup of caramel sauce, and sprinkle with 1/3 cup of pecans and 1/3 cup of shredded coconut.
Place the third cake layer on top. Spread the chocolate ganache evenly over the top and sides of the cake. Sprinkle with the remaining pecans and coconut.
Finally, drizzle the remaining caramel sauce over the top.
Enjoy
Dive into this indulgent, layered masterpiece of rich chocolate, creamy caramel, crunchy pecans, and sweet coconut! 
Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or any occasion when you want to impress and delight.

Message:
Peach Cobbler Cheesecake Cones 
These Peach Cobbler Cheesecake Cones are an irresistible treat featuring crispy waffle cones filled with layers of creamy cheesecake filling and warm peach cobbler. Perfect for a unique dessert twist, these cones combine the best of fruity cobbler and rich cheesecake!
Ingredients:
For the Cones:
16 oz cream-filled cookies vanilla, chocolate, or wafer cookies 
12 waffle cones 
3 tbsp whipped cream 療
For the Peach Cobbler:
48 oz sliced peaches with juice 
1 box of cake mix yellow, white, French vanilla, or butter pecan 
1 cup salted butter 杻
1  tsp cinnamon 
For the Cheesecake Filling:
1 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
1 cup confectioners sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
16 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 tsp lemon juice 
Instructions:
1 Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C.
2 Prepare the Cones:
Melt chocolate in the microwave at 30-second intervals.
Dip the top or bottom of each cone into the melted chocolate, and drizzle a little inside to coat the base.
Pulse cookies in a food processor until they turn into fine crumbs. Dip the chocolate-coated cone into the crumbs or sprinkle them over the cone.
3 Assemble the Peach Cobbler:
Spray a 913 inch baking dish.
Pour in the sliced peaches with juice.
Evenly sprinkle the dry cake mix over the peaches.
Melt the butter and drizzle it over the cake mix. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake in the oven for 45 to 55 minutes, or until the cobbler is golden and bubbling.
4 Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a bowl, whip the heavy cream until it forms thick, stiff peaks.
In another bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, confectioners sugar, vanilla extract, and lemon juice. Beat until smooth and creamy.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the cheesecake mixture.
5 Assemble the Cones:
Take a prepared waffle cone and alternately spoon layers of cheesecake filling and warm peach cobbler into the cone.
Drizzle with melted chocolate and sprinkle with crushed cookie crumbs for added texture and flair.
Enjoy these fun, hand-held desserts for a special treat that combines the best of cheesecake and peach cobbler!

Message:
Pina Colada Cheesecake Bars 
Transport yourself to a tropical paradise with these Pina Colada Cheesecake Bars! A delicious graham cracker crust is layered with creamy coconut cheesecake, a luscious pineapple topping, and finished off with whipped cream, toasted coconut, and maraschino cherries. Perfect for summer gatherings!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1  cups graham cracker crumbs 
 cup sugar 
6 tablespoons butter, melted 杻
For the Cheesecake Filling:
2 8 oz blocks cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup sugar 
1 cup coconut milk 便
3 large eggs 讀
 cup sweetened shredded coconut 便
For the Pineapple Layer:
2 boxes 3 oz each pineapple gelatin 
 cup boiling water 
2 boxes 3.4 oz each vanilla instant pudding & pie filling mix 
2  cups cold milk 拏
For the Topping:
1 8 oz container whipped topping 療
1 cup sweetened shredded coconut, toasted 便
12 maraschino cherries 
Instructions:
1 Prepare the Crust:
Preheat oven to 325F 163C.
In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
Press the mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for about 12 minutes, or until just golden. Set aside to cool.
2 Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar until fluffy using an electric mixer.
Add the coconut milk and eggs, mixing until well combined.
Stir in the shredded coconut.
Pour the cheesecake mixture over the cooled crust and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before placing in the fridge to chill for 2 hours.
3 Prepare the Pineapple Layer:
In a small bowl, whisk together the pineapple gelatin with boiling water until most of the gelatin is dissolved.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the vanilla pudding mix and cold milk until combined.
Stir the pineapple gelatin mixture into the pudding mixture until smooth.
Pour this layer over the chilled cheesecake and chill again for 5 minutes.
4 Make the Topping:
Toast the shredded coconut in a dry pan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until golden brown.
Spread the whipped topping over the chilled pineapple layer, then sprinkle the toasted coconut on top.
Garnish with maraschino cherries.
5 Chill & Serve:
Chill for an additional 2 hours before slicing and serving.
Enjoy your tropical escape with these decadent cheesecake bars! 
#PinaColadaBars #TropicalDessert #CheesecakeLovers #SummerTreat

Pina Colada Cheesecake Mousse 
This creamy and tropical Pina Colada Cheesecake Mousse brings together the delicious flavors of pineapple and coconut, layered with a toasted graham cracker and coconut crumble. A no-bake treat thats perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
For the Crumble:
9 graham crackers 
1  cups sweetened shredded coconut 便
2 teaspoons sugar 
6 tablespoons butter, melted 杻
For the Pineapple Cheesecake Mousse:
1  cups heavy cream 拏

Message:
Blueberry Lavender Lemonade 
A refreshing and unique twist on classic lemonade, this Blueberry Lavender Lemonade combines the floral essence of lavender with the sweet and tangy flavor of blueberries. Perfect for a summer gathering or a relaxing afternoon!
Ingredients:
2 cups blueberries plus  cup for garnish 𢡄
1  cups sugar 
1  cups water 
3 tbsp dried lavender 
1  cups lemon juice 
6 cups filtered water 
Fresh mint for garnish 
Directions:
1 Make the Blueberry Lavender Syrup:
Combine the blueberries, sugar, water, and dried lavender in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Stir together and let the blueberries cook down for about 8-10 minutes.
Mash the blueberries and continue to cook for another 5 minutes.
2 Strain the Syrup:
Use a fine mesh sieve to strain the syrup into a heat-safe bowl. Press the blueberry mixture to release as much juice as possible.
3 Continue to Cook:
Pour the syrup back into the saucepan and cook for an additional 10 minutes to thicken it.
Remove from heat and allow it to cool.
4 Mix the Lemonade:
In a pitcher, combine the lemon juice, filtered water, and the blueberry lavender syrup.
Stir well to mix everything together.
5 Garnish & Chill:
Add the remaining  cup of blueberries and some fresh mint leaves for garnish.
Place the pitcher in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Serve chilled and enjoy the floral, fruity goodness of this Blueberry Lavender Lemonade! 𢡄

Message:
Chocolate Strawberry Mousse Cake Parfaits 
These decadent parfaits feature layers of chocolate cake, fresh strawberry mousse, and a strawberry compote, all topped with a chocolate-covered strawberry. Perfect for any dessert lover!
Ingredients:
For the Chocolate Cake Base:
1 chocolate cake store-bought or homemade , cut into cubes
For the Strawberry Mousse:
1 cup freeze-dried strawberries 
1 cup heavy cream 拏
3 tablespoons powdered sugar 
1 teaspoon LorAnn Strawberry Bakery Emulsion 
For the Strawberry Compote:
1 cup fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced 
2 tablespoons sugar 
2 tablespoons water 
1 teaspoon lemon juice 
For the Chocolate-Covered Strawberries:
Fresh strawberries, washed and dried 
Semi-sweet chocolate chips 
Directions:
1 Prepare the Strawberry Mousse:
Pulse freeze-dried strawberries in a food processor or blender until finely ground into powder.
In a mixing bowl, whip heavy cream, powdered sugar, and strawberry emulsion until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold in the strawberry powder until well combined. Set aside.
2 Make the Strawberry Compote:
In a saucepan, combine the sliced strawberries, sugar, water, and lemon juice.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the strawberries break down and the mixture thickens slightly about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
3 Chocolate-Covered Strawberries:
Melt the semi-sweet chocolate chips in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each.
Dip each strawberry into the melted chocolate and place them on a parchment-lined sheet to set.
4 Assemble the Parfaits:
Layer chocolate cake cubes at the bottom of each serving glass.
Spoon a layer of strawberry mousse over the cake, followed by a layer of strawberry compote and fresh strawberries.
Repeat the layers until the glasses are filled, ending with a dollop of strawberry mousse on top.
5 Garnish:
Top each parfait with a chocolate-covered strawberry for an elegant finishing touch!
These delightful parfaits are perfect for indulging in layers of chocolate and strawberry goodness. Enjoy!

Message:
Strawberry Cheesecake Cupcakes 
These Strawberry Cheesecake Cupcakes are filled with a creamy no-bake cheesecake center and topped with homemade strawberry buttercream. Perfect for spring celebrations!
Yield:
Servings: 24 cupcakes
Prep Time: 30 minutes
Cook Time: 18 minutes
Total Time: 48 minutes
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1 box strawberry cake mix 
1 3.4 oz instant strawberry pudding mix 
 cup oil 
4 large eggs 讀
1 cup milk 拏
For the Cheesecake Filling:
1 3.4 oz package instant cheesecake pudding mix 
 cup milk 拏
4 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
1  cups Cool Whip, thawed from an 8 oz container
For the Strawberry Buttercream:
 cup shortening 杻
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
 tsp salt 蓼
 tsp vanilla extract 
 tsp strawberry extract 
 cup diced ripe strawberries 
5-6 cups powdered sugar 
24 whole strawberries 
48 graham cracker cookie sticks 
Instructions:
1 Preheat the oven:
Set the oven to 325F. Line muffin tins with 24 cupcake liners.
2 Prepare the Cupcakes:
In a large bowl, beat the cake mix, pudding mix, oil, milk, and eggs for 2 minutes.
Spoon the batter into the prepared muffin tins and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the tops spring back when touched.
Cool the cupcakes on a wire rack.
3 Cheesecake Filling:
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and cheesecake pudding mix until thick.
Beat the cream cheese until smooth, then add the pudding mixture and mix again. Fold in the whipped topping.
Use a cupcake corer or a small knife to cut out the center of each cupcake. Pipe the cheesecake filling into the centers. Refrigerate the cupcakes while making the frosting.
4 Strawberry Buttercream:
Beat the shortening and butter together until creamy. Add the salt, vanilla, and strawberry extract, then mix again.
Slowly add half of the powdered sugar, mixing until smooth.
Puree the diced strawberries in a food processor or blender, adding 1 tablespoon of water if the strawberries arent juicy enough.
Add the strawberry puree to the frosting and beat until creamy. Add the remaining powdered sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
5 Assemble the Cupcakes:
Use a large piping bag fitted with icing tip 1M to swirl the strawberry frosting on the chilled cupcakes.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Before serving, top each cupcake with a fresh strawberry and two graham cracker cookie sticks.
Enjoy these flavorful, spring-ready cupcakes with a creamy cheesecake surprise inside! 療

Message:
Cookie Dough Bars 
These No-Bake Cookie Dough Bars are an easy, egg-free treat loaded with chocolate chips and M&Ms, perfect for sharing or enjoying on your own!
Ingredients:
Cookie Dough
10 tablespoons salted butter softened 杻
 cup brown sugar 
 teaspoon vanilla extract 
2 cups all-purpose flour baked at 350F for 5 minutes 
14 oz can sweetened condensed milk 拏
1 cup miniature chocolate chips 
1 cup miniature M&Ms 
Cooking spray 林
Topping
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 
2 tablespoons salted butter 杻
 cup miniature M&Ms 
Instructions:
1 Prep the Pan:
Line an 8 x 8 baking dish with parchment paper and spray it with cooking spray. Set aside.
2 Mix the Cookie Dough:
In a large bowl, beat together the softened butter and brown sugar with a hand mixer until light and fluffy.
Add the vanilla extract and continue beating for another minute.
Gradually add the baked flour and sweetened condensed milk, alternating between the two while mixing on low speed until a soft dough forms.
3 Fold in the Goodies:
Use a spatula to fold in the chocolate chips and M&Ms into the dough. Spread the dough evenly into the prepared baking dish.
4 Freeze the Bars:
Freeze the dough for 30 minutes to firm up while you prepare the topping.
5 Make the Chocolate Topping:
In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and butter. Microwave for 30 seconds, stir, and repeat until smooth.
6 Top the Bars:
Pour the melted chocolate over the chilled cookie dough and spread it evenly. Sprinkle extra M&Ms on top and gently press them into the chocolate.
7 Chill & Serve:
Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours until firm. Once ready, cut into bars and serve!
Enjoy these fun and delicious cookie dough bars packed with chocolaty goodness and crunchy M&Ms! 
#NoBakeDesserts #CookieDoughBars #ChocolateLovers #SweetTreats

Message:
Lemon Meringue Pie Cannoli 
A delightful fusion of classic cannoli and lemon meringue pie, these easy-to-make treats combine a pie crust shell filled with a tangy lemon meringue filling. Perfect for a refreshing summer dessert!
Ingredients:
2 9-inch round pie dough circles e.g., Pillsbury Pie Crusts 不
1 egg 讀
1 teaspoon water 
 cup lemon curd 
 cup marshmallow fluff 
1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed 
1 teaspoon fresh lemon zest optional 
1 teaspoon powdered sugar for garnish 
Instructions:
1 Prep the Pie Crust:
If using store-bought pie dough, thaw it for about 10 minutes to make it easier to unroll.
Preheat your oven to 425F 220C.
Lightly dust a cutting board with flour and unroll one of the pie crusts. Use a 4-inch cookie cutter to cut 4 circles from each dough. Repeat with the second pie crust.
2 Shape the Cannoli Shells:
Whisk the egg and water together to make an egg wash.
Spray 8 metal cannoli forms with non-stick spray. Wrap a pie dough circle around each cannoli form, sealing the edges with the egg wash.
Place the wrapped forms on a parchment-lined baking sheet and freeze for 10 minutes to set the dough.
3 Bake the Shells:
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cannoli shells turn golden brown.
Cool for 10 minutes, then carefully remove the pie crust from the cannoli forms and let the shells cool completely before filling.
4 Prepare the Filling:
Stir together the lemon curd and marshmallow fluff until well combined.
Fold in the whipped topping and lemon zest if using to create a light and fluffy filling.
5 Assemble the Cannoli:
Spoon the lemon meringue filling into a disposable pastry or zip-top bag. Refrigerate until ready to use.
Just before serving, snip off the tip of the bag and pipe the filling into the cooled cannoli shells.
6 Garnish and Serve:
Sprinkle the filled cannoli with powdered sugar and enjoy!
These Lemon Meringue Pie Cannoli are a citrusy, creamy, and delightful dessert, perfect for summer parties or anytime you crave a bright and refreshing treat!
