Message:
Lemon Raspberry Swirl Cheesecake Cups Recipe
 Indulge in these delightful Lemon Raspberry Swirl Cheesecake Cups, where tangy lemon meets sweet raspberry in a creamy, dreamy dessert thats perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
1 cup Graham Cracker Crumbs
2 tablespoons Sugar
4 tablespoons Melted Butter
16 oz Cream Cheese, softened
 cup Sugar
2 Eggs 讀
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
 cup Lemon Juice 
1 tablespoon Lemon Zest
 cup Raspberry Preserves
Fresh Raspberries, for garnish 
Lemon Slices, for garnish 
Whipped Cream, for garnish
Instructions:
1 Preheat and Prepare:
Preheat your oven to 325F 163C. Line a muffin tin with cupcake liners to ensure easy removal of your cheesecake cups.
2 Create the Crust:
In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup of graham cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and 4 tablespoons of melted butter. Mix until well combined.
Press about 1 tablespoon of the mixture into the bottom of each cupcake liner to form the crust.
3 Mix the Cheesecake Batter:
In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and  cup of sugar until smooth and creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract,  cup of lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon of lemon zest until well combined.
4 Assemble the Cheesecakes:
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the crust in each cupcake liner, filling about 2/3 full.
Drop small dollops of  cup raspberry preserves on top of each cheesecake and swirl gently with a toothpick to create a beautiful marbled effect.
5 Bake:
Bake the cheesecakes for 18-20 minutes, or until the centers are set.
Allow them to cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
6 Garnish and Serve:
Before serving, garnish each cheesecake cup with fresh raspberries, lemon slices, and a dollop of whipped cream for an extra touch of elegance.
Enjoy!
These Lemon Raspberry Swirl Cheesecake Cups are not only delicious but also visually stunning, making them the perfect treat for gatherings, celebrations, or just a sweet indulgence at home!

Message:
Caramel Cheesecake Cubes 
Caramel Cheesecake Cubes are delightful, bite-sized treats that combine the creamy richness of cheesecake with the indulgent sweetness of caramel. Perfect for any occasion, these elegant cubes are sure to impress your guests!
Prep Time: 30 minutes
Cook Time: 30 minutes
Rest Time: 30 minutes
Total Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Difficulty: Beginner
Servings: 9 cubes
Best Season: Suitable throughout the year
Ingredients
For the Homemade Caramel Sauce:
200 g granulated sugar 
50 g water 
200 g heavy cream room temperature 拏
40 g unsalted butter 杻
1.5 g salt 蓼
For the Crust:
90 g crushed graham crackers 
35 g unsalted butter melted 杻
For the Cheesecake Filling:
250 g cream cheese softened 燎
65 g granulated sugar 
120 g heavy cream 拏
50 g milk 拏
4 g gelatin 
30 g homemade caramel sauce 
For the Topping:
200 g caramel sauce rest of the caramel sauce 
Instructions
1. Prepare the Cake Ring:
Soften the cream cheese at room temperature.
Grab a 6-inch square cake ring and wrap the bottom with plastic wrap for easy removal.
2. Make the Crust:
In a bowl, mix together 90 g crushed graham crackers with 35 g melted unsalted butter.
Pour the mixture into the cake mold and press down firmly.
Place in the fridge to keep cool while preparing the filling.
3. Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and 65 g sugar until smooth.
Add in 30 g of homemade caramel sauce and mix well.
Gradually add 120 g heavy cream and mix until combined.
Soften 4 g of gelatin in ice-cold water.
In a separate small bowl, warm 50 g of milk and add the softened gelatin, stirring until well combined.
Pour the gelatin mixture into the cream cheese mixture and mix until fully incorporated.
Pour the cheesecake mixture into the cake ring and smooth the top.
Set in the fridge to chill until set, about 15-30 minutes.
4. Add the Topping:
Once the cheesecake is set, pour the remaining 200 g of caramel sauce on top and smooth it out.
Return the cake to the fridge and let it cool for at least 4 hours or overnight for best results.
5. Serve:
To release the cheesecake, use a warm towel or a kitchen torch around the edges of the cake ring.
Slice the cheesecake into cubes and serve. Optionally, top each cube with crushed graham crackers for added texture.
Enjoy!
These Caramel Cheesecake Cubes are not only visually appealing but also provide a rich and creamy texture balanced with the sweet indulgence of caramel. Perfect for parties, gatherings, or simply treating yourself!

Message:
Strawberry Cheesecake Mousse 
This Strawberry Cheesecake Mousse is a delightful and easy dessert that combines the creamy richness of cheesecake with the fresh taste of strawberries. Its perfect for impressing your loved ones, especially for a romantic occasion like Valentines Day!
Yield: 4 servings
Prep Time: 30 minutes
Total Time: 30 minutes
Ingredients
1 cup fresh or frozen strawberries 
 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
1 block 8 ounces cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup powdered sugar 
1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract 
Instructions
1. Prepare the Strawberries:
In a blender or food processor, pulse 1 cup of strawberries until almost pureed, leaving some small chunks for texture. Set aside.
2. Whip the Cream:
In a medium bowl, whip  cup of heavy whipping cream using an electric mixer or stand mixer until stiff peaks form. Set aside.
3. Beat the Cream Cheese:
In another medium bowl, beat the softened cream cheese,  cup of powdered sugar, and 1 teaspoon of vanilla until the mixture is light and fluffy.
4. Combine the Mixtures:
Gently stir the pureed strawberries into the cream cheese mixture. Then, carefully fold in the whipped cream until well combined.
5. Chill and Serve:
Spoon the mousse into 4 bowls or one medium-sized bowl.
Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes, or until set.
Enjoy!
This Strawberry Cheesecake Mousse is light, creamy, and bursting with flavora perfect treat for any occasion! Serve chilled and enjoy the delightful combination of cheesecake and fresh strawberries!

Message:
Lemon Blueberry Cheesecake 
This Lemon Blueberry Cheesecake is a delightful blend of tangy lemon and sweet blueberries, creating a dessert that is both refreshing and indulgent. Its the perfect treat for any occasion, sure to impress your family and friends!
Rating: 4.58 from 7 votes
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Total Time: 1 hour 35 minutes
Servings: 12 people in a 25cm/10in diameter springform pan
Author: Lorena Salinas from Cravings Journal
Ingredients
For the Blueberry Sauce:
450 g blueberries fresh or frozen 
90 g sugar 
3 tsp cornstarch
3 tsp lemon juice 
For the Base:
220 g Graham Crackers or Digestive Biscuits or similar
5 tbsp unsalted butter melted 杻
 tsp salt
For the Filling:
900 g cream cheese approximately 4 packages, at room temperature 燎
250 g granulated sugar
2 lemons zest only 
220 g sour cream at room temperature
 tsp salt
4 eggs at room temperature 讀
4 tbsp lemon juice 
1 tsp vanilla extract or vanilla essence
For Garnishes:
200 ml whipping cream cold
2 tbsp icing sugar
1 lemon sliced and quartered 
Lemon zest to finish
Instructions
1. Make the Blueberry Sauce:
In a saucepan, combine 450 g blueberries, 90 g sugar, 3 tsp cornstarch, and 3 tsp lemon juice.
Cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens to a loose jam consistency. Stir occasionally and flatten some blueberries with a spatula as they cook.
Remove from heat and let cool. Divide the sauce in twoone half for the filling and the other for topping later.
2. Prepare the Base:
Process 220 g of Graham Crackers into fine crumbs.
Mix with 5 tbsp melted butter and  tsp salt.
Line the base and sides of a springform pan with baking paper, secured with vegetable oil.
Press the crust mixture into the base of the pan and freeze for at least 15 minutes.
3. Make the Filling:
Beat 900 g cream cheese and 250 g sugar until smooth and homogeneous, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add the zest of 2 lemons and 220 g sour cream; beat again.
Reduce mixer speed and add 4 eggs, one at a time, mixing until each is incorporated.
Add 4 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp vanilla extract; mix with a spatula.
Pour half of the filling into the crust and add dollops of blueberry sauce. Use a knife to marble it carefully without disturbing the crust. Repeat with the remaining filling and blueberry sauce.
4. Bake the Cheesecake:
Preheat the oven to 180C 350F with a baking pan filled with water on the bottom rack.
Place the cheesecake on a rack above the water and immediately reduce the heat to 150C 300F.
Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes, until the top is golden and the center jiggles like gelatin when shaken.
Check the water level halfway through and refill with boiling water if necessary.
Allow the cheesecake to cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight.
5. Garnish and Serve:
Unmold the cheesecake and remove the paper lining.
Spread the remaining blueberry sauce on top.
Whip 200 ml cold whipping cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar until fluffy.
Use a pastry bag with a star nozzle to pipe rosettes around the edge of the cheesecake.
Garnish with lemon slices and zest.
Enjoy!
This Lemon Blueberry Cheesecake is a deliciously creamy dessert that beautifully balances sweet and tangy flavors. Perfect for any celebration or just a special treat for yourself!

35 Oreo cookies regular or mint

32 ounces four 8-ounce blocks cream cheese softened to room temperature 燎

Pinch of salt

Message:
Juicy Pineapple Heaven Cake 
Experience a slice of paradise with this Juicy Pineapple Heaven Cake! Bursting with the tropical flavor of crushed pineapple and topped with a sweet glaze, this cake is a delightful treat for any occasion. Moist, fluffy, and delicious, its sure to become a favorite!
Ingredients:
1  cups all-purpose flour 
1 teaspoon baking powder 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
2 large eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
 cup sour cream 拏
1 cup crushed pineapple, drained 
 cup powdered sugar 
2 tablespoons pineapple juice 
Directions:
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and grease and flour a loaf pan. 
2 In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. 
3 In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. 
4 Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, and then stir in the vanilla extract. 
5 Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture in three additions, alternating with the sour cream, starting and ending with the flour mixture. Mix until just combined. 
6 Gently fold in the crushed pineapple until evenly distributed. 
7 Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top. 籠
8 Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 
9 Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. 
 In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar and pineapple juice to make a glaze. Drizzle over the cooled cake.

Calories: 280 kcal  Servings: 8 servings

Message:
Southern Cherry Cobbler Bars 
These Southern Cherry Cobbler Bars are a delightful fusion of sweet cherries, a buttery crumbly topping, and a hint of cinnamon, making them the perfect dessert for any occasion. Theyre easy to make and bursting with flavor!
Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
 cup granulated sugar 
 cup brown sugar 
1 teaspoon baking powder 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
 teaspoon ground cinnamon 
1 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed 杻
1 large egg 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
2 cups cherry pie filling 
 cup almond flour 
 cup oats 
Directions:
1 Preheat the oven to 375F 190C. Grease and line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper. 
2 In a large bowl, mix the flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, and ground cinnamon. 
3 Cut the cold, cubed butter into the flour mixture using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. 
4 In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and vanilla extract, then add to the flour mixture and stir until just combined. 籠
5 Press half of the dough mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish to form the base. 
6 Spread the cherry pie filling evenly over the base layer. 
7 In a separate bowl, combine the almond flour and oats with the remaining dough mixture. 北
8 Crumble the remaining dough mixture over the cherry filling. 
9 Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is bubbly. 
 Allow the bars to cool completely in the pan before slicing into squares. 
Prep Time: 20 minutes  Cooking Time: 40 minutes  Total Time: 1 hour
Calories: 290 kcal  Servings: 12 servings
Enjoy the taste of the South with these irresistibly delicious cherry cobbler bars!

Message:
Brookie Killer Brownie 
Get ready for the ultimate dessert combo! This Brookie Killer Brownie brings together two fan favorites: a rich, fudgy brownie base and a soft, chewy cookie top. Its the best of both worlds in every bite!
Ingredients:
For the Brownie Layer:
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
2 large eggs 讀
 cup all-purpose flour 
 cup cocoa powder 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
 teaspoon vanilla extract 
For the Cookie Layer:
 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
 cup granulated sugar 
 cup brown sugar, packed 
1 large egg 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1  cups all-purpose flour 
 teaspoon baking soda 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
1 cup chocolate chips 
Directions:
Preheat Oven:
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and grease a 9x9-inch baking pan. 
Make the Brownie Layer:
2 In a medium bowl, mix the melted butter, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract. 
3 Add the eggs and whisk until smooth. 籠
4 Stir in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just combined. Pour the brownie batter into the prepared pan and spread evenly. 
Make the Cookie Layer:
5 In a separate bowl, cream the softened butter with both granulated and brown sugars until light and fluffy. 
6 Add the egg and vanilla extract, then mix until smooth. 
7 Stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt. Fold in the chocolate chips.

8 Drop spoonfuls of the cookie dough over the brownie batter and spread evenly to cover the brownie layer. 籠

 Allow the brookie to cool completely in the pan before slicing into squares.

Hawaiian Pineapple Cake 
This tropical delight is a moist and flavorful cake made with crushed pineapple and topped with rich cream cheese frosting. With a hint of vanilla and an optional coconut garnish, this cake will transport you straight to the islands!
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 cups sugar 
2 eggs 讀
1 teaspoon baking soda 
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
Pinch of salt 蓼
1 20 oz can crushed pineapple undrained in its own juice 
1 cup chopped nuts optional 
For the Cream Cheese Frosting:
 cup butter 1 stick, softened 杻
1 8 oz package cream cheese, softened 燎
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1  cups confectioners sugar 
Coconut for garnish optional 便
Directions:
1 Preheat Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and grease a 9x13-inch baking pan. 
2 Mix the Batter:
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, eggs, baking soda, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined. 
Stir in the crushed pineapple including its juice and chopped nuts if using.

Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 
Let the cake cool completely before frosting.

Once the cake has cooled, spread the cream cheese frosting evenly over the top. 
Sprinkle with coconut optional for garnish. 便
Enjoy this delicious and tropical Hawaiian Pineapple Cake with every bite!

Message:
Chocolate Dipped Strawberry Mousse Cake 
Indulge in the heavenly combination of rich chocolate cake, airy strawberry mousse, and luscious chocolate ganache, topped with chocolate-dipped strawberries! This show-stopping dessert is perfect for special occasions or whenever youre craving an elegant sweet treat.
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
1  cups all-purpose flour 
1 cup granulated sugar 
 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 
1 teaspoon baking powder 
 teaspoon baking soda 
 teaspoon salt 蓼
2 large eggs 讀
 cup whole milk 拏
 cup vegetable oil 
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
 cup boiling water 
For the Strawberry Mousse:
1 cup fresh strawberries, pureed 
 cup powdered sugar 
1  cups heavy cream, chilled 
2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin 籠
2 tablespoons cold water 
For the Chocolate Ganache:
1 cup semisweet chocolate chips 
 cup heavy cream 
For Decoration:
Fresh strawberries, dipped in melted chocolate 
Directions:
1 Prepare the Chocolate Cake:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line two 8-inch round cake pans. 
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 
Add eggs, milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients. Beat on medium speed until smooth. 
Slowly stir in the boiling water. The batter will be thin. 
Pour the batter into the prepared pans and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 
Let the cakes cool completely before assembling. 
2 Make the Strawberry Mousse:
In a small bowl, mix the gelatin with cold water and let it bloom for about 5 minutes. 
In a saucepan, heat the strawberry puree and powdered sugar over medium heat. 
Stir in the bloomed gelatin until fully dissolved. Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool. 
In a chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream to stiff peaks. Gently fold the cooled strawberry mixture into the whipped cream. 
Refrigerate the mousse for about 30 minutes to set. 
3 Assemble the Cake:
Place one layer of the cooled chocolate cake on a serving plate. 
Spread a generous amount of strawberry mousse on top of the first layer. 
Place the second layer of cake over the mousse and spread the remaining mousse evenly over the top and sides.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set. 
4 Make the Chocolate Ganache:
Heat the heavy cream until just simmering, then pour it over the chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl. 
Let it sit for 5 minutes, then stir until smooth. Allow the ganache to cool slightly before pouring it over the cake, letting it drip down the sides. 
5 Decorate:
Dip fresh strawberries in melted chocolate and arrange them on top of the cake. 
Optionally, drizzle extra melted chocolate over the strawberries for a more luxurious finish. 
Recipe Details:
Prep Time: 45 minutes
Chill Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Total Time: 2 hours 15 minutes
Servings: 10-12 slices
Calories: 420 kcal per serving
This Chocolate Dipped Strawberry Mousse Cake is a beautiful and delicious dessert, perfect for those who love the classic pairing of chocolate and strawberries!

Message:
Strawberry Pie 
Get ready to bake a delicious, homemade strawberry pie with a flaky, buttery crust and sweet, juicy filling. Perfect for any occasion, this pie is best served with a dollop of whipped cream or a scoop of vanilla ice cream!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
3 cups all-purpose flour 
2 tablespoons granulated sugar 
1 teaspoon salt 蓼
1 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small chunks 杻
1/2 teaspoon lemon juice 
6-7 tablespoons ice cold water 
For the Filling:
5 cups sliced fresh strawberries 
4 tablespoons cornstarch 
3/4 cup granulated sugar 
1 pinch salt 蓼
A splash of lemon juice 
To Finish:
1 egg 讀
1 tablespoon water 
1-2 tablespoons coarse sugar for sprinkling on top 
Additional Notes:
Chilling Time: Dough should be chilled for at least 45 minutes or overnight for the best results.
Serving Suggestion: Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream for extra deliciousness. 
Directions:
1 Prepare the Crust:
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt. 
Cut in Butter: Add the cold, cubed butter to the dry ingredients and cut it in using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. 杻
Add Lemon Juice and Water: Add the lemon juice and ice-cold water, one tablespoon at a time, mixing gently with a fork after each addition until the dough comes together. 
Chill: Divide the dough in half, shape into discs, wrap in plastic wrap, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 45 minutes or overnight. 
2 Make the Strawberry Filling:
Prepare the Strawberries: Slice the strawberries and toss them with cornstarch, sugar, a pinch of salt, and a splash of lemon juice. 
Let it Rest: Allow the filling to rest for about 15-20 minutes to thicken slightly. 
3 Assemble the Pie:
Roll Out Dough: Roll out one disc of chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to fit a 9-inch pie dish. Gently press it into the dish. 不
Add the Filling: Spoon the strawberry filling evenly into the crust. 
Top Crust: Roll out the second disc of dough and place it over the filling. Trim any excess dough and crimp the edges to seal. 
Egg Wash: Beat the egg with water to make an egg wash and brush it over the top crust. 讀
Sprinkle Sugar: Sprinkle coarse sugar on top for extra crunch and sweetness. 
4 Bake:
Preheat Oven: Preheat the oven to 375F 190C. 
Bake: Bake the pie for 45-50 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. 
Cool: Let the pie cool before serving for easier slicing. 
Enjoy your Strawberry Pie with a side of whipped cream or ice cream for the perfect finishing touch!

Message:
No-Bake Vanilla Cheesecake 
Indulge in the creamy goodness of this No-Bake Vanilla Cheesecake! With a buttery biscuit base, a smooth vanilla cheesecake filling, and whipped cream on top, its the perfect dessert for any occasion.
Ingredients:
Biscuit Base:
300 g digestive biscuits 
150 g unsalted butter 杻
Vanilla Cheesecake Filling:
750 g full-fat cream cheese like Philadelphia or Mascarpone 燎
100 g icing sugar 
1-2 tsp vanilla extract 
300 ml double cream 拏
1 tbsp lemon juice optional 
Optional Topping:
150 ml double cream 拏
2 tbsp icing sugar 
Serve With:
Fresh berries 
Berry coulis 
Chocolate sauce 
Caramel sauce 
Instructions:
For the Biscuit Base:
1 Prepare Biscuits: Blitz the digestive biscuits in a food processor until they resemble fine crumbs. Alternatively, place them in a bag and crush with a rolling pin.
2 Melt Butter: Melt the unsalted butter until liquid, then mix it with the crushed biscuits. You can pour it directly into the food processor and blitz to combine.
3 Press Into Pan: Press the biscuit mixture firmly into the bottom of an 8"" 20 cm springform deep tin. Refrigerate or freeze while you prepare the filling.
For the Cheesecake Filling:
4 Mix Ingredients: In a large bowl or stand mixer, add the cream cheese, icing sugar, vanilla extract, and lemon juice if using. Whisk until smooth.
5 Add Cream: Pour in the double cream and whisk until thickened. Alternatively, you can whip the cream separately until stiff peaks form and gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture.
6 Combine: Once thickened, pour the cheesecake mixture over the prepared biscuit base. Smooth the top with a spatula.
7 Chill: Set the cheesecake in the fridge for 5-6 hours or preferably overnight to allow it to firm up.
For Decoration:
8 Whip Topping: Whip the double cream with icing sugar until pipeable. Decorate your chilled cheesecake with the whipped cream as desired.
Serve:
9 Garnish: Serve your cheesecake plain or with berries, coulis, chocolate sauce, or caramel sauce for an extra treat!
Enjoy this delightful No-Bake Vanilla Cheesecake thats sure to impress your family and friends!

Message:
Cheesecake Stuffed Chocolate Chip Cookies 
Indulge in these decadent Cheesecake Stuffed Chocolate Chip Cookies! Combining the rich flavors of creamy cheesecake with classic chocolate chip cookies, these treats are perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth!
Ingredients:
For the Cookie Dough:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
 tsp baking soda 蓼
 tsp salt 蓼
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
1 cup packed brown sugar 
 cup granulated sugar 
1 tbsp vanilla extract 
1 egg 讀
1 egg yolk 讀
2 cups chocolate chips 
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 oz cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup granulated sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Directions:
1. Preheat Oven:
Preheat your oven to 325F 165C and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
2. Prepare Cookie Dough:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate large bowl, cream together the melted butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until smooth.
Beat in the vanilla extract, egg, and egg yolk until well combined.
Gradually mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in the chocolate chips.
3. Make Cheesecake Filling:
In a small bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.
4. Assemble Cookies:
Form tablespoon-sized balls of cookie dough and make a hole in the center of each ball.
Fill the hole with a small amount of the cheesecake mixture, then cover with more cookie dough, sealing the cheesecake inside.
5. Bake:
Place the stuffed cookie balls on the prepared cookie sheets and bake for 15-18 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Let cool on the cookie sheets for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Prep and Cook Times:
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cook Time: 18 minutes
Total Time: 38 minutes
Nutrition:
Calories: 310 kcal per cookie
Servings: 24 cookies
 Tips:
Chill the Cookie Dough: Refrigerate the dough for 30 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Add Flaky Sea Salt: For an extra flavor boost, sprinkle flaky sea salt on top before baking!
Enjoy the delightful combination of Cheesecake and Chocolate Chip Cookies in every bite!

Message:
No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Cream Pie 
This delightful No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Cream Pie features a buttery graham cracker crust topped with a sweet, light, and fluffy strawberry cream cheese filling. Its the perfect dessert for picnics and BBQs, sure to be a crowd-pleaser!
Ingredients:
For the Graham Cracker Crust:
10 graham crackers, crushed into crumbs 
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 杻
2 tablespoons granulated sugar 
For the Strawberry Cheesecake Filling:
1 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
1  cup powdered sugar, divided 
8 ounces cream cheese, softened 燎
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
12 ounces fresh strawberries, chopped 
5 teaspoons gelatin, dissolved in 3 tablespoons water 
For Whipped Topping:
1 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
 cup powdered sugar 
Extra strawberries for decoration 
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Graham Cracker Crust:
In a bowl, combine crushed graham crackers, melted butter, and sugar using a fork.
Press the mixture into the bottom and halfway up the sides of an 8-inch springform pan or a 9-inch pie pan.
Refrigerate while you prepare the filling.
2. Prepare the Gelatin:
Dissolve gelatin powder in cold water and let it bloom for a few minutes.
Heat on low until completely melted, then set aside to cool for a few minutes.
3. Make the Strawberry Cheesecake Filling:
In a bowl, mix heavy whipping cream until stiff peaks form, gradually adding  cup powdered sugar.
In a large bowl, mix cream cheese with the remaining 1 cup powdered sugar until fluffy.
Add vanilla and the melted gelatin, mixing on low speed until smooth and well combined.
Gently fold in the chopped strawberries, then gently stir in the whipped cream.
4. Assemble the Pie:
Pour the strawberry cheesecake filling into the graham cracker crust and smooth it out with a spatula.
Refrigerate for at least 5 hours or until firm.
5. Whipped Topping:
Once firm, remove the cheesecake from the springform pan.
For decoration, whip together 1 cup heavy whipping cream and  cup powdered sugar until stiff peaks form, and decorate the border of the pie. Add additional strawberries on top if desired.
6. Serve:
Store in the refrigerator until serving. Enjoy your delicious No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Cream Pie!
Prep Time:
15 minutes
Servings:
8 servings
Calories:
Approx. per serving: 290 kcal calories may vary based on specific ingredients used
This creamy, fruity pie is a perfect treat for warm weather, bringing a burst of strawberry flavor in every bite!  Enjoy!

Message:
No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Parfaits 
These No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Parfaits are a delightful summer dessert, featuring layers of buttery graham cracker crumbs, fresh macerated strawberries, and a creamy cheesecake filling. Perfect for warm days and easy to assemble!
Ingredients:
1 lb fresh strawberries 
1/4 cup granulated sugar 
1 teaspoon lemon zest 
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice 
1 sleeve graham crackers or 1.5 cups graham cracker crumbs 
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
Two 8-ounce blocks cream cheese, softened 燎
14-ounce can sweetened condensed milk 拏
1 teaspoon vanilla paste or vanilla extract 
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Strawberries:
Remove and discard the stems from the strawberries, then cut them into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, combine the strawberries with granulated sugar, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Stir well to combine and let this mixture sit for 15 minutes to macerate.
2. Make the Graham Cracker Crust:
In the meantime, place the graham crackers into a food processor and pulse until ground into fine crumbs. If you dont have a food processor, crush the graham crackers using a rolling pin.
In a bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and stir until the crumbs are evenly moistened. Set aside.
3. Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large bowl, whip together the cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla paste with a hand mixer on medium-high speed for about 1 minute, until smooth and well combined.
4. Assemble the Parfaits:
In a glass, place a few spoonfuls of the cheesecake mixture at the bottom.
Add a layer of the buttery graham cracker crumbs.
Top with a layer of the macerated strawberries, leaving the excess liquid behind and discarding it.
Repeat the layers: cheesecake mixture, graham cracker crumbs, and strawberries.
5. Chill and Serve:
Chill the parfaits in the refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Enjoy your delicious No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Parfaits!
Prep Time:
15 minutes
Servings:
4-6 servings
Total Time:
15 minutes not including chilling time
These parfaits are not only delicious but also visually appealing, making them perfect for gatherings or a refreshing treat on a hot day!  Enjoy every spoonful!

Message:
No-Bake Peanut Butter Marshmallow Pie 樂
This No-Bake Peanut Butter Marshmallow Pie is a dreamy dessert that combines a light and fluffy peanut butter mousse filling with a crunchy Oreo cookie crust. Topped with whipped cream, crushed peanut butter cookies, and a drizzle of peanut butter, its a treat that will satisfy any sweet tooth!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1 package 14 oz Oreos 
8 tablespoons 1 stick unsalted butter, melted 杻
For the Filling:
1 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
 cup powdered sugar 
8 ounces cream cheese, softened 燎
3 tablespoons granulated sugar 
1 jar 7 oz marshmallow crème 
1  cup creamy peanut butter 樂
For the Topping:
 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
23 tablespoons powdered sugar 
Peanut butter for garnish, optional 樂
Peanut butter sandwich cookies for garnish, optional 
Instructions:
1. Prepare the Crust:
Lightly grease a 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray and wipe gently with a paper towel.
Grind the Oreos into a fine crumb using a food processor or blender.
In a small bowl, melt the butter in the microwave for 30 to 45 seconds. Pour the melted butter over the cookie crumbs and stir until the crumbs are well coated.
Pour the crumbs into the springform pan and press firmly into the bottom and up the sides to create a thick crust. Refrigerate or freeze the crust while you prepare the filling.
2. Make the Filling:
Chill a metal mixing bowl in the freezer for 5 minutes to prepare for whipped cream.
Pour the heavy whipping cream into the chilled bowl and beat on medium-high speed until it starts to thicken. Slowly add the powdered sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form.
In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and granulated sugar until smooth, scraping down the bowl as needed.
Add the marshmallow crème and mix until smooth.
Mix in the peanut butter and beat until all ingredients are well combined.
Gently fold the prepared whipped cream into the cream cheese filling until completely mixed. Pour the filling into the prepared crust and spread evenly.
Refrigerate for 3-4 hours until the filling is set.
3. Prepare the Topping:
Before serving, make a second batch of whipped cream as instructed above.
Use a large piping tip to decorate the border of your pie with whipped cream.
Garnish with crushed peanut butter cookies and drizzle with warm peanut butter microwave the peanut butter for 20-30 seconds to warm it.
Prep Time:
20 minutes
Cook Time:
4 hours chill time
Total Time:
4 hours 20 minutes
Yield:
8-10 slices
This indulgent No-Bake Peanut Butter Marshmallow Pie is perfect for any occasion and will surely impress your family and friends! Enjoy each fluffy, creamy slice! 樂

Message:
Strawberry Sensation Ice Cream 
Cool off this summer with a delightful homemade Strawberry Sensation Ice Cream! This creamy treat features fresh strawberries and is sure to become a favorite for your family and friends.
Ingredients:
For the Strawberry Mixture:
2 cups fresh strawberries hulled and sliced 
 cup granulated sugar
1 tablespoon lemon juice 
For the Ice Cream Base:
2 cups heavy cream 拏
1 cup whole milk
 cup granulated sugar
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
Pinch of salt 蓼
Directions:
1. Prepare the Strawberry Mixture:
In a bowl, combine the sliced strawberries,  cup sugar, and lemon juice.
Let the mixture sit for 30 minutes to allow the strawberries to release their juices and dissolve the sugar.
2. Make the Ice Cream Base:
In another bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, whole milk,  cup sugar, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until the sugar is fully dissolved.
3. Combine the Mixtures:
Add the strawberry mixture to the ice cream base and mix well until combined.
4. Chill and Freeze:
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to chill thoroughly.
5. Churn the Ice Cream:
Pour the chilled mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturers instructions, usually for 25-30 minutes.
6. Freeze Again:
Transfer the churned ice cream to a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 4 hours to firm up.
7. Serve and Enjoy:
Scoop the homemade strawberry ice cream into bowls or cones and enjoy the fresh strawberry flavor in every creamy bite!
Total Time:
Prep Time: 30 minutes plus chilling and freezing time
Chill Time: 2 hours
Churn Time: 25-30 minutes
Final Freeze: 4 hours
Yield:
About 4-6 servings
This Strawberry Sensation Ice Cream is a perfect way to celebrate summer with a refreshing and creamy dessert!

Message:
Mini Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Trifles
Indulge in these delightful Mini Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Trifles! This no-bake dessert features a smooth and creamy chocolate cheesecake filling layered with fluffy whipped cream and crunchy Oreo cookie crumbs. Perfect for a sweet treat or entertaining guests!
Ingredients:
Oreo Crumbles:
15 Oreos, ground into crumbs 
3 tablespoons butter, melted
Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Filling:
16 oz 452g cream cheese, room temperature
 cup 104g sugar
4 tablespoons 28g natural unsweetened cocoa powder
4 tablespoons 60ml Baileys Irish Cream 
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
Whipped Cream:
1 cups 300ml heavy whipping cream, cold
3 tablespoons 45ml Baileys Irish Cream
3 tablespoons 21g natural unsweetened cocoa powder
3 tablespoons 22g powdered sugar
 teaspoon vanilla extract
Instructions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat and set aside.
Make the Oreo Crumbles:
In a bowl, combine the Oreo crumbs and melted butter, stirring until well combined.
Spread the mixture evenly onto the prepared cookie sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes. Allow it to cool, then break any large clumps into smaller pieces.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, add the cream cheese and sugar. Mix until well combined and smooth.
Add the cocoa powder and mix again until combined.
Add the Baileys, vanilla extract, and salt; mix until smooth. Set aside.
Make the Whipped Cream:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the heavy whipping cream, Baileys, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract. Whip on high speed until stiff peaks form.
Assemble the Trifles:
Divide half of the cookie crumbs evenly among four cups or jars, spreading them into an even layer at the bottom.
Spoon or pipe an even layer of the cheesecake filling on top of the cookie crumbs, using about half of the filling.
Follow with a layer of whipped cream on top of the cheesecake filling.
Divide the remaining cookie crumbs among the cups, layering them on top of the whipped cream. Reserve a bit for garnish if desired.
Add the remaining cheesecake filling on top of the cookie crumbs, distributing it evenly.
Top each trifle with a swirl of whipped cream and sprinkle with additional cookie crumbs, if desired.

Description:
Mini Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Trifles
Indulge in these delightful Mini Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Trifles! This no-bake dessert features a smooth and creamy chocolate cheesecake filling layered with fluffy whipped cream and crunchy Oreo cookie crumbs. Perfect for a sweet treat or entertaining guests!
Ingredients:
Oreo Crumbles:
15 Oreos, ground into crumbs 
3 tablespoons butter, melted
Baileys Chocolate Cheesecake Filling:
16 oz 452g cream cheese, room temperature
 cup 104g sugar
4 tablespoons 28g natural unsweetened cocoa powder
4 tablespoons 60ml Baileys Irish Cream 
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
Whipped Cream:
1 cups 300ml heavy whipping cream, cold
3 tablespoons 45ml Baileys Irish Cream
3 tablespoons 21g natural unsweetened cocoa powder
3 tablespoons 22g powdered sugar
 teaspoon vanilla extract
Instructions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat and set aside.
Make the Oreo Crumbles:
In a bowl, combine the Oreo crumbs and melted butter, stirring until well combined.
Spread the mixture evenly onto the prepared cookie sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes. Allow it to cool, then break any large clumps into smaller pieces.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a large mixing bowl, add the cream cheese and sugar. Mix until well combined and smooth.
Add the cocoa powder and mix again until combined.
Add the Baileys, vanilla extract, and salt; mix until smooth. Set aside.
Make the Whipped Cream:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the heavy whipping cream, Baileys, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract. Whip on high speed until stiff peaks form.
Assemble the Trifles:
Divide half of the cookie crumbs evenly among four cups or jars, spreading them into an even layer at the bottom.
Spoon or pipe an even layer of the cheesecake filling on top of the cookie crumbs, using about half of the filling.

4 servings

Message:
No Bake Frozen Peanut Butter Cheesecake Nutter Butter Crust
This No Bake Frozen Peanut Butter Cheesecake with a Nutter Butter crust is a dream come true for peanut butter lovers! Rich, creamy, and easy to make, this cheesecake will leave everyone asking for seconds.
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
24 Nutter Butter Cookies, finely crushed about 3 cups 
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
For the Cheesecake Filling:
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
1 can 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk
 cup creamy peanut butter e.g., Skippy Naturals
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon lemon juice
1 container 8 ounces Cool Whip fat-free, regular, or light, thawed
Optional Toppings:
 recipe chocolate whipped cream
 cup hot fudge, warmed
 cup peanut butter, warmed
Chopped peanuts
Mini Nutter Butters
Instructions:
Make the Crust:
In a medium-sized bowl, stir together the crushed Nutter Butter cookies and melted butter using a fork.
Press the mixture into the bottom and about  inch up the sides of a 9 or 9 springform pan.
Chill the crust in the refrigerator until you are ready to fill it.
Make the Filling:
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese with a hand mixer until smooth about 30 seconds.
Mix in the sweetened condensed milk and creamy peanut butter, blending until smooth.
Add the vanilla extract and lemon juice, mixing until well combined.
Gently fold in the Cool Whip until fully incorporated.
Assemble the Cheesecake:
Spread the cheesecake filling evenly in the prepared Nutter Butter crust.
Cover the pan with plastic wrap and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Serve:
Once ready to serve, remove the cheesecake from the freezer and carefully take off the plastic wrap and springform pan ring. You may need to run a butter knife around the edges to loosen it.
Let it sit at room temperature for 5-10 minutes to soften slightly for easier cutting.
Decorate Optional:
Place the hot fudge and peanut butter in separate ziplock sandwich bags, cutting off the tips to pipe onto the top of the cheesecake.
Pipe whipped cream around the edges or use more Cool Whip, add Mini Nutter Butters around the edges, and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
If desired, the decorated cheesecake can be refrozen.
Enjoy:
This cheesecake can also be served refrigerated not frozen for a different texture. Enjoy every delicious bite! 
Yield:
12 servings
This No Bake Frozen Peanut Butter Cheesecake is sure to be a hit at your next gathering. Enjoy the creamy texture and delightful peanut butter flavor with every slice!

Message:
Mini Lemon Blackberry Cheesecakes
These Mini Lemon Blackberry Cheesecakes are the perfect combination of tangy lemon and sweet blackberry flavor. They make a delightful dessert for any occasion!
Ingredients:
For the Graham Cracker Crumbs:
 cup graham cracker crumbs
1 tablespoons sugar
 cup unsalted butter, melted
For the Cheesecake Filling:
2 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup sugar
 cup sour cream
 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
 teaspoon kosher salt
2 large eggs
Zest of 2 large lemons
2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice
1 cup fresh blackberries
1 8 oz can of blackberry pie filling
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 325F 160C. Line a cupcake pan with cupcake liners.
Make the Crust:
In a medium bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Mix until well combined.
Using a tablespoon, scoop the crust mixture into the cupcake liners.
Press the mixture down firmly with the bottom of a flat round cup to form a compact crust. Set aside.
Prepare the Cheesecake Filling:
In a standing mixer, beat together the cream cheese and sugar until smooth and creamy.
Add in the sour cream, vanilla extract, lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt, and mix until well combined.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing until fully incorporated after each addition.
Gently fold in the fresh blackberries.
Fill the Liners:
Scoop about  cup of the cheesecake batter into each cupcake liner, filling them to about  full.
Bake:
Bake in the preheated oven for 17-21 minutes, or until the edges start to turn a light golden brown and the center is set.
Cool:
Allow the cheesecakes to cool completely in the pan on a wire rack.
Top and Serve:
Once cooled, top each cheesecake with blackberry pie filling and sprinkle with some crushed graham crackers for garnish.
Yield:
Makes approximately 12 mini cheesecakes.
These Mini Lemon Blackberry Cheesecakes are sure to impress your family and friends with their vibrant flavors and lovely presentation! Enjoy!

Message:
Easy No Bake Salted Caramel Oreo Icebox Cake
This Easy No Bake Salted Caramel Oreo Icebox Cake is a delightful summer dessert that combines the rich flavors of cream cheese, salted caramel, and Oreos. With layers of coffee-dipped Oreos and a creamy filling, its a no-fuss treat thats perfect for entertaining!
Ingredients:
8-ounce package cream cheese, softened
 cup caramel ice cream topping
 teaspoon coarse ground sea salt adjust to taste
32 Oreo cookies about 4 packets
6 ounces strong coffee, cooled and sweetened if desired
4 cups Cool Whip, divided
For Decoration:
Caramel syrup
Chocolate syrup
Extra sea salt
Directions:
Prepare the Baking Tray:
Line an 8-inch by 8-inch baking tray with non-stick parchment paper for easy removal.
Mix the Caramel and Salt:
In a mixing bowl, stir together the caramel topping and coarse sea salt. Taste and adjust the salt if necessary.
Make the Cream Cheese Mixture:
In a separate bowl, beat the cream cheese and the caramel mixture together until creamy and smooth.
Gently fold in 3 cups of Cool Whip until well combined.
Dip the Oreos:
Dip 16 Oreo cookies in the cooled coffee, allowing them to soak briefly to absorb some moisture. Place them in a single layer in the bottom of the prepared baking tray.
Layer the Cheesecake Mixture:
Spread half of the caramel cheesecake mixture over the coffee-dipped Oreos.
Repeat the process with another layer of 16 coffee-dipped Oreos and the remaining cheesecake mixture.
Top with Cool Whip:
Spread 1 cup of Cool Whip over the top layer of the cake.
Refrigerate the cake until well set, ideally for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Decorate:
Before serving, top with additional Cool Whip, and drizzle with caramel and chocolate syrups. Sprinkle with extra sea salt if desired.
Slice and Serve:
To cut the cake into 9 squares, use a knife dipped in boiling water for clean cuts. Enjoy this delicious dessert!
Notes:
Feel free to adjust the amount of sea salt to your taste.
This cake is perfect for making ahead of time and serves well chilled on warm days.
This No Bake Salted Caramel Oreo Icebox Cake is a crowd-pleaser thats easy to prepare and sure to impress! Enjoy your sweet treat!

Message:
No Bake Nutella Cheesecake 
Indulge in this rich and creamy No Bake Nutella Cheesecake, perfect for chocolate lovers! With a crunchy Oreo crust and a smooth Nutella filling, this dessert is easy to make and incredibly delicious!
Ingredients:
24 Oreo cookies 
4 tablespoons butter, melted 杻
1 cup heavy whipping cream 拏
20 ounces cream cheese, softened 燎
1 tablespoon   cup powdered sugar 
3 tablespoons cocoa powder 
1  cups Nutella 
For Serving:
Fresh strawberries 
Whipped cream 
Extra Nutella for drizzling 
Instructions:
Prepare the Crust:
Crush the Oreo cookies including the filling in a food processor until fine.
Stir together the crushed cookies and melted butter, then press the mixture into the bottom of a springform pan. Place in the freezer while you prepare the filling.
Whip the Cream:
In a chilled metal bowl, whip the heavy cream with 1 tablespoon of powdered sugar using a whisk or hand mixer until stiff peaks form. Place it in the refrigerator until ready to use.
Make the Cheesecake Filling:
In a separate bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the remaining  cup powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and Nutella to the cream cheese, beating until well combined.
Combine Mixtures:
Take the whipped cream out of the refrigerator and gently fold it into the Nutella mixture until smooth and even.
Assemble the Cheesecake:
Pour the cheesecake filling on top of the chilled Oreo crust and smooth the top with a spatula.
Chill:
Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 4 hours or up to 48 hours for the best set.
Serve:
When ready to serve, run a thin knife around the edges of the pan to release the cheesecake. Unclamp the springform pan and carefully remove it.
Serve slices topped with fresh strawberries, whipped cream, and a drizzle of Nutella heat it in the microwave for 20-30 seconds for easier drizzling.
Enjoy your decadent No Bake Nutella Cheesecake! 
This cheesecake is a wonderful dessert for gatherings or a special treat for yourself. It combines the beloved flavors of chocolate and hazelnut in a simple, no-bake format. Enjoy!

Message:
Red Velvet Lasagna 
Indulge in this delightful Red Velvet Lasagna, a layered, no-bake dessert thats perfect for any occasion! With its crunchy graham cracker crust, creamy layers, and rich chocolate pudding, its a sweet treat everyone will love!
Ingredients:
Crust Layer:
10 ounces graham crackers regular or vanilla, finely ground about 2 packages 
9 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted and cooled 杻
Cream Cheese Layer:
16 ounces cream cheese, softened to room temperature 2 packages 燎
1 cup granulated white sugar 
1.5 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or freshly squeezed lemon juice 
Red Chocolate Pudding Layer:
6.8 ounces instant chocolate pudding 2 packages, 3.4 ounces each 
3 cups milk 拏
60 drops red food coloring adjust for desired color 
Topping Layer:
8 ounces whipped topping e.g., Cool Whip or substitute with whipped cream 
1 teaspoon shaved or curled dark chocolate for garnish 
A drizzle of cherry, strawberry, or raspberry sauce wild cherries in syrup are recommended 
Instructions:
Prepare the Crust:
In a medium-large bowl, mix the melted and cooled butter with the finely ground graham crackers until well combined.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan.
Cover and chill while preparing the next layer.
Make the Cream Cheese Layer:
In a mixing bowl, use a handheld electric mixer to combine the cream cheese, sugar, and apple cider vinegar or lemon juice until smooth and creamy.
Spread this mixture evenly on top of the graham cracker crust.
Prepare the Red Chocolate Pudding Layer:
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the milk and instant chocolate pudding mix until it begins to set about 4-5 minutes.
Add the red food coloring until the desired color is achieved, mixing well.
Spread the pudding evenly over the cream cheese layer.
Add the Topping Layer:
Using an offset spatula, spread the thawed whipped topping evenly over the pudding layer.
Sprinkle with shaved or curled dark chocolate for garnish.
Optionally, drizzle with cherry sauce or another fruit sauce before serving.
Chill and Serve:
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. For more defined layers, consider freezing overnight at least 6 hours before cutting into squares.
Use a sharp knife to cut through the layers, wiping it clean between cuts for neat slices.
Enjoy your delicious Red Velvet Lasagna! 
This dessert is not only visually stunning but also rich and creamy, making it a perfect centerpiece for parties and gatherings. Its sure to impress your friends and family!

Message:
Heavenly Banana Walnut Cream Cake 
Indulge in the Heavenly Banana Walnut Cream Cake, a moist and flavorful dessert that brings together layers of creamy custard, crunchy walnuts, and sweet banana slices. Perfect for any occasion, this cake is a delightful combination of textures and flavors!
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
1 teaspoon baking soda 離
1/2 teaspoon salt 蓼
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
1 cup granulated sugar 
2 large eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
1/2 cup sour cream 拏
3 ripe bananas, mashed 
1/2 cup chopped walnuts 
1/2 cup white chocolate chips 
For the Filling and Topping:
2 cups creamy custard 
1 banana, sliced for garnish 
1/4 cup whole or halved walnuts  for garnish
Directions:
Preheat the Oven:
Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans.
Prepare Dry Ingredients:
In a medium bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour , baking soda 離, and salt 蓼. Set aside.
Cream Butter and Sugar:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter 杻 and granulated sugar  until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs 讀 one at a time, then stir in the vanilla extract .
Add Wet Ingredients:
Mix in the sour cream 拏 and mashed bananas  until well combined.
Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the chopped walnuts  and white chocolate chips .
Bake the Cakes:
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn them out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Assemble the Cake:
Once the cakes have cooled, spread half of the creamy custard  over the top of one layer. Place the second layer on top and spread the remaining custard over the top.
Garnish and Serve:
Garnish with banana slices  and whole or halved walnuts . Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.
Enjoy your Heavenly Banana Walnut Cream Cake! 
With its rich flavors and delightful textures, this cake is sure to become a favorite for banana lovers and dessert enthusiasts alike!

Message:
Green Grape Cheesecake 
A Fresh and Vibrant Twist on a Classic
Cheesecake is a beloved dessert enjoyed worldwide for its creamy, rich texture and endless flavor possibilities. While the classic cheesecake often features fruits like strawberries, blueberries, or even limes, a lesser-explored yet equally delightful fruit is the green grape. Known for their tangy sweetness and juicy texture, green grapes can offer a fresh and unique twist to the traditional cheesecake. This recipe combines the smooth, velvety texture of cheesecake with the refreshing burst of green grapes, creating a dessert thats not only delicious but also visually stunning. Whether youre preparing it for a special occasion or just want to try something new, this green grape cheesecake is sure to impress.
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
200g about 2 cups of graham cracker crumbs 
100g about  cup of unsalted butter, melted 杻
2 tablespoons of granulated sugar optional 
For the Cheesecake Filling:
500g about 2 cups of cream cheese, softened 燎
200ml about  cup of heavy cream or double cream 拏
150g about  cup of granulated sugar 
2 large eggs 讀
2 tablespoons of cornstarch to help stabilize the cheesecake 
1 teaspoon of vanilla extract 
Zest of one lemon optional, for a hint of citrus flavor 
For the Green Grape Gel Topping:
200g about 1 cup of fresh green grapes, halved seedless grapes work best 
50ml about  cup of lime juice or grape juice for a milder flavor 
100g about  cup of granulated sugar 
1 tablespoon of cornstarch 
A few drops of green food coloring optional, for a more vibrant topping 
For Garnish:
A few fresh green grape halves or slices for decorating the top 
Whipped cream optional 
A few mint or cilantro leaves optional 
Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Crust 
1 Crush the graham crackers: Start by crushing the graham crackers into fine crumbs. You can do this by placing them in a food processor or by putting them in a resealable plastic bag and crushing them with a rolling pin.
2 Combine the crust ingredients: In a medium-sized bowl, mix the graham cracker crumbs with the melted butter. If you prefer a sweeter crust, you can also add 2 tablespoons of sugar at this stage.
3 Press the crust: Take an 8 or 9-inch springform pan and press the graham cracker mixture evenly into the bottom, forming a firm, even layer. Use the back of a spoon or the bottom of a glass to pack the crust down tightly. Place the pan in the refrigerator to chill while you prepare the filling.
Step 2: Make the Cheesecake Filling 
4 Beat the cream cheese: In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese with a hand mixer or stand mixer until its smooth and creamy, free of any lumps.
5 Add sugar and cornstarch: Gradually add the sugar and cornstarch, mixing until fully incorporated. The cornstarch helps to stabilize the cheesecake, giving it a smooth texture.
6 Add eggs: Add the eggs one at a time, beating after each addition until the mixture is smooth. Be sure not to overmix, as this can incorporate too much air into the filling.
7 Pour in the heavy cream: Slowly pour in the heavy cream and vanilla extract, mixing until everything is well combined. For a subtle citrus note, you can also add the zest of one lemon at this stage.
8 Fill the crust: Remove the prepared crust from the refrigerator and pour the cheesecake mixture into the pan, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Step 3: Bake the Cheesecake 
9 Preheat the oven: Preheat your oven to 160C 320F.
 Bake: Place the cheesecake in the oven and bake for about 45-55 minutes, or until the center is just set but still has a slight wobble. You dont want to overbake the cheesecake, as this can cause it to crack.
11 Cool: Once baked, turn off the oven and crack the door open slightly, allowing the cheesecake to cool slowly for about an hour. This will help prevent the top from cracking. Afterward, remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool completely at room temperature before transferring it to the refrigerator to chill for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Step 4: Prepare the Green Grape Gel Topping 
12 Make the grape puree: While the cheesecake is chilling, you can prepare the green grape topping. In a blender or food processor, blend the green grapes with the lime juice or grape juice if you prefer a less tangy topping until smooth.
13 Cook the topping: Pour the grape mixture into a small saucepan and add the sugar and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and turns into a glossy gel. If you want a more vibrant color, you can add a few drops of green food coloring at this stage.
14 Cool the topping: Once the mixture has thickened, remove it from the heat and allow it to cool to room temperature.
Step 5: Assemble the Cheesecake 
15 Top the cheesecake: After the cheesecake has fully chilled, spread the cooled green grape gel evenly over the top of the cheesecake, using a spatula to smooth it out.
16 Garnish: Garnish the cheesecake with halved or sliced fresh green grapes, a few dollops of whipped cream, and a sprinkle of mint or cilantro leaves for a fresh and decorative touch.
Step 6: Serve and Enjoy 
17 Once the cheesecake is fully assembled, slice and serve. The combination of the creamy cheesecake with the tart, refreshing flavor of the green grape gel creates a perfect balance of textures and flavors. Each bite is a delightful experience, with the crunchy graham cracker crust adding a contrasting texture to the smooth filling and the juicy green grape topping.
Tips for Success:
Room Temperature Ingredients: Make sure all your ingredients, especially the cream cheese, are at room temperature before you begin. This will ensure a smoother, creamier filling.
Water Bath: If youre worried about cracks, you can bake the cheesecake in a water bath. Simply wrap the bottom of the springform pan in aluminum foil to prevent water from seeping in, then place the pan in a larger baking dish filled with about an inch of hot water. This will help the cheesecake bake more evenly.
Chill Time: Cheesecake is best served after its had plenty of time to chill. Allowing the cheesecake to sit in the fridge overnight will help the flavors to develop and the texture to set perfectly.
Enjoy your Green Grape Cheesecake!

Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake Roulade 
Indulge in this delightful Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake Rouladea luscious combination of rich chocolate cake and creamy peanut butter filling. Perfect for any chocolate lover, this cake roll is sure to impress with its stunning presentation and mouthwatering flavor!
Ingredients:
For the Cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
2 cups granulated sugar 
2 cups unsweetened cocoa powder 
1 teaspoons baking powder 離
 teaspoon salt 蓼
2 cups unsalted butter, softened 杻
3 large eggs 讀
1 teaspoon vanilla extract 
2 cups milk 拏
For the Peanut Butter Filling:
 cup creamy peanut butter 樂
1 cups powdered sugar 
2 cups heavy cream 
Directions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven 
1 Set your oven to 350F 175C. Grease and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Prepare the Dry Ingredients 籠
2 In a bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar 療
3 In a separate large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract and milk until combined.
Step 4: Combine Mixtures 
4 Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the butter mixture until just incorporated.
Step 5: Bake the Cake 
5 Pour the batter into the prepared baking sheet, spreading it evenly. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow it to cool slightly.
Step 6: Make the Peanut Butter Filling 樂
6 In a bowl, mix the creamy peanut butter and powdered sugar until smooth. In another bowl, whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the peanut butter mixture until well combined.
Step 7: Assemble the Roulade 
7 Once the cake has cooled, carefully invert it onto a clean kitchen towel dusted with cocoa powder. Peel off the parchment paper, then spread the peanut butter filling evenly over the cake. Starting from one edge, roll the cake into a log shape using the towel to assist.
Step 8: Chill and Serve 
8 Wrap the cake roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour. Once chilled, slice and enjoy your delicious chocolate peanut butter cake roulade!
Enjoy your Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake Roulade! 
This decadent dessert is perfect for special occasions or just a sweet treat to brighten your day. Each slice reveals the delightful swirl of chocolate cake and creamy peanut butter fillingirresistible!

Message:
Luxurious Chocolate Drip Cake 
Indulge in the ultimate dessert experience with this Luxurious Chocolate Drip Cake! A delightful combination of rich chocolate flavors, creamy frosting, and a stunning ganache drip, this cake is perfect for any special occasion or celebration.
Ingredients:
 For the Cake:
3 cups all-purpose flour 
1 teaspoons baking powder 離
 teaspoon baking soda
1 cup unsalted butter, softened 杻
2 cups sugar 
4 large eggs 讀
1 cups buttermilk 拏
2 teaspoons vanilla extract 
Pink food coloring 
 For the Ganache Drip:
1 cup dark chocolate chips 
 cup heavy cream 
 For the Frosting:
2 cups unsalted butter, softened 杻
4 cups powdered sugar 
2 teaspoons vanilla extract 
Pink food coloring optional 
Instructions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven 
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 180C and grease three 8-inch round cake pans.
Step 2: Cream the Butter and Sugar 療
2 In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and sugar until fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Step 3: Prepare Dry Ingredients 籠
3 In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and baking soda. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, alternating with the buttermilk. Mix until just combined. Add pink food coloring to achieve your desired shade of pink.
Step 4: Bake the Cake 
4 Divide the batter evenly among the prepared pans and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool completely in the pans before transferring them to a wire rack.
Step 5: Make the Frosting 
5 In a large bowl, beat the softened butter until smooth. Gradually add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined. For an extra touch, you can add pink food coloring to match your cake.
Step 6: Prepare the Ganache 
6 For the ganache, heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan until just simmering. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate chips in a bowl and let it sit for 2 minutes. Stir until smooth and glossy.
Step 7: Assemble the Cake 
7 Frost the cooled cakes with the buttercream frosting, stacking them neatly. Pour the ganache over the top, allowing it to drip down the edges for a beautiful effect.
Step 8: Decorate and Serve 
8 Finish by decorating the top with swirls of frosting and sprinkling with chocolate flakes. Slice and enjoy your Luxurious Chocolate Drip Cake! 
Enjoy Your Slice of Heaven! 
This stunning cake not only looks gorgeous but also delivers on taste, making it a perfect centerpiece for any celebration!

No-Bake Lemon Blueberry Mousse Cheesecake 
Indulge in the refreshing flavors of summer with this No-Bake Lemon Blueberry Mousse Cheesecake! This stunning dessert combines a crunchy graham cracker crust, luscious blueberry mousse, and creamy lemon filling, making it perfect for any occasion.
Ingredients:
 Crust:
1 cups graham cracker crumbs 
 cup melted butter 杻
 cup sugar 
𢡄 Blueberry Mousse:
1 cup fresh blueberries 𢡄
 cup sugar 
1 tablespoon lemon juice 
1 teaspoon gelatin powder
 cup cold water 
 cup heavy cream, whipped 籠
 Lemon Cream Cheese Filling:
2 8 oz packages cream cheese, softened 燎
 cup sugar 
2 tablespoons lemon zest 
 cup lemon juice 
1 cup heavy cream, whipped 籠
 Topping:
 cup blueberry jam 
Fresh blueberries 𢡄
Lemon zest twists 
Directions:
Step 1: Prepare the Crust 籠
1 In a mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar. Mix well until the crumbs are evenly coated.
2 Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a springform pan. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to set.
Step 2: Make the Blueberry Mousse 
3 In a blender or food processor, puree the fresh blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice until smooth.
4 In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water and let it stand for 1 minute. Then, heat gently until the gelatin dissolves completely.
5 Mix the dissolved gelatin into the blueberry puree until well combined.
6 Gently fold in the whipped cream until fully incorporated.
7 Spread the blueberry mousse over the chilled crust. Chill in the refrigerator until set, about 1 hour.
Step 3: Prepare the Lemon Cream Cheese Filling 
8 In a large mixing bowl, beat together the softened cream cheese, sugar, lemon zest, and lemon juice until smooth and creamy.
9 Fold in the whipped cream until well combined and fluffy.
 Spread the lemon cream cheese filling evenly over the set blueberry mousse layer.
Step 4: Add the Topping 
11 Top the cheesecake with the blueberry jam, spreading it evenly across the surface.
12 Garnish with fresh blueberries and twists of lemon zest for a beautiful finish.
Step 5: Chill and Serve 拾
13 Chill the cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours or overnight for best results before slicing.
14 Serve chilled and enjoy the delightful combination of flavors!
Delightful and Refreshing! 
This No-Bake Lemon Blueberry Mousse Cheesecake is not only visually stunning but also bursting with refreshing flavors. Perfect for warm days or any gathering, its sure to impress your family and friends!

Orange Cheesecake 
Samanthas Orange Cheesecake is a delightful treat that captures the refreshing flavor of orange creamsicle with the indulgent creaminess of classic cheesecake. This dessert is perfect for any occasion, providing a citrusy twist thats sure to impress!
Ingredients:
Crust:
1 cup graham cracker crumbs 
 cup unsalted butter, melted 杻
Cheesecake:
750 grams cream cheese, softened 燎
1 cup sugar 
 cup vanilla yogurt 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
 tsp salt 蓼
Zest from 3 oranges 
 cup fresh squeezed orange juice 
4 large eggs 讀
Instructions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven 
1 Preheat your oven to 325F 160C and spray a 9-inch springform pan with non-stick spray. Set aside.
Step 2: Prepare the Crust 籠
2 In a bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Mix until well combined, then press the mixture firmly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
Step 3: Make the Cheesecake Filling 
3 In the bowl of a stand mixer or a large bowl using a hand mixer, add the cream cheese and mix until smooth and creamy.
4 Gradually add the sugar and mix until fully incorporated.
5 Add the vanilla yogurt, vanilla extract, salt, orange juice, and orange zest. Mix until all ingredients are well combined.
Step 4: Incorporate the Eggs 讀
6 With the mixer on low speed, add the eggs one at a time, mixing just until barely incorporated after each addition. Be careful not to overmix.
Step 5: Bake the Cheesecake 
7 Pour the cheesecake batter into the prepared springform pan. To prevent leaks, place the springform pan on a cookie sheet lined with foil.
8 Place the cheesecake in the preheated oven on the center rack and bake for 85-90 minutes. The edges should be slightly puffed and golden, while the center should jiggle like jello but spring back to the touch.
Step 6: Cool the Cheesecake 
9 Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. Gently use a knife to loosen the sides of the cheesecake from the springform pan to prevent cracking as it cools.
 Allow the cheesecake to cool for an additional 2 hours at room temperature. Then transfer it to the refrigerator and chill for 6 hours or overnight.
Step 7: Serve 
11 Once chilled, cut the cheesecake into 10 equal slices and enjoy!
Prep Time: 12 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hour 25 minutes
Total Time: 3 hours 37 minutes
Servings: 16 slices
Calories: 296 kcal per slice
Enjoy this refreshing Orange Cheesecake thats sure to brighten any gathering!

Message:
Honey Peach Cream Cheese Cupcakes
These Honey Peach Cream Cheese Cupcakes are a delightful treat that captures the essence of summer with their sweet, fruity flavor and creamy frosting. Lets get baking and indulge in these soft, fluffy cupcakes that are perfect for any occasion!
Ingredients:
For the Cupcakes:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 cup buttermilk
1 cup peach preserves 
For the Cream Cheese Frosting:
1/2 cup cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup powdered sugar
1 tablespoon milk
For Garnish:
1/2 cup diced fresh peaches
2 tablespoons honey for drizzle
Sugar crystals for garnish
Optional Substitutions:
Gluten-Free Option: Substitute all-purpose flour with a gluten-free flour blend.
Vegan Option: Use plant-based butter and cream cheese alternatives, replace eggs with flax eggs, and use almond milk instead of buttermilk.
Instructions:
Step 1: Preheat the Oven
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C and line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
Step 2: Prepare Dry Ingredients
2 In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar
3 In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar together until light and fluffy.
Step 4: Add Eggs and Vanilla
4 Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Step 5: Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients
5 Alternately add the flour mixture and buttermilk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with the flour mixture. Mix until just combined.
Step 6: Fill Cupcake Liners
6 Fill each cupcake liner halfway with batter, then add a spoonful of peach preserves. Cover with more batter until the liners are three-quarters full.
Step 7: Bake
7 Bake for 18-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cupcakes cool completely.
Step 8: Prepare Frosting
8 In a small bowl, beat together the cream cheese, powdered sugar, and milk until smooth and creamy.
Step 9: Frost and Garnish
9 Frost the cooled cupcakes with the cream cheese mixture. Top each cupcake with diced fresh peaches, drizzle with honey, and sprinkle with sugar crystals.
Enjoy Your Sweet Treat!

Cook Time: 18-20 minutes
Total Time: Approximately 40-45 minutes
Servings: 12 cupcakes

Message:
No-Bake Red Velvet Cheesecake 
This No-Bake Red Velvet Cheesecake is the perfect dessert for Valentines Day or any special occasion! Its creamy, smooth, and has a delightful hint of chocolate with that classic red velvet flavor. Plus, its easy to make!
Ingredients:
For the Crust:
1 1/2 cups Oreo baking crumbs 
5 tablespoons melted butter 杻
For the Cheesecake Filling:
900 grams about 32 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature 燎
1 cup powdered sugar 
2 teaspoons red food coloring paste 喝
200 grams 8 ounces white chocolate, melted 
75 grams 3 ounces semi-sweet chocolate, melted 
1 cup whipped cream or whipped topping 
For Decoration optional:
Additional whipped cream or whipped topping
Oreo crumbs
Equipment:
9-inch springform pan
Hand mixer or stand mixer
Large mixing bowl
Silicone spatula
Whisk
Liquid measuring cups
Measuring cups and spoons
Instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Crust
1 In a large mixing bowl, combine the Oreo baking crumbs and melted butter until the mixture is moist and crumbly.
2 Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan and refrigerate to set.
Step 2: Melt the Chocolate
3 Melt the white chocolate and semi-sweet chocolate in the microwave. Break the chocolate into small pieces and heat on 50% power in 30-second increments until just melted. Set aside to cool slightly.
Step 3: Make the Cheesecake Filling
4 In a large bowl, combine the room temperature cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix with a hand mixer on medium speed until smooth.
5 Add the red food coloring paste and mix well, scraping down the sides to ensure even distribution of color.
6 While the mixer is running on low speed, add the melted white and semi-sweet chocolate in a steady stream until completely incorporated. Scrape down the sides of the bowl to ensure everything is well combined.
7 Gently fold in the whipped cream or whipped topping until the mixture is fluffy and creamy, with no streaks of white.
Step 4: Assemble the Cheesecake
8 Pour the cheesecake mixture into the prepared crust and smooth the top with a rubber spatula or offset spatula.
9 Refrigerate to set for at least 6 hours or overnight. Alternatively, you can chill for 2-3 hours in the fridge and then place in the freezer for 2-3 hours before serving.
Step 5: Serve
 Once set, top with whipped cream or whipped topping and sprinkle with Oreo crumbs for garnish, if desired.
Prep Time: 20 minutes
Chilling Time: 4 hours
Total Time: 4 hours 20 minutes
Yield: 12 slices
Calories: Approximately 400 kcal per slice calories may vary
Storage Instructions:
This cheesecake can be made up to 2 days ahead of serving and stored in the fridge in an airtight container.
For longer storage, it can be frozen for up to 2 weeks. Thaw in the fridge before serving.
Notes:
Its not recommended to use low-fat or fat-free cream cheese or whipped topping, as these can prevent the cheesecake from setting properly.
Enjoy this luscious No-Bake Red Velvet Cheesecake and impress your loved ones with this delightful treat!

Message:
French Silk Pie
This French Silk Pie recipe is a decadent and rich dessert that balances smooth chocolate filling with a delicious Oreo crust. With less butter and sugar than traditional recipes, its an indulgent treat that you can enjoy without the guilt. Lets dive into this heavenly dessert!
Ingredients
For the Crust:
18 Oreo cookies 200g, with filling
3 tablespoons melted butter 42g
For the Filling:
4 large eggs
1 cup granulated sugar 200g
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 5ml
1/2 teaspoon espresso powder optional
6 ounces unsweetened chocolate or extra dark chocolate 85% chocolate, finely chopped 170g
1/2 cup unsalted butter 113g
1 cup heavy whipping cream 237ml
For the Topping:
1 cup heavy whipping cream 237ml
1 tablespoon powdered sugar
Chocolate curls for topping
Instructions
Step 1: Preheat the Oven
1 Preheat your oven to 350F 175C. Spray a 9-inch deep pie dish with cooking spray or brush lightly with melted butter.
Step 2: Make the Crust
2 Place Oreo cookies in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until finely ground.
3 Add the melted butter and pulse until moistened.
4 Press the mixture evenly into the bottom and up the sides of the prepared pie dish.
5 Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until fragrant and set. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.
Step 3: Make the Filling
6 Combine the chopped chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan with 1 inch of simmering water. Stir until melted and smooth alternatively, melt it in the microwave, stirring every 20 seconds. Set aside to cool.
7 In a heat-proof bowl, combine the eggs with half of the sugar 1/2 cup or 100g. Whisk to blend well.
8 Place the bowl over the simmering water and whisk constantly until the mixture reaches 165F 74C on a digital thermometer. It should feel warm to the touch and completely smooth when rubbed between your fingers.
9 Remove the bowl from heat and place it on a tea towel. Beat the egg mixture on high speed while gradually adding the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar. Continue beating until very pale, thick, and tripled in volume ribbon stage, about 3-5 minutes.
 Add the cooled chocolate mixture and vanilla extract, whisking gently until incorporated. Let it cool for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until its not warm but not solidified.
Step 4: Whip the Cream
1 In a clean bowl, pour the heavy whipping cream and beat on medium speed until it thickens. Increase the speed and beat until it forms soft peaks.
2 Gently fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture in 2-3 stages until no white streaks remain. Pour this luscious mixture into the cooled crust.
Step 5: Chill the Pie
1 Place the pie in the fridge and let it set for at least 4 hours or up to 24 hours.
Step 6: Make the Topping
1 In a clean bowl, pour the heavy whipping cream and beat on medium speed until thickened.
2 Sift in the powdered sugar and beat until soft peaks form.
3 Spoon the whipped cream on top of the chilled pie and garnish with dark chocolate curls.
Serve and Enjoy!
This French Silk Pie is sure to impress with its silky chocolate filling and delicious Oreo crust. Perfect for special occasions or just a cozy dessert at home!
Prep Time: 25 minutes
Cook Time: 25 minutes
Chill Time: 4 hours
Total Time: 4 hours 50 minutes
Servings: 12 servings
Calories: Approximately 400 kcal per slice
Feel free to get creative with the toppings, and enjoy every silky bite of this delectable pie!
